tei:div.tei:p: ṭwāṃ ma cig khros ma nag mo'i sgrub pa gsang ba'i rgya can zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

—41 namodzñā na ḍakki ni ye: shāzag sgo phortsab sgo danas mdagachosakyi dbyangs lhun grub ma 'gag bde gshegasamadzod thugasarje rnam rol ye shesasku khrosam nag mo la phyag 'tshal bdag 'dra padmasaṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongatha'agro la brtse semasakyis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab bas rdo rje snying po'i chosasde bstan sam mā dmang zapagasang bsgrub pa' rim pa ni dben gan dur khrod 'ardogs su rung ba' sar phyon na sde brgyad tshogs la sa bslangs shing nag phyogasasrung ma thams cad dmar gyas brngan bar chad bgegasarnams3brasapha glud kya rdzongs bsru ba'i 'khor lo rim pa brgyad du bskor 'tsho ba'i yo byad brgyad kyang 'tshogs par bya dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi chag chag gdab sto bar gru gsum de rgyab chosa'abyung bya de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibasabazhi legasapa ra bri phyi rim padma 'dab bzhi la sog pa yongasasu gegasapa legasapa ra bya ba dpatshogabu grangasadang mthun rnam par bkod sgrub gtor pad brtsegasaganam lcagasaphur bu dang phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer spyod 'dod yon bkram mdzasashing yid 'ong bkod pa phun tshogasabya bsangs dang khrusagasolarim pa nan du byed rnal 'byor pa rnamasoblo sems bag phab nas bde ba'i stan la gan shing rlung ro dbyung byin rlabs ba da 'dzin tshogasabasagasa'abar 'dzag sgoms de dag sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o sam rwa dan dngasagazhi'i lam la 'jug pa la la kyi

ba tshu ram pa rnam grangs lnga yi bstan dang po skyab su 'gro ba' rigapa ni phaṭa: gni dbyingasaka dag chosakyi sku lhun grub ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje rang grol khrosamal: ngo mtshar chen pos skyabs su mchi lan gsum de nas sems bskyed bsgom pa'i rim pa ni phaṭa: gzhi snang chosasku'i mkha' dbyings su: ma rtogs dmus long mgo rmongs 'gro: rangagrol btsan sa zin pa'i phyir: brdal khyab chen por sems bskyed do lan gsum gsum pa yan lag bdun pa'i rim pa ni phaṭa: rang ṛg sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i dal: yongs grubachen po'i dkyil 'khor la: ngo mtshar dad brgya'i zer chen po'i: rang gsal don gyis phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid 'dod yon kun bzang gter ma spang ye rdzogs mchod pa'i sprin spang blang mtshan ma bral ba yis: 'ub chub chen por gus pas 'bul: snang srid chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la: gzung dang 'dzin rtog rnam par dag bshags dang bshags byedaganyis su med: blo 'das rdzogs pa chen pos gzigs: dmigs med ye dag dkyil 'khor klong zag dang zag med dge tshogs dben: 'on kyang rten 'brel rnam dag pas

rang grol dge la rjes yi rang ngang lasam g.yos ye shesagar: rang snang mchog gi ston pa yis: skal bzang las ldan pho mo la: ma 'gags zang thal chos 'khor bskor 'gro'ong skye 'gags gnas gsum yang: chos nyid ngang la dmigasasu med: 'on kyang 'khrul snang dongs sprugs phyir mi 'da' rdo rje'i ngang la bzhugs dus gsum bsags pa'i dgertsa yang: bsngo dang bsngo bar bya ba med 'on kyang 'khor gsum yongs dag kyis: mnyam brdal dgongs pa mngon du bya dge des gzung 'dzin dbu mar zhig: 'od gsal chosasku'i mkha' dbyings su: lhun grub gzhen nu bum sku'i sbubs: gdod ma'i rgyal sazin par re ga: lan gsum bzhi pa byin chen 'bebasapa'i rim pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ka dag skyeb med pa'idabyings: zang thal dri bral pho brang nas: chos sku yum chen kun bzang mo: gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phob: lhun grub 'gagasapa med pa'i dbyings: rnam kun mchog ldan phobrang nas: longs spyod rdzogs sku wa ra nyi: gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phob:rtsol bral bdechen dag pa'i dbyings: rang gsal 'gags med pho brang nas: ma cig khros ma

pa:tshu nag mo yang:gnasa'adir byon la dbang byin phob ye shes lnga ldan dag pa'i dbyings:'od lnga lhun grub pho brang nas:rang grol mkha' 'gro sde lnga po:gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phob:phrin las lhun grub dag pa'i dbyings:tshad med rnam bzhi'i pho brang nas:las mdzad ḍakki rigs bzhi yang:gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phob:'ub chub gsang ba chen po'i dbyings:ro mnyam bde ba'i pho brang nas rang rtsal gdong can mched bzhi po:gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phob dam tshig gsang ba chen po'i dbyings:tha tshig 'dzin pa'i pho brang nas:sgo skyong dab phyug mched bzhi yang:gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phob:chos nyid skye ba med pa'i dbyi sa rang grol bde ba'i pho brang nas:'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams:gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phob:sna ba 'ja' 'od lams se lam:rig 'dzin gar byed khrigs se khrig:ḍakki'i glu len kyu ru dza rol mo sna tshogs 'u ru dzasgyumakha' 'gro ma tshogs nyi li li:byin rlabs dngos grub thibs se thib:nyams dang rtogs pa ban ma bun:gnas 'dir byin chen dbab

du gsol: 'ja' lus chen por byin gyis rlobs: gachen nu bum sku'i rgyal sar drongs: kun tu bzang po'i sa thob shog: o hṝ badzra kro ti ka li baṃ sarba sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: lnga pa mja rja sabyin masarim pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: snang srid 'dod yon bkod pa rnams: ma bshamasaye rdzogs mchod pa che: rang grol rol bar byin rlabs nas: ma spang kun tu bzang por shar: tshe usnom hā me sa pañtsa rakta bā ling ta sto dhi tsitta sarba su dza ho: lan gsum brjod la byin gyisabam par bya sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa 'o sam wā rgya rgya rgya gnyisapa dngosagazhi la rim brgyad kyi bstan da po ti 'dzin gsum gya khog phub ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ka dag skye med chos sku'i klong: lhun grub 'gags med snying rje'i mdangs rang grol rol ba /ཿmthing nag: spro bsdu'i gzhi ru rnam par shar: gnyisapa lha sku bskyed pa'i rim pa ni phaṭa skye 'gagasabral ba'i dbyings klong du bde chen rang gsal zhing bkod rdzogs: ma chagasapad nyi zla ba'i khar rtog bral bam ro gan skyal steng: hūṃ bab 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas bdag snang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku: khros ma nag mo mthing nag rngams: zhal gcig phyag

ba tshu gnyis spyan gsum pa ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes: thod skam dbu rgyan cod paṇa 'phur nyi ma zla ba'i snyan cha byas: spyi bor phag zhal gyen du ngur: sgragaseb rdo rje'i tshwa tsha 'phros: spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche bzhi gtsigs: thal tshom khrag thig zo ras mdzes: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad chemaphreng rdzogs smin mar me yi tshwa tsha 'phro: nyarigisa'i brda glu gyer phyag g.yas gug nam mkhar phyar: bag chags las kyi 'khrul rgyun gcod: g.yon pas bhanta thugs garabakan khams gsum ma spang 'ub chub rol: nu ma 'bur zhing padmo rgyas: bde stong dga' bzhi'i rgyun bzang 'bebs zhe sdang rang grol stag sham klubs: nga rgyal ma spang glang godang: 'dod chags rang grol mi lngags bsgo: ye shes drug rdzogs rus rgyan spras: phrin las lhun grub dar dpyangs 'phur: zhabs gnyisagar bsgyur srid zhi gnon: he ru ka pamatshon pa'i phyir: mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭwāṃ brten:—thod rnga me long dril g.yer dang: ye shes lda ldan dar tshon mjes: 'ja' 'od zer gsum phyogs bcur 'phrosnye ma rig gzhob

bsregs me dpung 'bar snang stong 'dzin med sgyu ma'i sku: 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bur sgom: de yi phyi rim rtsibs stengs su: pad nyi zla ba bam ro'i khar: shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gri gug g.yas la kha ṭwāṃ g.yon lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: ṭa ri g.yas la bum pa g.yon: nub du padma mkha' 'gro ma bhan dmar gri gug phyag rgyar bsgyur: byang du las kyimakha' 'gro ma: rgya gram phur ba stabs su 'dzin: kun kyang sku mdog mthing gsal rngams: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa: dmar ser ral ba gyen du 'khyil: spyi boraphag zhal nag po ngur: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs smin mar me yi tshwa tsha 'phro: dur khrod chas rdzogs rus rgyan spras: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur bam gdanabardzis: mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭwāṃ brten: 'od lnga me dpung klong du bskyed: snang stong gnyis su med par gsal: de rgyab mtsham gyi rtsibs stengs su: pad nyi zla ba bam gyi khar shar lhor 'gugs byed chen mo ni: rdo rje g.yas la lcags kyu g.yon: lho nub 'ching byed rngams ma ni: zhags pa phyar zhing gri gug brten nub byang sdom byed dbang sdud mo: padma

gas/: dang ni lcags sgrog 'dzin byang shar phyos byed 'bar ma ni dril bu 'brol zhing bhan dmar stob:kun kyang mthing gsal nam mkha'i mdog:zhal gcig phyag gnyis mche bzhi gtsigs:dmar ser ral ba 'khyil zhing zlum:zur zhal rngams pa'i stangs stabs gyis pad nyi ro yi gdan la brdzis:gzig sham rus rgyan dar dpyangs 'phur 'od lnga me dpung 'bar ba'i klong:snang stong gnyis su med par sgoms:de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng:bdud dang dam sri bsnol ba'i khar:shar du dkar mo rnam rgyal ni mi mo sbrul gyi gdong pa can:gri gug g.yas la lcags kyu g.yon:chibs su lcags spyang sngon mo bcib:sha la rol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum:las la 'gyed cing bstan pa bsrung lho ru ser mo tshe 'phel ni:mi mo seng ge'i gdong pa can phyag gnyis tho ba nor bu bsnams chibs su rgya bong dmar ka bcibs:khrag la gzhib pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum rnam par 'phrul zhing sngags la mos:nub du dmar mo dbang sdud ni:mi mo bya yi gdong pa can:zangs 'dren thod khrag phyag na bsnams:chibs su rtsal ldan bya rgod bcibs:tshe sdud

rus 'cha' skang ldag ma: 'bum 'bum las byed pho nyar 'byed: byang du dbugs len nag mo ni: mi mo dred kyi gdong pa can: rgya gram sbrul zhags phyag rgya 'ching: chibs su gsera'aphar shugs ldan bcibs: srog dbugs sdud pa'i pho nya 'gyed: kun kyang mthing nag char sprin gzugs zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar bsgyur can: rus rgyan gzig sham daradapyangs 'phur: me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus: snang stong gnyis su med par bskyed: de rgyab dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad mthing gsal rngams pa'i cha lugs can: mgo brnyanasna tshogs ya ma zu : rdzu 'phrul phyag rgya du ma 'chang: bstan la gdung zhing sgrub la mos: dam tshig can gyi grogs su bskyed: de rgyab sgo bzhi bsrung mdzad pa'i: bka' nyan dragasapa sde bzhi ni: shar du klu rgyal sku mdog mthing zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum sgeg: sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka spud: dbu skra thor cog srog zhus mdzes: ratna'i phrengab gsum rim 'chang: phyag gnyis rdo rje gter bum bsnams: sku smad gser sbrul g.yas su 'khyil: 'ja' sprin khu sbring 'khrigs pa'i dbus snang stong gnyis su med par bskyed

badzra: lho ru las gshin sku mdog mthing:zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngams:spyan gsum rab bsgrad smar smin 'bar:dbu sgra gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan:tho chenakhram shing phyag na bsnams:stag gi lpags pa'i thul ba klubs:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur stang stabs kyis:ma he glang rgod chibs su bcib:lasabyed sprul pa khra thabs 'gyed me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus:stong gsal sgyu ma'i lha ru bskyed:nub du bdud btsan sku mdog mthing:zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum sgeg:spyan bsgrad mche gtsigasaman du bsdams zangs khrab zangs rmog dar snas brgyan:stag ral gzig shub g.yas g.yon 'khyugs:btsan mdung g.yas la bdud zhags g.yon:chibs su btsan rta rlungagashog bcibs:bsam pa tsam gyis yid la sleb:las byed pho nya'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs:stong gsal 'od kyi rol bar bskyed:byang du rakta 'tshubs ma'i klong:dpal ldan lha more ma ti:zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum sgeg:ral pa gyen brdzes dam rtags su:zla phyed rdo rje rma bya'i mdangs:rnam par bkra zhing rus rgyan spras:mi lngags bsgo zhing re lde

klubs: phyag gnyisaral gri bhanta bsnams: stangs stabs gar gyi rnam 'gyur gyis: chibs su dril rta shugs ldan bcibs: bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la dgyes: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'gyed: dbyings la gnas kyang dam tshig srung: zab gsang gnyer 'dzin chen mor bskyed: de mthar gnas yul mkha' 'gro dang: dur khrod he ru'i ḍakki rnams: ma 'dres til gong phyur ba bzhin: 'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed lha tshogs byin rlabasagazi 'od kyis: khams gsum semasacan lha 'dre rnams 'od gsal chosasku'i mkha' la sad: rdzogasapa chen por btsan gzin: rang grol gnyug ma'i lha ru bzhedas: de ltar gsal ba'i la rnams kyi: gnasagasum rdo rje'i srog yig las: 'od dang 'od phung dpag med 'phros: dag pa dbyingasakyi pho brang nas: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams: spyan drangasaganyis su med par bstim: gsum pa spyan 'dren bya lo rimapa ni phaṭa skyo'agagasa'agyur med spros mtha' bral: rang gsal lhun grub pho brang nas ye sangs rgyasapa kun bzang mo: ma 'gags bde stong wa ra hi: rang grol rol ba yum chen lnga: thugs rje'i rang

ba tshu rtsal mkha' 'gro 'bum:ma thogs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs:dbyings la spros rtog med mod kyang:'khor ba dbyings su gzhig pa'i phyir:gang 'dul thabs stobasadu ma yis:gdul bya rjes su bzung du gsol:slo shrī badzra kro ti ka li baṃX nya phiniḥ4sarba sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza:bzha pa b.lagasu gsol ba' rim pa na phaṭa:ma bcosaye sangs rgyas pa'i lha:gdod nas sku gsum dag pa 'i gshis:gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma med mod kyang:'khrul 'khor gzhig phyir brtan par bzhugs:sam ya dzñā na st+waṃ tiṣṭha badzra:lnga pa phyag lasarabya ba' rim pa na phaṭa 'khor ba ma spang gzhi la rdzogs:'das pa ma bsgrub rig pa'i ngang:ye mnyam chen po'i dkyil 'khor la:lta ba dag pas phyag 'tshalalo:na mo dzñā na shā ya mi na ma:drug pa mja pa khrul ba' rim pa na phaṭa gzung dang 'dzan pa'i bsdus pa yi:chos kun ye shesarol ba'i brlabs:rmad byung kun du bzang po'i rgyan byi nang gsang gsum rnam par dag:dngos 'dzin blo yis ma dmigs par:rig stong ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i:gsang ba gsum rdzogs mnyes phyir 'bul:thugs dam dgyes

bskang gnyis rtog kyi: dri ma dbyings su dag gyur cig: ma hā pañtsa pu dza ho: bdun — snyan pa'i dbyangasakyi bstod pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: kadag skye ba med pa'i dbyings: spros mtha' bral ba chos kyi sku: zung 'jug ye shes 'ub chub klong ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsal stong 'gags pa med pa'i dbyings: zang thal rang grol sngags kyi sgra: bde chen rol ba tshang ba'i dbyangs: ma mkha' 'gro'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam par dag cing rang gsal ngang: snang dang stong pa gnyis su med: zung 'jug chu zla'i rol gar bzhin: ma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'chal bstod: dbyings nyid ngo bo rnam par dag: stong gsal thugs rje 'gags pa med: dug lnga rang grol ye shes ngang: ma mkha' 'gro sde lngar phyag 'tshal bstod: ma skyes gdod nas dag pa yis: kun bzang klong las ye shes rtsal: tshad med rnam bzhi'i 'gro ba 'dul: ma mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod chos nyid zhi ba chen po las: rnam rol ma 'gags khros pa'i gzugs: log rtog gnyis snang du tra'i gshed: ma srin mo rigs bzhi'i sku la bstod: chos nyid chags bral chen po

ga tshu las: bde stong gar gyis 'gro ba 'dul: dam tshig gsang ba'i sgog 'dzin ma: ma dbang phyug nyer brgyad sku la bstod: dbyingasalas ma g.yosaye shesagar: logartog 'dul ba'i gshed du shar: rnam rol khros pa'i ngar skad can: dpal sgog bdag sde bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod zang thal sprosamatha' bral ba'i dbyings: thugs rje 'gro 'ongarnam 'gyur gyis: dad ldan gdul bya smin grol byed: ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror bstod dbyings la gnyis su med mod kyang: sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i gar bsgyura'aphrul: don la sku gsum dkyil 'khor te: ma 'khor 'das gnyis med 1nga la bstod: bstod dang bstod byar gnyis su med: mchod dang mchod par bya ba dben: zang thal 'ubachub bde ba'i klong: ma 'khor gsum yongs dag klong du bstod: brgyad pa ༅gas bya ba'i ram pa na ho sangasargyas rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang: rin chen padma las kyi dbyings: ye shesadam tshig 'jig rten gyi: ḍasgri ma tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag ni don gyi rnal 'byor te: dbyings bzhugs chos sku'i sgrub la brtson: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i nyams len byas

rang grol rol bar dag smin rdzogs: 'ub chub bde klong rtsol ba la: gnyis rtog ma rig mtshan ma yis dri ma bag chags byung gyur na: zang thal rdo rje lta bu yis: dgongs pa ro mnyam gnad kyis gzir: bshags dang bshags bya gnyis su med: ces5 dbyings rang grol lhug par ā oṃ yi hūṃ badzra sa ma ya shukhye ā yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing dri ma bshags gnad desanyamasartogasa'aphel rgyas daro sogrub thob daro sagazhi lag len 'deb pa 'i rim pa'o sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gsum pa rjesarim rnam grang lnga yi bstan dang po 'dzab bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ shrī mi gnasaye shesachos sku'i zhing: bde stong gar gyi pho brang nas: sku gsum mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam dgongs pa gnad nas bskul: gzugs skusasnang srid yongs khyab cing: sngags sgras sa gsum g.yo ba dang: ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter: da lta nyid du rab brtsal nas grub pa'i rtagasamatshan dngos grub kun: ring por mi thogs mngon gyur mdzod:dus la bab po sa ma mā: gnyis pa 'dzab bzlos sngags kyi nasal 'bar ni hū hrīḥ rang nyid khros ma'i thugs ka phu phag mo mthing gsal tshon gang ba gri thod 'dzin cing rgyan rnams spras: de

ba tshu yi thugs gar zla gdan la: kun tu bzang mo nas 'byu tsam: gcer bu mnyam bzhag skyil drung bzhugs: thugs klong nyi zla'i ga'u rtsa rig pa sno sngon spus brisatsamaḥde la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas gnyis rtog dri ma bsreg: gzung 'dzin las nyon bag chags dag: rang grol rol par rdzogs sangs rgyas: ma badzra kro ti ka li rbaXha ri niḥsaḥ〉 phaṭa bskyed gsal ting 'dzin gnad dang lda na pa yis bye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga bzlas gyur na phya nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi zhing nyams da rtogs pa'i yon tan gong 'phel rgyas gsum pa sgrub par bya ba'i'adzab dmags ni smi rang nyid khrosama'i thugs srog sngags: g.yon du 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis 'gro drug 'khor ba'i las nyon sbyangs: lha dang lha mo'i rol par sad: slar yang 'od zer dpag med 'phros: rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa bskangs: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub kun thib kyis byung nas bdag mdun dang: sgrub pa'i rdzas la sib sib thim: lha sngags bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor gyi: rol ba chen por dag smin rdzogs: 'khor 'das bde ba chen po'i ngang oṃ badzra kro ti ka li baṃX nyariniḥ4sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā

dmigs gsal ting 'dzan no ngar ldan yis bye ba bcu gsum bzlasapa sa daro sa grub thob sngar med nyams rtogasayon tan hur bo 'khrung byin rlabasarno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags bzhi pa lasal sbyor ba'i 'dzab dmigs ni hūṃ sdiḥ bdag nyid khrosam nag mo yi thugs srog ba spu'i bu ga nas: 'od zer me 'od mtshon cha'i char: khro chung sdigs khyung dur phag 'phros: snang srid khams kyi gnod byed dang nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags rnams: sbur ma me dang 'phrad bzhin bsreg mi mthun nyes tshogs zhi zhing stong: tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs rgyas: khams gsum sridagasum mos bzhi dbang: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral la sogs: las bzhi lhun gyis grub par bsam: snyen badzra 1 ti ka li dza nyabiniḥs naya tsar sa ma ya ndho tri sarba sha hūṃmā ra ya phaṭa: dmigs pa ting 'dzan rno ngar ldan pa yis bye ba gsum bzlas las bzhi lhun gyis grub nyams rtogs yon tan gong nas gong 2the la 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longasad nges shesagasal lnga pa 'dod don gsolagadab rim pa na hūṃ trīḥ ye shesathugasarje phyogs ris mtshan ma bral: bde chen 'dus ma byas pa'i mkha' klong nas rgyal ba kun yum badzra rigs kyi dbyings: rnam par sgrub pa'i

su(lnga skal ldan bdag cag la: mkhyen brtse nus stobs 'bar bas dgongs su gsol: sna tshogs sku ru lam du khyer na yang: rmongs 'khrul tshogs drug bslu brid zhi bar mdzod grags stong 'gags med sngags su lam khyer yang: 'phro rgod rlung gi rgyu ba dag par mdzod: shes rig zang thal thugs su lam khyer yang: nyon 'khrul dug lnga'i mdud pa grol bar mdzod: dkyil 'khor gsum ldan rnam par sgrub na yang: chen rtog 'dzin pa'i rgong rgya grol bar mdzod: rtsa thig rlung gsum sku gsung thugs sgrub kyang: gcisa'adzin mdud pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhi bar mdzod gnyug ma sku gsum 'bral med lam khyer tshe: byi rmugs 'thibs rgod rkyen dang bral bar mdzod: rdo rje snying po'i lam la brten na yang sdom pa gsum gyi gnad gsang skyong bar mdzod: rmad byung a ti'i nyams len byed pa la: gol shor nor gsum gegs dang 'phrang grol mdzod nam zhig 'di snang 'khrul 'khor zhig ma thag: rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' klong grol bar mdzod gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags mi 'char bar: kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par shog: cesapa la sogasadage bsngo rgya

chen bya nyamasadang rtogasapa'i yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur byan rlabs rno nusaya mtshan khyad par 'phags gdamasapa kun gya yang bcud rmad byung ba snying gi yang tig srog bcud dmar nag nyid shin tu zab cing rtagasamatshan bsamami khyab bden rdzun lag tu longasodang nges shes gsal dkon mod rgyal khamasa'agrim la stosadang mthongaḥ mi bslu ba de gu ru padma'i bka' sam pā mim rgyalaba'idabang po padma rtsebha wa'i ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen po yis snying gi yas tig gdamasapa rmad byung ba grub chen 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pas ran chen brdo la thob cig dgyesasde mo mdo khams dpal gyi rdzo sa der dgongs bra thob gter bdag bzas phyirasrog bdag bzha la gnyer thub par srung shig badzra sam yu skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya ma 'ong snyigasam sum cukha ral dus nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan dpa' bo ni 'jig bralanus na 'dusapa rtsal gyis rnyed bstanadang 'gro la phan bde'i nyi ma spel sngags nag ral khur skyesabu bcu gsum la zab gsang dpal gyi mdzod chen 'di gtad nas rong chen bcu gsum chos kyi lam la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod gdul bya'abum phrag rang grol rgyal gzin the tshom med do rdo rje padma'i bka' zab gsang zagasasu ma 'jug ging dkar nag sprul thugs kyi srasadang 'phrad par shog sam yā rgya rgya rgya sgrub pa gsang ba'i rgya can zhesabya ba rdzogs so

—41 gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan rgya slob dpon padma sobha pa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza bkod pa'o brda thim lha gang zhig ngur smig 'dzan pa chosakya mdzod/gang dganyan mongs rab dben rnal 'byor pa /gang sku zab gter spyod pa gdong lnga'i dbang /gang la mos 'dun rgyas pa zhirnyasabargyan/chos dbyings klo 'dzan zab rgya 'byed pa'i sgo/chos nyad don rtogasa'agyur ba mi mnga' ba/chos la mos 'dun stobs rgyasarang grol sogs/chos 'di'i gas sgo phye bar lan brgya bskul/gsang chen mdzod 'dzan nusaldan 'dusartsa gyas/gsang ba dbyings kyi brda rgo gsal bar phyes/gsang chen snyan rgyud lam du drangs byas nas/gsang sngagasamakha' 'gro 'du ba' glang nas spel/shes 'dod zhe rtsa sbos pa 'i rtog ge'i rigs/shes min ras chad blo lngan the tshom can/shes rig zum bzhin log lta'i bdud dpung 'ga'/shes rab ra gad sa spyan gcig khrag khol mas/shes paragyasal klong chen zhal du stobs/nges gsang theg pa chen por zhus pa rnams/nges pa'i don rtogs gdod ma'i rgyal sa la/nges pa nyid du maro na pa ra byang chub nas/nges med 'gro kham dong sprugasanusapar shogadage'o chal chol rnala'abyor kun bza la/dge'o dus mtha'i rgad po kun nyis phul/dge'o sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'dzug gyur cigalegs so rdzogs ldan sna ba dar smin rgyas/masko lam ste kun nas bkra shas shog/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rjesnyingapolas ma cig khros ma nagamo yi:bshags pa mun sel sgron me bzhugs so:gas/: na mo dzñā na ḍakkini ye ste ste/misna spruslo rab khumasam ba thams cad kya:phran lasagacig tu bsdusapa' gar 'gro ba' mgon po padma wāng bde za 'khor lo' rgyan du rol ma 'o salas ldan pho mo rnams gas chen rdo rje'i sgor zhugs tsha dam tshag nyam chags byu gyur na bshags pa'i thabasa'ad e ma rmad sa ma yu gnyan po stobasabazha tshang ba yis 'ad nyid dus drug sbyar bar rag khyad pa ra bas tshogasabyed pa'i dus 'ad nyad srog ga gtso ru zungs e ma hodamigs rmed bla ma chos sku kun tu bzang ma 'gags ra grol longs sku rigs lnga dang:thugs rje 'gro 'dul thub pa chen podrug:gnyis med bde rol sems dpa' sems ma'i dal:mu bzhi gnas dag sgo skyong yab yum sogs:zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo:gzung 'dzin dbyings rol chemachog yab yum dang dug lnga rnam dag khrag 'thu yab yum bcu gnas yul ko seng dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad rigs drug dbyings rol spor byed chen mo drug:khrag 'thung lnga bcu

brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i klong: sku dang ye shes dbyer med lhun grub dal: rnam dag 'dus ma byas pa'i dkyil 'khor la: rnam grol lta bdag pas phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes nyid las ye shes gar bsgyur ba dga' rab shrī seng pa da 'byung bī ma la: rje 'bangs nyer lnga rgya bod paṇa grub la: dam tshig nyam chags sbyangaphyir phyag 'tshal lo: sgo gsum ltos med phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: nyams chags dag phyir gus pa chen pos 'bul: bdag ni gsang chen theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba blama'i sku gsung thugs mchog gi dam tshig nyer bdun bka' bzhin ma srungs te nyam chags zhig ral 'gal 'das mthol lo bshags yan lag spyad bya shes bya sgrub bya dang mi spang dang len nyi shu rtsa lnga las: 'das te 'gal 'khrul chag nyams zhig ral kun: mi 'chab mi sbed gnong zhing 'grod pas bshags: bla med don rtogs ma bsgom dor ba dang rdo rje'i bla ma ma sgrub gshe bskur log: sngags gsum phyag rgya khas blang sa gnad las g.yel: mched la brtse gdung ma byas dam nyams bshags: phyi gsang gnas dus sgrub rdzas

ba rte yo byad dang:bar gsang lha sngags gzungs ma grub pa'i rtags:gsang bar 'os dang gsang ba gnyer gtad rnams:'chol rtog ngang spyod 'gal 'das mthol lo bshags:gzhan yang dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde dang:sum brgya drug cu rtsa ba yan lag ni:phyi dang khyad par wag pa'i dam tshag las:'gal 'das nyam chags zhig ral ci mchis pa mi 'a ba mi sted gnong zhing 'grod sems kyis:snying nasabashags so tshangasapa'i dngos grub stsol:o badzra sa1 sogs yi ge brgya pa bgyortsa brgyad pad dkar gdan gnasayo dpa' la dmigs te rtog pa bar ma bcad tsho ba de yi gnad lngan na dam tshag nyam chags sor chud 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa dma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen po yas snying dang 'dra ba'i gdamasapa med byung ba 'brog mi lo tsā chos mdzod 'dzan la g.yo da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa' rin chen brda la thob cig sar dzu mdo khamasardo rje' rdzo la dgongasorgya thoms ma 'o sasnyigasam gsum cu kha ral dus o rgyan rig 'dzan nu ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nasabastan pa rin chen 'dzan skyong spel bka' bab ral khur bcu gsum dag la 'doms de dag gisakyang rong chen bcu gsum 'dul gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro

don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srung shig srog bdag lnga skal med lag tu ma shor spri gri gsum dam ldan bu la sprod cig king dkar nag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bshagasapa mun sel sgron me rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma waṃbha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza bkod pa'o brda thim snyi blo gro rnal 'byor kun bzang bstan 'dzin dang /blo mtha' yasaparnyas mos bskul ngor/blo bral dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes smras/blo non smon semasazhesabyasayi ger phab/blo ldan skyes bu rnams kyi dpal du shogasarba maṅga lam/
0〈tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba tshogs chen rab rdzogs bzhugs so:

ba rte na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye sgosgo/ skosgoshā/ ma 'ongasalasaldan pho mo yi rgas ོga sgrib pa dag pa'i phyor mkha' 'ayo dkyil 'khor la brten pas sabasto bskang ba zab mo bstan samamā blo sem bag phag dwangasam yi la byed ḍakkis sabazhi thogs dkyala'akhor lha tshogasarnamasalabastabs tshogasardzogasasprib pa dag par dmigs snyen ya snodum ga ga ka pā la ru bskyil ba yi rtsa brgyadastong la sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi sman:myong grol bde stong pañtsa a dṛ ta:dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la gus pas 'bul:khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings su stong bya'i phyir:rtena'abrel bcu gnyis rtsa ba khrag chen po:gir ta'i bcud dang 'byung ba'i rakta rnams:dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul:brdal khyab yangs pa'i gzheng par brten4sa pa'i phyi nang snod bcud bkod pa'i gtor go bshams:'dod yon lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang 4sa nas rgyal yum 'phagasama'i dkyil 'khor bskang phyir 'bul kunagazhi brdal khyab yangs pa'i skong bu phusems rtog byang chub sems kyi mar khus gtam:ye shesalnga ldan sgron me 'bar ba 'dis:ma rig bsal phyir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul

gtsa/: bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i sems can kun:rang rig ye shes dgongs pa mngon gyur nas:nang dbyings gdod ma'i rgyal sa mchog zin nas:sprul ba'i 'gro khams dong sprugs nus par regag:bsod nam thabs su shar ba 'dis 'gro ba'i don gnyis gegs med 'grub nyams rtog yon tan gong 'phel rgyas dam tshag nyam chags sor chud 'gyur ze tshom med do sa ma mā rgyal dbang padma'i thugasabacud 'di 'brog mi lo cwa khyod la gtad sprul ba lasacan gcig gisarded bstan 'gro'i don 'byung the tshom med thub pa ra sru sashig srog bdag lnga sam yu rgya rgya rgya rdzasabazha' bskang ba tshogasachen rab rdzog rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sba rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa dma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa 'o brda thim snyi chosamin gang gi dgosamed kun bzang dang ༷༷ ༷ ༷༷ /dun che ba dharmasogs/chos bskul nus pa du mas mos ro ra du/chos kya mdzod 'dzan nus ldan rdo sa smras/chos gzug yi ge'i ris byed smon semasasogs/chos 'das 'gro khams dori sprugs nus par shog

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:ma cig khros ma nag mo yi tshogs bsags bsdus pa 'dod 'byung nor bu bzhugs so:gtsa(: na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye:ga sa sgazhes gsang za lam la zhugs ya rnal yor skyesabu pho mo yis dam go wa gsabaskang ba'i phyir rga mja 'dod lung nor bu bam sam shā de nas bza' 4'a bayo ba' rags ga 'byer dum gcig snod du bsags bsangs sbyangasabyin gyisabamasanas slar snyan pa'i dbyangs4 'di skad do phaṭa:gces 'dzin phung po tshogs dang bsre sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rol bar bsgyur:'dod rgu'i dpa la yon nam mkha'i mdzod:myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir dmigs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:skye med rnam dag chosasku yum lhun grub rang grol yum chen lnga:thugs rje rtsol bral 'bum phrag gyi:ma dang mkha' 'gro sbyan 'dren gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:snang ba snod kyi gzhed pa ru khams gsum srid pa'i dpal yon bshams brdal khyab lpags pa'i gzhong pa phuphung khams skye mched tshogs su shar:kun gzhi yangs pa'i gzhed pa ru sems rtog ga ṇa tsakrar dmigs ma dang mkha' 'gro'i

dal du 'bul:'ub chub bde ba chen por bzhes:dam tshig nyam chags mthol lo bshags:gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i rū tra bsgral:ye shes gsang ba'i klong du bstabs:gnyis med thub chub chen por bzhes:sku gsum 'bras bu'i sa thob shog:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dngosa'abyor yid kyisarnam 'phrul ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i lhag gtor rnams:ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul:phrin las rab 'byamasayongs grub mdzod:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:de ltar gnad du brten pa' mi tsha 'dir phya nang rkyen lasargyal nyamasartog yon to gong 'phel 'gyur the tshom med dosam mā rgyal dbang padma'i thugasab da 'ad 'aprog mi lo tsā khyod la gtad da dung ma spel brda lathob ma 'ong snyigasam lnga yi dus sprul pa la can gcag ga rnyed bstan dang 'gro ba' phan bde spel 'gro don bsam mi khyabapa 'byung de phyir srog tham zab mo 'di thub par srungasashig srog bdag lnga skal med lag tu ma shor cig sam wā rgya rgya rgya tshogasabasagasabasdusapa 'dod 'byung nor bu ོga so gter rgya gto rgya sbasargyazab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o ma gyi slob dpon pa dma rtsebha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar za bzasabakod pa'o brda tham snyi bde ba'i rnal 'byor kun bzang bstan 'dzin ngor/bde ldan dpa' bo rolaba'irdo rje yis/bder gnasazangs

btsakhri ri mched lnga'i ba gam nas/bde legs nga gnas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod phab/bde spel yi ge'i ras bye do samasaso/sarba masgo lam/zer badzra phaṭa:brtan galo phung khams sems rtog 'di:ma dang mkha' 'gro bskang phyir 'bul:rlung sems sgyu lus bum skur chub:sku thugs zung 'jug mngon gyur shog:ga
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: ma cig khros ma nag mo'i tshogs bsags gter gyi bum pa bsod nams rdzogs pa'i rdzong chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gsaX na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye:sko 144garna / kadag zang thal chos sku spros mtha' bral lhun grub ma 'gags long spyod rdzogs mad da yum ra grol rol ba sprul sku bde ba che 'du 'bral med pagazhug ma'i ngang du mchod bdag 'dra o rgyan padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs lasaldan 'jug pa'i thabs ba mo mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa 'i cha lag tshogs bsags thabs gter gyi bum bzang bsod nams nga chen bstan sam yu nayang bza' bca' bayo ba'i yo byad rigs gang 'byor yo byad ci snyed tshogs pa bsags bsangs sbya sa ting nge 'dzan gyis byan rshabs sa ro mtshar bkod pa bsam ma khyab par spel lasakyi rim pa bco lnga dag gi bstan dang po byinagya bam pa'i rim pa ni phaṭa rang rig yeshes khros mar 'phos:phung po 'dod rgu mi zad gter:ngo mtshar ma du byung ba yi kun bzang mchod pa bla na med:dpag yasanam mkha'i khyon gang gyur:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:ngo bo yedag chos sku'i rdzas:rang bzhin rnam dag lhun grub gter:rnam 'phrul ma 'gags sha lnga dang:bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga yi bcud spang blang bral ba byang chub sems:sna tshogs 'phrul dga'i longs spyod 'gyed:snyen yisahūṃ ha ho hrī:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa gnyasapa tshogasazhing spyan 'dren bya ba ni rkangaslong sgradang thod rnga snyan pa'iglus ka

pa:tshu dag skye ba med pa'i klong:bde chen spros bral pho brang nas:chos sku yum chen kun bzang mo:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa lhun grub bde chen dag pa'i dbyings sku dang ye shes pho brang nas:longs spyod rdzogs mdzad wa ra hi:'du ba tshogs kya 'khor lor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:thugs rje rang shar rang grol klong zang thal ye shes pho brang nas sprul sku khros ma nag mo yaja :'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:dbyings nyid rnam par dag pa'i klong 'dzin pa bral ba'i pho brang nas:sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:gsal dag ye shes chen po'i slong:ma 'gags bde lan pho brang nas:rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i dbyings:lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas:rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:chags bral bde stong 'ub chub klo :zang thal ye shes pho brang nas:padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:

ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dag grol ye shes rol ba'i klong:dga' ba rang grol pho brang nas las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:'du ba tshogs kyi ja lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:zhi ba lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas snying rje'i rang gdangs mkha' 'gro ma:lcags kyu chen mo gtso 'khor bcas:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rgyas pa rmad byung dkyil 'khor nas:byams pa'i rang gdangs mkha' 'gro ma:zhags pa chen mo gtso 'khor bcas:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:dbang chen lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas:dga' ba'i rang gdangs mkha' 'gro ma:lcags sgog chen mo gtso 'khor bcas:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:drag po rngams brjid dkyil 'bar nas:btang snyoms rang gdaja sa mkha' 'gro ma:dril bu chen mo gtso 'khor bcas 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:chos nyid zhi ba chen po las:gdug pa 'dul ba' gar bsgyur mkhas:dkar mo rnam rgyal sha za 'bum:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs

pa:tshu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:mnyam nyid 'ub chub chen po las gnyisartog mtshan ma 'dul la mkhas:ser mo tshe 'phel khrag 'thung 'bum:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor /zhegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:ma chags chags bral bde ba'i klong:gsang chen rol ba'i gar la mkhas:dmar mo dbang sdud skang ldag 'bum:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyogs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:dag grol rol ba dbyings kyi klong:'dzin med bde stong gar la mkhas:ljang mo dbugs len rus 'cha' 'bum:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gogs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:rang grol chos nyid dag pa'i dbyings:tshad med snying rje'i dkyil 'khor nas:rdo rje rigs kyi sring bdun yang 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs 4 ṭa phaṭa phaṭa:'ub chub bde ba chen po'i klong:tshad med byams pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:rin chen rigs kyi grogs bdun yang:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa 4 ṭa:chags med bde chen rol ba'i dbyings tshad med dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:padma rigs kyi mdza' bdun yang:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:

dag grol rol ba chen po'i klong:tshad med btang snyomasadakyil 'khor nas:las rab rigs kyi sring bdun yang:'du ba tshogasakyi 'khor lor gshegs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:'o mtsho rol ba'i klong dkyil nas:'dod rgu'i gru char 'bebs mdzad pa:klu yi rgyal po gtso 'khor bcas:'du ba tshogasakyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:lho phyogs lcagasamakhar dgu rum slong:yi dwags kun gyi sde dpon mchog:ya ma ra tsa 'khor dang bcas 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa pha 'ong lung ba'i sku mkhar nas bdud btsan 'tshogs pa'i sras gcig pu:shan pa kis 'debs 'khor dang bcas:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:mu le gting gi mtsho 'gram nas:bstan pa bsrung ba'i pho nya mo:dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo yang:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dbyings nyid spros mtha' bral mdo kyang:sna tshogs thabs dang rten 'brel bsgyur:'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:bka' gsang gnyan gyi pho brang nas:las

gtsa) mdzad dregs chen bco brgyad dang dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: tha tshig gsang ba'i pho brang nas las byed bka' nyan ging dkar nag: rnam sprul bsam mi khyab pa yang 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dbyings bzhugs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dbu skra thog tsug ldems se ldem: lcang lo'i zar bu ta la la: snyan cha gdu bu gyi li li: rus rgyan g.yer kha khro lo lo: sna tshogs gar byed khyugs se khyug: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog nyams re dga': rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang: tshogs rdzas yo sbyad lhun re 'thug: gdung ba'i glu dbyangs ngag re snyan mgron gyi 'du ba bag re dro: dbyings nas skur bzhengs dus la bab phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gsum pa tshogasamaja 'bul ba'i rim pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bka' brgyud bla ma sras dang bcas:bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogs la rol: byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pa dang: 'khor ba dong sprugs nus par shog phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs

'khor dang bcas: bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogs la rol: dbang dang dngo sa grub char ltar phob: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dbyings gsum dag la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'bum phrag yangs pa'imakha' 'gro ma bdud rtsi baṃ gyi tshogs la rol brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dbyings la spyod cing gar bsgyur mkhas dpa' bo dpa' mo bsam mi khyab bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogs la rol: 'gro don brin las 'grub par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dbyings las ma g.yos thugs rje'i rtsal rnal 'byor pho mo mched lcam bcas bdud rtsibam gyi tshogs la rol: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ye shes las grub bstan pa'i bdag: dam can srung ma gtso 'khor bcas bdud rtsi bam gyitshogs la rol: bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dbyings las log 'khrul gdug sems 'chang: nga bdag lha 'dre che 'bring chung: bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogasalarol stong nyid snying rje spyod par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ma rig khams gsum 'khor ba'i yul: rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams kun bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogasal rol: 'khrul

ba lho snang dong sprugs nus par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: la la phyi yi tshogs la rol: la la nang gi tshogs la rol: la la gsang ba'i tshogs la rol la la de nyid tshogs larol: rol cig dga' ston tshogs la rol: spyod cig mthun pa'i rdzas la spyod: lag ma med par hab thob rol: dgyes bskang yi rang tshim gyur nas: brtul zhugs spyod pa mtharaphyin shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rga pa gagathapa bya ba'i rim pa ni phaṭa: dpang gyur skyabasamachego bla ma dang: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug la: gnasagasum ma dang mkha' 'gro'i sde thugasarjebartse bas dgongs su gsol: bdag ni 'khor tshe thog med nas: ma rig nyon shes sgrib dbang gis: so sor thar ba'i sdom pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang: gsangab sngags kyi dam tshig las: 'gal zhing nyams par gyur pa kun: mi 'chab mi sped gcig tu bsdums: gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags byin chad srog la bab kyangasdoms: dag tshangs sor chud mdzad du gsol: cas badzra satwa sa ma lā yi ge brgya pa dag par bzlasanasabashags lnga pa log 'khrul du tra bsgral ba ni 'gugasagazhug grang ldan byasal 'di skad do phaṭa

phaṭa phaṭa: ye shes lnga yi 'od slong nas: rigs lnga dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag ḍakki'i tshogs dang bcas: dbyings nasagazugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: rngamasabarjid khros pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: zhing bcu tshangs ba'i bdud sde dang: lta ba log pa'i du tra rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa dang: rnam shes skye med dbyings su drongs: sarba du tra zlo tri sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: drug pa sha khrag bstab pa 'i rim pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: nyon 'khrul dug lnga'i dgra bgegs rnams: bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched kyis: sku gsum ye shesalnga yi gdangs: tshad med las bzhi'i gar mkhan mo: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍakki ma: gtso 'khor bsam mi khyab pa yis sku gsung thugs mchog dgyes par 'bul: rmongs 'khrul 'khor ba stongs gyur cig ma hā me sa rakta tsitta la kha hi: bdun pa lhag ga' garṣa ba'i rim pa ni khrugasagam grangasaldan byasal 'di skad do phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa rdo dzeerigasakyi mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: zhe sdang dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag

ba tshu ḍakki'i tshogs dang bcas: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: nga rgyal dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag ḍakki'i tshogs dang bcas: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: 'dod chags dgra bgegs rdul du rlog0 las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag ḍakki'i tshogs dang bcas 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes phrag dog dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag ḍakki'i tshogs dang bcas: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: gti mug phrin las grub par mdzod: rdo rje rigs kyi sring mo bdun: yang sprul bsam mi khyab pa bcas: 'dir gshegs wag gtor mchod pa bzhes zhi ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: rin chen rigs kyi grogs mo bdun: yang sprul bsam mi khyab pa bcas: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: rgyasapa'i brin las grub gar mdzod: padma rigs kyi mdza' mo bdun yang sprul bsam gi khyab pa bcas: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: dbang gi phrin las grub par mdzod: las

rab rigs kyi bran mo bdun: yang sprul bsam mi khyab pa bcas: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: drag po'i phrin las grub par mdzod: sangs rgyasabastan pa bsrung mdzad pa'i ging lang ma bdun sring mo'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor mched pa bzhes: sgrub pa po yi phrin las sgrubs: dus la bab po sa ma yu: bka' gsang gnyan po srung mdzad pa'i: las mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol 'dod yon rgyan gyi tshogs lhag rol sha khrag dmar gyi tshogs lhag rol dam rdzas dpal gyi tshogs lhag rol: phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs lhag rol za kha sdang ba'i dgra la ston: mthu rtsal khyad chos bgegasal phob dam tshig ma g.yel sa ma yā: yaṣṭi ṭa bā ling ta khā hi: brgyad pa thugasadam gnad nas bskul ba ni hūṃ sbyo dmigasamed mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings: rang gsal lhun grub pho brang nas rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum kun tu bzang mo wa ra hi: khros ma nag mo seng ge'i gdong: sangs rgyas rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang rin chen padma las rab rigs dam tshig sha

ba tshu za mkha' 'gro rnams:thuṭa dam ma g.yel dbyings lasabaskul:sna tshogasagazugs sku'i cho 'phrul bsgyur:bstan pa'i dgra la rtag tu rngams:gser skyems mchod pa'adi bzhes la:phyi dgra zhing bcu tshang ba bzlog:nang dgra dam log slob ma sod gsang dgra gnyis 'dzin rū tra sgrol:mtha' dmag dus 'khrug rgud pa thul:phyogasalas rnamargyal snang ba stsol:bkra shis rdzogs ldan snang ba yis:sa gsum kun khyab phrin las mdzod:dusal bab po sam yā:cesabarjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegasapar bya dgu pa ra mdogastoba' ram pa na hū smyosngon tshe bar dang tha ma la:spyi dpal pad 'byung he ru ga'i spyan sngar khasablangasadam bcasapa'i:lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' chen brgyad:phyogasaskyong bcu dnga'ajigasabyed dgu:rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang rgyal chen sde bzhi g.yog 'khor bcas dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga dang:dug gi spu gri gza' bdud rgyal:nor ster klu dbangadagra sgog 'dren:las gshin sha khrag dmar la dgyes:bdud btsan nag po bstan dgra'i gshed ma mo nag mo rnal 'byer grogs dregs chen bco brgyad gtso 'khor

bcas sde dpon sum cu bstan pa'i bdag: ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs 'dod yon rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: chad don khas blangasadran par mdzod sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod: mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku tshe bsrings lta ba log pa'i bdud sde thul: zhing bcu tshang rnamasaming med mdzod: khyad par zab gsang rdor snying gi: bstan pa phyogs bcu'i pha mthar spel: smin grol gdams pa'i gru gzing tshugs: phyogs las rnam rgyal snang ba yis: sagasum kun khyab phrin lasamadzod: dusal bab po sam yā: bapa bam ma skyong ba'i risapani hūṃ bhyo: zab gsang bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin cing: bod khamasaskyong ba'i tha tshig can dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shan rta dpal: klu mo bde 'bar gzugs legs ma gong btsun de bum g.yu lcam btsun: gangs dkar sha med g.yar mo btsun: che zhes chen mo g.yog 'khor bcas lngab lngab mang po gron dang bcas: sil sman rol mo'i ska la dgongs: rnal

badzra 'byor dam la da tshur byon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la zab gsang bstan pa srung bar mdzod: sngon tshe bskal ba bzang po'i dus: a su ra yi brag phug zhu slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma rlang chen dpal seng gis zhing chen bkram pa'i gdan steng du: rakta'i thig le bkram nas su: bstan ma bcu gnyis mgron du bkugs: mgo la dam rtags rdo rje bcing: lce la dam tshig bdud rtsi bzhag: dbang bskur gsang ba'i mtshan yang btags: bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer kha gtad:mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i tha tshig bsgos: bsgrub pa po yi grogs su bzhag: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas lung bstan gnang khyed rnams gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: bshal chu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bod khams bde skyid ldan pa dang lta log mi stegs bstan pa bsnubs dus 'khrug ru 'dzing ngan pa bzlog: thuṭa dam ma g.yel sa ma yā:oṃ la la le le rta rta te te kha rag mo ma ma sring 'gro ma e dam bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: 'tsha ga rta bro brdu ba'i rim pa ni phaṭa: ye shesalnga yi 'od klong nas: rigs lnga'i dam

tshig 'dzin mdzad pa'i:'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma:gsang ba go po'i bro la bskul:gnyis rtog dbyings su gcod pa dang:log 'khrul dam sri 'byung po brub mnan no sku dang ye shesargya:ma ldang ldang med bro ra 'debs:rang grol chen po'i sathob shog:ma āX hūṃ swā snyatswa bha ya nan:mā ra ya nan:sa rdzirango bgo pa'i pho pani oṃ usnoskye mid masadabyingasaspros mtha' bral:'gags med bde klong rol ba nas sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i dbang dngos grub:bskur thob bral ba'i ye shesabacud sgrub mchog bdag la stsal du gsol:mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i tshad dam them:dngos grub stsol len dus la bab:thugs dam ma g.yel ye shes lha'i:mi gnas gnyug ma'i gsang gsum bcud byin rlabasamachog thun sirnyi hūṃ:rtsasngagasamathar kāmawākka tsitta sarba sirnyi sam ya oṃ ā hūṃ trī:ba sum gagasapa bya ba' ra pa ni nyadapang gyur ma dang mkha' 'go dbongs:bdag mi gsang chen smor 'a sa nas:rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig la:'gal 'a la nyams chags ci song yang:sming nas 'grod semasadag pos

ga tshu bshags: badzra sam ya bhi shuste āḥ yigabargyagagasu bzlasate lhag go bskangs babazhibasngo ba smon lamagadapapani to 'disamadzaX dusagasum bsagasapa'i dge pha ma'agro ba yongs la bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i ye gzhi'i sbubs: kun tu bzang po'i sathob shog: ga gsum lo lnga bsdu ldang bya ba'i rim pa na āḥ snang cha thabasasu shar ba'idakyil 'khor lha shes rab rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' ru bsdu: slar yang thugs rje'i rol rtsal 'gags med pa'i: 'gro 'dren sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod lam bya'o a sa phaṭa phaṭa rsādrug bsasha bya ba'i ram pa ni na mo smin grol byin rlabasa'abyung ba'i gnas: dngosagrub mchog gi nyi ma can dad ldan gdul bya'i lo thog smin: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shisashog dbang dang dngos grub kun gyi mdzod grub gnyis gru char ster mdzad cing: sgrub mchog nyams rtogasarab rgyas pa'i: yi dam rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: chosanyid ye dag mkha' dbyings su: thugasarje 'gro 'ong ltar 'phrul nas: dad ldan dga' bzhiX ye shes spel: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shisashog: dbyings la gnas kyang ye shesagar: legasanyes

ltang 'dzin pho nya ba: rgyal dbang padma'i tha tshig can: dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: ye dag brdal khyab stong pa che: rang gsal 'gags med zang thal gshis: rnam rgyal spyod pa gza' gtad bral: rang grol 'bras bu'i bkra shis thegag de ltar smon pasade 'brasayid bzhin 'grub dam tshag nyamasachagaganyes nga sor chud nas nyamasadang rtog pa'i yon tan gong 'phel 'gyur phyi nang bar chad bdud kyi gegasalas grol bden rdzunalag tu lo sa dang nges shes gsal baglu ba med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' sa ma yu mim rgyal ba'idabang po pa dma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongatha'agro la brtse ba chen po yis thugasakyi yang zab ti ga dmar nag 'di chosakyi mig gcig 'brog mi khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cig dgye sde mo mdo khamasartse shod gsham du dgong pra mdzod gter bdag bzang phyir klu bdud btsan la gnyer skal med lag tu ma shor srog bdag lnga ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul nga dang dbyer med dpa' bo ni 'jigs bral nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gya rnyed zab gsang bstan pa 'dzan srung spel bar byed las can sngagasanag ral khur bcugasum la spelanas rong chen bcu gsum chos kyis 'tsho smon log bdud sprul ma lu 'gum par byed gdul bya 'bum phrag rnga yab dpa' rir 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod basma ba

gtsam med do rdo rje padma'i bka' skal med lag tu ma shor ging dkar nag dam ldan thugs kyi srasadang 'phrad par shog sam yā rgya rgya rgya tshogs bsags gter gyi bum bzang bsod nams rdzogasapa'i ོnga chen rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu hya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pa dma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi sngag spyod chal rol chosabadag kun bzang dang /sngagasal mosapa 'itsab tsub dharma'i mtshan/sngags kyi phyogs mthong dharma kirti pa /sngagasal dad sgo'i chos nyid rang grol dang /sngagasaspyod rnal 'byor padma dbang ga sku/sngags kyi lde mig ratna sa ra yis/sngags mchog gtan la pha ba par ya ya bskul/sngags spyod rol ba'i rdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i brda/sngags rgya gab sbas med par legs pa ra phab/sngagasaglipa padma'i 'du khang ya mtshan che/sngags sgo ris su phab mtshan smon semasaso/sngags kyi bstan — rgyas pa' bkra shis shog/sarbam lam/

ba:tshu gsang sngags tshogs la rol ba ni ho: bde ba chen po'i tshogs ston 'di: lha dang bla ma'i dam tshig rdzas ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bzhes lhag ste dngos grub ya mtshan che ba'i skyes: gtsang sme'i rtog pa grol bar spyod: ho dpa' bo thabs kyi tshogs la rol dpa' mo shes rab tshogs la rol: bde stong tshim pa drug ldan gyis sngags gyi zlos gar bsgyur bzhin du: gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i: rdo rje rnal 'byor 'du ba yi: tshogs rton dhu ma tha la'i grong: mi shig dwangs ma lnga yi klong rang rig padma rgyal po'i drung:ye shes tshom bur 'khod pa dang: lhun grub 'khor lor longs spyod shog: ces rol bar bya'o: pa da lo dgyes phyir yo' phul/

( 'amatshu zab gsang rdo je snying po las ma cig khros ma nag mo'i bskang ba beeḍūrya'i chun 'phyang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:gas(: na mo dzñā na ḍasnyi ni ye sgorgarma ga /sgo dbying rig zung 'jug chos sku'i mkha' dbyi sa su lhun grub sku dang ye shes 'ub chub rol gnyis su med pa bde za gnyug ma'i gshis so ma rang chen pos phyag bgyi'o bdag 'dra rig 'dzan rdo rje gshog rgod ngas ma 'o sa skal bzang las can pho mo rnams gsang chen lam la spyod pa byed pa'i tsha nyam chags sbyang zhing tshogs gnya rdzogs pa'i thabs bskang ba beeḍārya' 'phyang bstan sa ma yu de ya phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'i rags ska bar 'osapa 'i rdza rnams kun bsagasate bsang sbyangs spel bsgyur ti nge 'ad na gyis 'phru' 'bul ca stob pa 'i rim pa 'di lta ste snyan pa 'i dbyadang rol mo' sgra bskul nas rnal 'byor lta spyod to 'dzan dag pa yisaḥhūṃ hrī:dmigasamed mkha' ltar ye dag kyang:spros bral ngang las ye shes sku:smra bsam brjod bral de bzhin thikun tu bzang mo'i thugs dam bskangs:rang grol rol ba 'gags med klong sku dang ye shes 'ub chub rol bde dang stong pa zung 'jug sku:rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam

bskangs: shar grol gnyis med zung 'jug ngang: ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar gnyis rtog rū tra yongs kyi gshed khros ma nag mo'i thugs dam bskangs dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes gar stong par rgyas 'debs bde ba'i yum gti mug rmongs pa'i 'gro ba 'dul sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs gsaladag rol ba chen po las sna tshogs ma 'dres so sor snang : zhe sda rad grol ngo bo nyid: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: 'khor 'das dag mnyam rol ba'igashis: thab chub bde rol rnam par dag: nga rgyal rang grol ye shes sku: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bska sa ma chags padma ra ga'i klong: gnyis rtog mtshan mamed pa'i gar 'dod chags rang grol gsung gsang 'dzin: padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: snang srid dag mnyam bde ba che: rang shar rang grol 'dzin pa med phrag dog dbyengs rgol mnyam pa nyid: las kyi mkha' 'go'i thags dam basmangs: chos nyid zhi zhing chags pa bral stong nyid sming rje'i rol ba las: tshad med lngags kyas

badzra: 'gro ba 'dul: zhi byed mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs rang grol sku dang ye shes rgyas: bde chen dag pa'i rol ba las: tshad med zhags pas 'gro ba 'dul: rgyas byed mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: ma chags padma'i gar 'dzin cing: bcu drug 'dzoms pa'i lang tsho ston: tshad med sgrog gis 'gro ba 'dul: dbang byed mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: las rnams mthar phyin phrin las 'grub: gdul bya'i yid kyi mun pa sel tshad med dril bus 'gro ba 'dul drags byed mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs mi 'gyur chos kyi dbyings nyid las gdug pa 'dul phyir srin mor khros dkar mo rnam rgyal sha za 'bum: 'khor dang bcas pa'i lang tsho ston: mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos kyang: sna tshogs gar gyis 'gro ba 'dul: ser mo tshe 'phel khrag gzhib 'bum: 'khor dang bcas pa'i lang tsho ston: bde chen thab chub rol pa las: gdug pa 'dul phyir gar bsgyur mkhas: dmar mo dbang sdud rkang ldag 'bum: 'khor dang bcas pa'i lang tsho ston: dag cing grol ba bde klong las

gnyis snang 'dul pa'i gar bsgyur mkhas: ljang mo dbugs len las byed 'bum: 'khor dang bcas pa'i lang tsho ston mi 'gyur chos nyid stong pa las gdul bya bdul zhing rnal 'byor skyongs rdo rje rigs kyi dbang phyug ma: sring mo bdun gyi thugs dam bskangs bde chen sku dang ye shes mdzod lhun grub rol ba chen po las: rin chen rigs kyi dbang phyug ma: grogs mo bdun gyi thugs dam bskangs: chags med pa dma'i gar bsgyur zhing: bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'gros la mkhas: padma rigs kyi dbang phyug ma: mdza' mo bdun gyi thugs dam bskangs dag mnyam gar bsgyur rol ba las: gdug pa 'dul zhing bstan pa skyongs las rab rigs kyi dbang phyug ma bran mo bdun gyi thugs dam bskangs: 'o mtsho rol bar dbang bsgyur zhing: 'dod rgu'i gru char 'bebs mdzad pa'i: klu yi rgyal po chen po ni: 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs: lcags mkhar dgu rim dbang bskyar zhing: bstan dgra'i srog len rnal 'byor sbongs: gshin rje ya ma ra tsa ni: 'khor dang bcas thugs dam bskangs: pha 'ong

ba tshu long bu'i sku mkhar nas: bstan pa srung ba'i pho nya ba: btsan rgyal sgog len nag po ni: 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs: mu le gting gi mtsho 'gram nas: bsgrub pa po yi sring gcig ma: ma mo rang byung rgyal mo ni: 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs: bka' gsang gnyan kyi pho brang nas bstan pa srung ba'i lha chen po: las byed ging chen dmar nag ni: 'khor dang bcas pa'i lang tsho ston: tha tshig gsang ba'i pho brab nas 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro dang: las mdzad dregs pa dam can ni bsam mi khyab pa'i thugs dam bskangs: gnyis med dbyings la gnyis su bzung: sgyu ma lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor 'gyed: khams gsum sems can thugs dam bskangs: las snang rgyu ba rang grol shog: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i grong 'dzin zhing: gnyis su snang ba'i log sbyor rgol: bgegs rigs 'byung po'i thugs dam bskangs gnyis snang rang sar grol gyur cig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dngos 'dzin sngo yisam bcos par phyi nang gsang gsum bkod pa yang: ye shes bdud rtsir rab dmigs

te: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bul: gha ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskangs: brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin shog: chen rtog 'dzin pa rnam dag pa'i: phung khamasaskye mched bkod pa yangs: ye shes bdud rtsir rab dmigs te: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyesaphyir 'bul gha ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskangs gzung 'dzin dbu mar zhig gyur cig: rlung sems dag pa chen po las gang shar sems rtog bkod pa yang: ye shes bdud rtsir rab dmigs te: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bul: gha ṇa tsakras thugs dam bska sa: zang thal dgongs pa mngon gyur cig phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bdag gisatshogasachen bsags pa'i mthus: ja ma'i thugs dgongasardzogasagyur cig yi dam lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes gyur cig dam can srung ma bskang gyur cig: lan chags bu lon byang gyur cig 'gro ba rigs drug tshim gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stong gyur cig 'bras bu sma gsum thob grur cig phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de ltar dmigasa'adun rnam pa ra dag pa yas rmad byu bskang bzab mogand smin na dam tshag

btsa( nyams chags nyes lhung sor chud nas dbang da byan rlabs dngos grub thob par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje pa dma'i bka' bden rdzun lag tu longasadang nge shesagasal skalamed gnasasu ma shor i tham rgya samayā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa dma saṃ lha wa'i ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis srog da 'dra ba'i yas tig dmar byung ba 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la gtad rgyas sbyin da lta spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cigadagyes sde mo mdo khams dpal gyi rdzo sa der dgongs pra mdzod gter bdag bzang phyir srog bdag bzhi la gnyer thub pa ra srungs shag badzra sa ma yu skal med lag tu ma shor tha tshag can ma 'ongasasnyagasam sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa la pa'i tshe nga sprul da mi gzhan dpa 'a bo na 'ari gas bral nus lda na 'dus pa rtsal gyis rnyed bstan da 'gro la phan bde'i nyi ma spel sngagasanag ral khur skyes bu bcu gsum la zab gsangabacud kyi snyi khu 'di gtad nas rong chen bcu gsum bstan pa'i dpal du 'dud gdul bya 'bum phrag rang grol rgyal sa zin 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod ze tshom mi dgosardo rje padma'i bka' gdamasabacud zagasasu mashor gi dkar nag nga sprul thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bskang ba beeḍūrya'i chun 'phyang zhesabya ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan rgya slob dpon padma bha

wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar za bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi chagasamed sbasapa'i rnal 'byor pad chosadang /chagasartog dbumar grol ba'i kun bzang ba/chagasabral dga' bzhi'i ro spyod padma dbang /chagasartog bayothabasagacod pa'i chosagragasadang /chagasapang mda' mo bral ba'i rang gro ba/chags pa dga' bzhi'i 'byung khung rasgo'iming /chags med dad mo gdung ba'i bskul ngor du/chags spyod bde ba'i rnal 'byoraspyo ldan pas/chagasabralamakha' 'gro 'du ba'i dga' tshal gyi/chags pa mi dmigs bkra shisasmid tshal nas/chags rtog rdzo yis bsre bslad ma byasapar/chags med mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab mo pha ba/chad dang lhag chad bral ba'i yi ge pa/chagasagrolapadma dbang chen gyis bgyis pa sa/chags 'khrul 'gro khams dongs sprugs nus par shogasarba ma lam/

0〈tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: ma cig khros ma nag mo'i gter srung gi bskang ba phrin las lhun 'grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye rtenab tsāsmogratha34 rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa 'i yum so so rang rig ye shes sku 'du 'bral dmags su med pa'i dbyings mngon gsum mthong bas phyag 'tsham lo ma 'angasalasaldan pho mo rnams gsang chen lam la zhugasapa 'i tshe tshogs rdzogasasgrib pa sbyongasaba'i phyar ga ṇa tsakra'i 'khor lo bstan sam yu de yang dam can rgya mtsho rnams bskang ba'i phrin lasalhun gyis grub de phyir gnad 'di gcesapa ra zu sa snyan pa'i dbyang sa dang 4sa nas su hūṃ hrīX gzhi dbyingasaskye ba med pa'i mkha' dbyings su: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod sprin gtings: bde stong ye shes 'od zer 'khrigasapa yi: rtsa gsum dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskangs: dge legs 'dod 'byung dpal 'phel bum pa bzang skye rgu'i gsos gyur sgrub mchog yongs kyi mgon: rnam mngagater mdzod gyur ba ye shes sku klu rgyal bsod nams dpal spel drag rtsal sprul pa srid pa gsum na spa: legs nyes ltang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing: dam ldan

bsgrub pa po yi mgon gcig pu: gshin rje ya ma ra tsa'i myur mgyogs stobs rtsal bar snang glog las che: gdug pa bstan dgra'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: zab gsang stanapa srung ba'i pho nya ba: bdud 'dul btsan rgyal nag po'i thugs dam bskangs: byang shar mu le mthing mtshor mnga' mdzad cing: gsang sngags 'bum phrag rgyud kyi nyer 'dzinam mthu nus drag rtsal bsam mi khyab pa'i gar: dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo'i bdud dang klu mo bsgos pa'i sras gcig pu: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde'i zhi zhing bcu'i sha la za ba'i dam tshig can: drang srong smug nag 'od 'phros pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ri la gnas shing: dus 'khrug nad yam rgol ba 'joms byed pa'i sangs sabastan pa'i mdzod 'dzin tha tshig can: sngags bdag bdud 'dul nag po'i me rlung 'tshubs ma chen po'i klong dkyil nas: bstan pa srung zhing bstan dgra'i sgog joms pa zhing bcu'i sha la za ba'i tha tshig can btsan dmar me yi phreng ba'i stong gsum gla yi yul la dbang mdzad cing: o rgyan chen po'i tha tshig la gnas nas: zab gter srung

badzra zhing nyams pa'i dgra sha rol dbang chen klu yi rgyal po'i chags bral bde ba chen po'i ye shes gar: mi rtog don ston 'gro jo bde la spyor zab gsang chos kyi nyi mo ngas la brdal: badzra ging ka ra yi gtum la gdug sems 'chang zhing ngo bo dag log 'khrul pho mo sgrol ba'i lam gyi 'dren: gsang jags bstan pa 'dzin pa'i pho nya gar: kro ta ging ka ra yi dbyings la gnas kyang ye shes gar bsgyur bas: rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel mi mthun rgol ba'i la yog 'joms mdzad pa'i bstan nga ma can rgya mtsho'i rdo rje'i rigs sgrub pho nya dam can rnams: rnal 'byor gsang ba'i glu la dgyes dgongs 'tshal: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskangs: rnal 'byor lta spyod dag pa'i lha sngags ting 'dzin gsal bas brda glu gar gyi sgra yis phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i skyems kyis dza gad a mṛ tais mang sa tsitta bsgreng bas 'dod yon bsam mi khyab pas dgyes bskang phrin las kun 'byub bdud las rgyal: zab gsang bstan pa phyogs bcur dar rgyas

mdzod rngams shing 'khu ba'i snying khrag drungs nas 'byen: log sbyor bdud sde dpa' rkong ming med mdzod drag rtsal che ba'i khyad chos ston re ran: mthu rtsal g.yel na khyod brten 'bras bu chung: dam tshig ldan rnams khas jangs ma g.yel bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i brin las grub par mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod tshogasaskyemasagatsang sar mchod par bya phrin lasagang bcol thogasamed 'grub par 'gyur byin rlabasarjo nusaga' la khyang par 'phags bden rdzur lag tu longasadang nges shes gsal sam pā e ma rgyal ba'i ngabang popadma sobha wa' ma 'ongaba'agro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi yang bas gdams zab rmad byung ba 'aprog mi lo tsā khye'u chung khyod la gto da lta ma spel rin chen bdo la thob mdo khamasartse shod gsham du dgong pra mdzod ma 'ongasasnyigasam sum cu kha ral dus sprul dpa' bo 'jag bral 'dus pa rtsal gang gsarnyed nasabastad 'gro'i phan bde spel lasacan chosabadag ral khur bcu gsum la bstan nasarong chen bcugasum smin grolabyed bdud tshogasa'ajom shing la ldan bye ba 'dren 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod sam mā rgya rgya rgya gter sru bskang ba phrin lasastun grub rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasagro zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob

badzralhozab gsang rdo rje snying po las:ma cig khros ma nag mo'i dgos chos gnam phud gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍasnyi ni ye: tha ga spyosnangagadedanathami shig spros mtha' bral lhan skyas sku dang ye shes mdzod zang thal mnyam pa nyad kyi gshis so ma rang grol ngang nas 'dud bdag 'dra padma saṃ bha pa' ma'ongasalas ldan don phyar du gdul dka' 'dul mdzad khrosam yi nyams len gsang ba' mthil gcig bkod de ya cha lag zab mo bstan sa ma yā de yang nadral rka gling dang snyan pa' sgra yasabaskul byasate phaṭa:rang snang mi shigs dag pa'i dbyings:mkha' spyod bde ba chen po' zhing:zang thal rol ba'i pho brang nas:dbyings gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khoralor gshegs tsa ri pad ri padma 'od:bkra shis rdzongs sogs 'dzam gling gi:sa spyod mkha' spyod pho brang nas:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ḍakki'i tshogs 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:ska la rdzogs dang padma brtsegs:'jigs byed tshal dang bde chen rol:dur khrod brgyad du brten bcas pa'i dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma:'du

ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs gnas dang nye ba'i gnas mchog dang chos nye ba'i tshandho sogs he ru ka yi gnas bcu nas:dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs dza lan dha ra pulli ra:karnyi ka dang hi ma la:nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas:dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma 'du ba tshogs kyi'akhor lor gshegs gsang ba brda shod sham bha la padma brtsegs thang 'du ba'i ljongs:yul chen sum bcu so gnyis nas:dpa 'a bo dab ni rnal 'byor ma:'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs:zod rnga snyan pa'i sgra la dgongs:stong nyid dril bu'i rang sgras bskul:rnal 'byor mos gus gdung bas 'bod:snyan pa'i glu dang gar la rol:sngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel bar:'byor ldan lasakyi tshogs 'khor dang:dga' ston lha mi'i bkod pa rdzogs bsgrub mchog pho mo dam re gtsang:tha tshig ma g.yel sman 'dren gshegs:'dod yon longs sprod tshogs su rol:ska gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs:rtsa rlang thig le nyams pa bshags:sdom gsum dam 'gal

gtsa( dri ma 'chags:sor chud tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol:rnal 'byer bdag cag bsgrub mchog la:nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol:dben khrod 'grim pa'i 'tsho ba sbyor:sa dang lam gyi bar chad sol:blo sna dam pa'i chos la bsgyur:'dun phug phyi ma'i don 'grub cing:mi ldog gdod ma'i sa ru skyol 'pho chen dwangs ma'i 'ja' sku mchog:tshe 'dir 'grub par mdzad pa dang:nang gsal gzhen nu bum sku'i sbubs:ka dag dang po'i sa thob shog:ces brjod tshogasaskyemasagatsang sar mja ga yol phrinalas thogs med 'grub phyi na bar 'ad bdud las rgyal nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel bar nge sa the tshom med do rdo rje' bka' ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis ya nga zab gdamasapa srog thig dmar nag skor chos kyi mig gcig 'brog mi khyod la gtad da du spel ba' dus la ma bab pa sa rin chen brda la thob cag dgyes gye mo mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgo sa bra mdzod gter bdag bza phyir klu bdud btsan la gnyer gdamasabacud thub pa ra gyis shig srog bdag lnga ma 'o sa snyigasam sum cu kha ral dus sprul dpa 'a bo nus lan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas stan pa rin chen 'dzan skyo saspel sngags nag ral khur skyes bu — — —— — ba ོ — — — —— — — — ོ — — ོ ོ tsho — — ོ — — — —tsho — —— —— — — —— ——

bcu gsum la rang skal dpal gyi rong chen bcu gsum 'dul gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min dpal rir 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod yad gnyisami dgosardo rje lta bu'i bka' zab gsang zagasasu ma 'jugaging dkar nag las ldan thugasakyi gras da 'phrad pa ra shog sam mā rgya rgya rgya gnasayul srung ma'i bskangasab phrin la lhun grub rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya brda thim o rgyan gyi slob dponapadma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o gu rgya snyi dad ldan sngags nag kun bzang dgyesabaskang phyar/ dad dam mi 'gyur nu ldan rdo rje yis/ dad rten 'gro ba'i dpa la du zab gsang phab/ dad mosa'abyor bapadma'i ming gis bris/ dge'o legs so sarba masgo lam/
badzra cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po'i zab sgrub bsam 'phel nor bu bzhugs so:

btsaX na 31 dzñā na ḍakki ni ye sgori sgyu/cha ma 'gyur chos dbyings 'dusam byas lhan skyes sku dang ye shesamadzod bsal bzhag bral ba gnyug ma' ga sa rang ngo shesapasaphyag 'tshal lo ma'ongs snyigasam lnga yi dus gsang chen rdo rje theg pa' lam spyod pa 'a skal bza re mchagan de yi dab skal snying po' chos med byung khrosama'i sgrub skor bstan sa ma yu de nyid lhur len byed pa yi skal bzang skyes bu' rkyenabasgrog cing mthun skyen 'dod rgu'i gte 'phel phyir lu rgyal mi mgon dkar ro yi zab sgrub bsam 'phel nor bu bstan sam rwa de yang sgrub — ra bya ba la bla rdo sgog 'khor gces pa ra zu sa dam tshag sdom pa gnad du 'chongs mja sa yo byad rgya za bsags sha khrag 'thab mkhon gsur gzhob spa :khrus da gtsang sbra jon du garṣa ra nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis hūṃ trīḥrang mdun 'ja' 'od gur khang 'khrigs pa'i dbus bayolas 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'byil klong du:'dod 'byung ratna 'bar ba'i gter gyi dbus:naḥlas byung ba'i klu yi rgyal po ni:'dod 'byung mtha' yas beeḍūr lhun po'i mdangs:zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum sgeg lang tsho 'bar:ratra'i rtse phran dar dpyangs nor bu'i phreng:ka mud thod chen sbral gyi gdengs ka spad phyag zhabs gad

btsarnya bu ratna'i mig dang ldan: sku smad sbrul mjug ser khra g.yas su 'byil phyag g.yas lcags kyus srid gsum blo yid 'gugs: g.yon pa nor bus dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs gnas lngar klu rgyal chen po rigs lnga dang: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nā ga mched brgyad rdzogs mtha' 'khor stong gsum sa bdag klu gnyan dang:gtod rigs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor rang srog naḥlas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas: gar bzhugs bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: klu rgyal gtso 'khor dpon g.yog dpung dang bcas: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs te: bskyed pa'i lha dang sgrub rdzas rnams la bstems: rang sgog 'od kyis mdun bskyed thugs rgyud bskul: ci bcol bka' nyan phrin las sgrub pa dad : 'dod rgu'i longs spyod char chen 'bebs par dmigs: slo nā ga ra tsa sa ma ya pho dza ci khrub brngo da la 'bod par bya ba da o na ga ra tsa sa ma ya pho dza: sdang ba'i dgra bo la rbad: rbad rtagasabyu bar yas ya bzla ba dang oṃ na ga ra tsa sa ma yā pho dza: snang ba'i dgra bo la kla nad mdze gram thongs shig: bsad

pa las kyi 'byul 'khor dmigs pas phyeḥ skabasasu gsol mchod brgya stong khri 'bum bskyal de nas g.ya 'gugs bya ba'i rim ba ni bzang drug 'o ma bu sur dkar nya brid dang klu shang bra ma'i bas gdud dpung chen bta sngagasadang phyag rgya dag gisabyin gyisabarlabs snyan pa'i dbyangasadang bcas te 'di skad doḥ ba13 dad dang dam chig gnyan pos rgyud bskul nas: ma thogs klu yi rgyal po spyan 'dren gshegs: sgrubardzas bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs ja phud dkar mngar skyems kyi mchod pa dang: bdud rtsi bsang gi dud sprin mtha' yas pas klu yi rgyal po gtsug na rin chen dang stobs ldan 'od mtha' yas dang mi mgon dkar rig ldan nor rgyas 'jog po wa ri ṇa padma drang sgong kun bkod padma che: rgyal rje dmang dang bram ze'u gdol ba'i rigs 'dzam gling chu mtsho ldeng kha chu mig dang: rlan dang bsil la rten bcas klu yi rigs dpon g.yog 'khor bcas gnyan gtod sa bdag rnams: bdud rtsi 'dod yon mchod pas dgyes pa bskangs: sku la gzi 'bar bkrag mdangs nus stobs rgyas: gsung la gzi 'bar tig skugs 'gag pa bral thugs la gzi 'bar byams brtse'i 'od stong

ba rte rgyas: yon tan phrin las nus stobs bsam mi khyab: ldan te bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub po la: 'tsho ba zas kyi phywa g.yang char ltar phob: yangs srab reg bya'i phywa g.yang dam pa stsol: 'khrugs med chos dang mthun pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: 'gro blo dbang du sdud pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: snyan grags pha mthar khyab pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: bkra shis sgrub mthar phyin pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: gdul bya chos la 'god pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde ba'i phywa g.yang stsol: nad med lang tsho dar ba'i phywa g.yang stsol: mug bral 'byor ba phun tshogs phywa g.yang stsol: 'khrug zhi dga' bde spyod pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: phan bde'i phywa g.yang sarba sirnyi hūṃ: khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson las 'gro khams grol 'og min dpal gyi ri bor 'god pa yi: mdzad pa rmad byung dpal la dbang thob shog: brgyastong la sogasaci khrub yang yang brjod gnad desabasod nam lo saspyodadapal 'phel 'gyur sam yā skabasasu zhi bskul char 'bebs bya ba la bzang drug klu sman bsres pas 'o chab mchod gza' skar phun tshogasachugs mig la brten te ting ting sgra bcasasnyan pa'i 'di skad do na ga phuḥ mtha'

mas rgya mtsho chen po dang: bag shu ma dang sintu dang na ra dze na snyug ma can: grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi la sogs: stong gsum 'dzam gling khams brten pas: klu rgyal na pon g.yog 'khor dang bcas: ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol dkar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang: mngar gsum sman gyi mchod pa 'bul klu rnams mdangs na nga ldan gyur cig klu rnams mdangs dang ldan nas kyang skye rgu'i gsos sman 'bru 'phel byir rgya mtsho'i gting nas na bun slong: bar snang sprin gyi khyab pa dang: 'dzad med char rgyun rab rgyas nas: dmigs pa'i yul khams bde rgyas mdzod: sad dang ser ba'i g.yul ngo zhi: btsa' than 'bu srin lo nad zhi phun sum tshogs pa'i dngosagrub rnams nub pa med par stsal du gsol: nā ga phum bam bam 'dus 'dusasarba arsha ta re ā na gaste tram̐ swā snya brgya stong lasogasabazla bar bya 'o masaphyogasabargyar bkram par bya kand des ra chen 'bebs par 'gyur ze tshom med do sa ma yu de nas drag bskul bya ba ni gtor skyemasadagra bo'i sha khrag dmigs 'gugasagazhugasabyasal byin gyisabarlabs rol mo'i sgra bcasa'adi skad do ྅ bye rgyal

ba tshu dbang padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang tha tshig la gnas pa'i klu rgyal dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas drag tu bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs: bstan 'a'atshe ba'i dgra bgegs dang rnal 'byor tshe srog la rgol rnams: pho rgyud skyes pa rtsad nas chod: mo rgyud bud med mngal nas skoms: chung gsum lhugs phran brngas bachisathong: dgra sha zo la dgra khrag 'thung dgra snying byung la dgra rus mur ming tsam med par rdul du rlog brngan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la phung 'byed than dgu dbral 'phrul: nad mtshon dug gi char chen phob gsang sngags che ba'i khyad chos ston: rnal 'byor sgrub pa chud ma gsan: chos skyong med dam ram mdar rlog ma g.yel 3'gyeng dam tshig can: dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ sa nā ga ra tsa sa ma ya cho cho: rgyug rgyug bring bring: tshar tshar: thog thog: shag shag yal yal: dgra bo a mu ga'i tshe rbad rus pa hab: srog la rdzub: ma tri dum bu tri ka dza che ge mo la shag rbad: brgya sto la sogs brjod pa'i tshe dgra dpu pha lam yin kya 'jig rno nus myur mgyogs thog las che phyin rnyabs

ya mtshan khyad par 'pha gas bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grim dang mthong the tshom mi dgos rdo rje'i bka' sam mā ye ma rgyalaba'idabang po padma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'o sa'agro la thugasarje brtseb yis snying gi ya bcud gdams pa zab pa'i skor 'brog mi lo tsā chos mdzod 'dzin la gtad da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pa'i rin chen brda la thob cig sar phyo ma 'ong bstan pa'i 'byor sgud skyob pa'i phyir mdo khamasardo rje' rdzob du dgongs ba sdoms ma 'o snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng ba ling ba'i tshe nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i pha ra bde spel rong chen bcugasum chos kyi lam la 'god ral khur bcu gsum bka' 'di'i bdag po ra 'byung rgud 'joms 'gro ba 'dul ba'i rten 'brel yod zab bcud thub pa ra srungs shig srog bdag lnga skal log lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum bya ra mel rtse mdzod cig king dkar nag sam yu rgya rgya rgya klu yi zab sgrub bsam 'phel nor bu rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sabha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza bkod pa'o brda thim ñtsā ces pa 'di 'a chos bdag dharma dang kun bzang gnyis kyis sgrub pa 'di thabs chags che bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa la ni khong rnam gnyas yang rab yan gsung nas yang yang bskul ngor/ bdag 'dradapa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes
gtsarsha mkha' 'tsho brda dag par phab pa'i ya ge pa ni slob bu smon sems kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:bstan srung klu rgyal chen po'i gsol mchod dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so:

gtsa( na mo dzñā na ḍākki ni ye: canasga sgo chadad dam ldan pa' rnal 'byor gyas bstan srung sgrub par bya ba'i tshe med mi rung ba'i cha lags su gsol mja dgosa'adod kun lung bstan sam mā de yangadakar gtor 'o phud bshams bsangasasbyang byin gyi brlabs na slar rang sko lha yi — rgyal gyi rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangasabacasate (3 dad dang dam tshig gnyan po'i mthu ldan pa'i 'bod do klu yi rgyalapo 'od mtha' yas rigs lnga klu chen brgyad po g.yog 'khor bcas: ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: bla rdo sgog 'khor rten la brten parabazhugs: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: dbul sel 'dod 'byung nor bur mnga' gsol lo gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra bcas rnam par bstod: bkrashis rdzas rtag rgyal srid rnam pa bdun: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon rnam pa lnga: dkar gsum 'o phud mngar gsum sman gyi rigs: zla rgyas zla phrum rin chen brdar ba'istems 'dod yon mchod smin ma tshang med pa'i gter: mig 'phrul lta bu'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas: bstan mong kla yi rgyal po gsol zhing mchod: grol rigs kla yi

tshogs rnams gsol zhing mchod: rje rigs nā ga'i sde tshogs gsol zhing mchod: dmab rigs dbul ba sel rnams gsol zhing mchod: bram ze'u chags med ra gsol zhing mchod: gdol ba sha zan klu rnams gsol zhing mchod: mtha' yas stobs rgyas 'jog po gsol zhing mchod: nor rgyas rig ldan padma gsol zhing kun bkod padma chen po gsol zhing mchod klu rigs dpon g.yog 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod: sa bdag gnyan gtod tshogs rnams gsol zhing mchod sa gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyi: phyi ru rgyal khams dmag 'khrug mu ge sol nang du rnal 'byor nad gdon rgud tshogs thul gsang ba rlung sems ting yel ba bzlog dpal 'byor nus stobs yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas bsnyen sgrub chos mthun bya ba mthar phyin nas: zas jor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i gru char gyis nga khams kun mer mer gang bar mdzod ste rgu'i gsos gyur chags sdang kun bral nas chos sprod 'khor ba'i g.yul las rab rgyal te kun bzang padma'i zhabs

drung 11la bar mjordod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā ces brjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs gnad des phrin las ga bcol 'grub nyams rtogs yar ngo' zla ltar 'phel sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'byor bar nges: the tshom med do sam mā rgyal dbang padma'i thugasabam 'di 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la sbyin ma 'ongasobastan pa 'dzin pa'i phyir nus ldan rdo rje'i dpal du shog bstan pa'i 'gro don gong 'phel phyar: chosabadag lasacan rnam dang 'phrad bshad sgrub bstan pa 'i ba dan bsgreng gdamasabacud ma zag srog bdag lnga skal med la sdom sgru gra gsum thub pa ra mdzod cig rki dkar nag sayoyā rgya rgya rgya gsol mchod dgosa'adod kun 'byung rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab spo gsang rgya gu hya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa dma /bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa 'o brda thim snyi cesapa 'ad ya chosabadag dharma sngagasanag kun bzang ratā sarasogs kyis bskul ro ra/ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nu ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo las zhal bshus te gnas mchog smar gyi spen ma'i rna rdzo rdza da spang gi dben khrod nas dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos nyid rang grol gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/

ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bstan srung las gshin nag po'i zab sgrub dug khrag khol ma bzhugs so:gtsakhro na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye smosgo sgyusga bdag 'dra pa dma saṃ bha was ma 'o salas ldan don phyar du bstan srung las gshan nag po ya zab sgrub dug khrag khol ma bstan sa ma rwa de ya bla rdo srog 'khor dang gsang thod srog gi rten rdzas can da la' dbus bkod nyer spyod bkram ra nyad la yi nga rgyal gyas khrus dang gtsa sbra sngon du gtong de nas rol mo' sgra bcas te snyan pa' dbyangasakyisa'adi skad do hū bye rang mdun dug rlung 'tshubs ma 'byil ba'i klong:rakta rba rlabs 'khrigs pa'i dkyil dbus su:ma he glang rgod shin tu 'jigs pa'i steng:las gshin nag po char sprin lhun po'i mdangs:ma he'i gdong can spyan gsum mkha' la gzigs:zhal gdangs rngams pa'i ha he'i gad rgyang sgrogs glog dmar ljags 'dril drag po'i skan sgra ldeb:g.yas g.yon rwa las me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro:phyag g.yas tho chen nam mkha'i dbyings la phyar:g.yon pas bsngan dgra'i tsitā zhal da 'dren:rab 'jigs rngams brjid gyad

stabs rol ba'i brdzis: stag sham rus rgyan dar dpyangs glog gis brgyan las byed mched brgyad 'khor du rnam par 'dud: sku mdog phya mtshan cha lugs ma ngeye shes me dang dud sprin 'khrigs klong bskyed: thugs sgog yi ge nyid las 'od 'phros pas gar bzhugs gnas nas bskyed pa'i ye shes pa: spyan drangs gnyisame pa'i lha la bstim: rgyal bstan nub med srub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: rmad byung a ti'i bstan srung mnga' gsol lo snang srid ro mnyam chen pos phyag 'tshal bstod bskyed nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga sman gtor rakta dgra bo'i sha khrag rus: srog dbugs skye mched phung khams ma lus dang: ja chang skyems phud dmar gyi bayis gsol lo mchod do sku gsung thugs mchog bskangs: dgyes pa chen po'i rnal 'byor phrin las sgrubs bstan pa'i dgra sde ming tsam med par mdzod: bdagayi thags ba'i sags pheng bi: 'od rkye bsal ce sang ma'i smog phring 'thog: jal 'bor bdag si bka' la zhen par bsam: cha ya ma ra tsa: sa rta me ya: ya me rta ri

gas/: ya kṣe ya ka la ru pa sa ma ya dza: brgya stong la sogasabarjod la 'bod par bya 61 ya ma ra tsa: satwa me ya: ya me twa ri na: ra ya kṣe ya ka la ru pa dgra bgegs gnod byed larbad rbad: rbad pa'i la rim ci 'grub yang yang brjod skyid ya ma ra tsa: sa twa me ya: ya me twa ru na: ra ya kṣe ya ka la ru pa dgra bo rnyermo khung thum sod: bsad pa lasakyi spu gri ca 'grub brjod skabs 'dir gsol mchod brgya sto la sogasabaskyal de nas dgra bo khram la 'debs pa ni dgra bo' gegs bdud gza' skar phung dgu' nyad lca ma'i byang bu sor bzhe dri bral la sprul nag khrag dang byi la'i rakta yis dmigs byasaming rusamakhan gsum bris pa'i mthar dmod ni brjod la gshin khram da bram 'god bswo dus gsum sangs rgyas gzu dang dpang: yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang: ma dang mkha' 'gro gzu dang dpang: chos skyong srung ma gzu dang dpang khyad par las gshin gzu dang dpang: bka' nyan mched brgyad gzu dang dpang 'khor tshogs bsam yas gzu dang dpang:brngan pa'i skyems phud 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor sgrub po'i dmod 'di bsgrub kyeḥ bdag gi dka' ba dang blang nas rtse gcig snying po'i sgrub tshugs bzung: bsnyen sgrub
