lhur blang brtson 'grus bskyed: yi dam khros ma nag mo bsgoms: chos skyong khyod nyid grogs su brten: rang don bor zhing gzhan don bsgrubs: sems bskyed ya mtshan tshangan yang: dam nyams dgra bo rnye mo'i: legs su ma ster nyes su rgol: mi 'dod 'tshubs ma sprin ltar ldang rnal 'byor tshe bsod sgog la bab nyesasbyor de dag ma bzodanas chos skyong khyed nyid las la rbad: nyes byed dgra bo che ge mo'i: bla tshe bsod nams bcas pa kun: las gshin ging kibhe dmar nag gis: gshin rje'i khram la da thob cig: 'chor med btsan khram la thob cig0 'khrug med bdud kyi khram la da thob cig ldog med ma mo'i khram la da thob cig: g.yo med gza' yi khram la da thob cig ldang med klu yi khram la da thob cig: 'jug med lha yi khram la da thob cig 'bogs brgyal rgyal po'i khram la da thob cig: tshe ni khram thob nyil nyil skem: srog ni khram thob rbad rbad chod: bsod nams khram thob 'ub 'ub bsnabs kha rje khram thob yal yal gtor: dbang thang khram thob sur sur sgems: rlang rta khram thob nag

badzra nur bsnubs:ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod dgra sha zo la dgra khrag 'thung:dgra snying byung la dgra rus mur:dgra bo me stag chu 'phrad bzhin:ming tsam med par rdul du rlog:drag rtsal khyad chos da ston cig:au ya ma ra tsa sa twa me:ya me twa ru ṇa:ra ya kṣe ya:ya kṣe ya tsa shra ka la ru pa sarba tipho a pa ye:rgyug rgyug:bring bring shag shag:zung zung:phyung phyung:mig rtsa gcus:tshe srog gtub:citta shag:brla la rbad lus ngag yid gsum khram la thob: dzo 2 450brgya stongal sogs brjod bgo du dgra bo gshin rje khram la 'debs de nas lo zla' zad ma sasu chu 'am me la gto byasate gong gas dmod mjug bsgyur kha dpa ga dason dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur the tshom med do sam yu skabasasu drag bskul bya ba na dmar gtor bshamasal 'gugasagazhugs garṣa da bsgragathaca rngamasapa' sgras hūṃ bhyo:lho phyogs lcags mkhar dgu rim nas las gshin ya ma ra tsa ni 'jigs byed glang po'i gdong pa can gshin rje 'khor tshogs 'bum 'bum bcas:ma thogs myur du thugs dam bskul:mi ro rta ro bsnol steng nas:rlung las mgyogs pa'i bang

rtsal gyis: cho cho rgyug rgyug dgra la rbad: hab hab rngams pa'i dgra snying gtub: bdag la brnag pa'i rnye lnga phu nu nye ba gza' 'khor dang: phyugs 'apangs yul khams bcas pa kun 'jigs byed khyod kyi lto bar bstabs ma zad bar du ljib sdib zo: dus mtha' bstung la ming med mdzod drag rtsal che ba'i khyad chosaston dus la bab po sa ma yā: yi ye: zhus zhur: thig thig: 'jigs byed nā ga ra tsa 'khor dang bcas pa dgra la rbad rbad bka' dang dam tshig la gnas shing mthu dang nusapa yod na da rgyugs shig: cesabaskul dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur skabasasu 'byugasabaskang byed dgos na skyem gtor dpung ldan bsag byasate bsang sbyang byin gyithabarlabasanas slar rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis hūṃ ju 'jam dpal ya marnya ga'i bka' nyan pa las gshin 'khor tshogs sprul ba g.yog dang bcas ma thogs 'dir gshegs dam tshig rten la bzhugs: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la 'khru ldog khro gsags nam yang mi mdzad par zhi zhing byams brtses phrin las rab 'byams sgrabs: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yu:

pa rte brgya stong la sog ci 'grub brjod gnad des ldog pa'i g.yul lasargyal byams brtse'i pha ma bu bzhin skyong the tshom med do sam mā e ma rgyal ba'i dab po padma se bha wa'i ma 'ong 'gro la thugasarje chen poyis bstan srung sgrub pa'i drag sngag la mtha' rnams skal bzang skye pa'i srog gi srung ma 'di grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog mi khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cig sar phyo snyigasama'ind mtshon rgud pa gsoba'i phyir mdo khamasardo rje'i rdzong la dgongasapra thob ma 'ongasosnyigasam sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nasachosabadag ral khur bcugasum la gtad de bstan pa rin chena'adzan skyong spel rong chen bcu gsum chos kyi lam la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod zab gsang thub par srungasashig srog bdag lnga skal med lag tu ma shor spu gra gsum bya ra mel rtse mag laking dkaranag dam ldan thugasakyi srasadang 'phrad par shog sam yu rgya rgya rgya lasagashin gyi zab sgrub dug khrag khol ma rdzog so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma minyi wa'i bga' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa'i bstan srung drag sngags bka' rgya can/ da dung mi spel re zhig bsdamasasnyam yang / chosabadagakun bzang dharma rnam gnyagakyis/ mi smra kha med mgo bo'i btsog na bskul

bri kyang snod kha btsang skyad yan bsam shor/ bsnyen sgrub lhur len nusan ngo mtshar che phab rgyu phongs zer sgrub 'bra nga ma mthong / brtson pa'i snying po longasashig slob bu rnams/ g.yo sgyu med panu ldan rdo rje'i smras/ ye ge'i ri byedaslob busan sem so/ dge'o legs so sarba maṅka lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung las gshin nag po'i gsol mchod dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i spu gri bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍākki na ye rja lcasnaldasgo dad dam ldan pa 'i rnal 'byar gyas 'byor tshogathayod byad ga 'os bsags bsangs sbyang sa byin gyi bams byas te rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis hūṃ bhyoḥ dzha phyogs 'jigs rung dud sprin 'tshubs ma'i klong: gru gsum lcags mkhar dgu rum 'bar ba nas: las gshin ya ma ra tsa gtso 'khor bcas: ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: bla rdo srog 'khor rten la brten par bzhugs: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: bdud 'dul rgyal po'i pho nyar mnga' gsol lo: lha sngags ting 'dzin dag pas phyag 'tshal bstod dgyes bskyed dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: phyi nang gsang mchod bkra shis rdzas rtag dang: rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod: ma tshang med pa mig 'bral lnga bu'i gnyer: kun tu bzang po'i rol bar byin rwabs pas las gshin ya ma ra tsa gsol zhing mchod: bka'

nyan las mdzad mched brgyad gsol zhing mchod:sprul 'khor bsam mi khyab pa gsol zhing mchod:sku gsung thugs yon phrin las mnyes pa bskangs:nyam chags 'gal gabrul nong pa mthol lo bshags:khyed rnams gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod:dge 'dun sde spel slob dpon sku tshe bsrengs:rnal 'byor don bsgrub sbyin bdag sde rgyas mdzod khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos:phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas par shog nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming tsam med pa dang:phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon phyor:'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā:cesabarjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs phrin las gang bcol thog med 'grub the tshom med do tham mā rgyal dbang padma'i thugasabacud 'di 'brog mi lo tswa'i dpal du bstan nusaldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i gsos su shog zab bcud srungs shag spu gra gsum skal med lag tu ma shor cig thub par gyas shag king dkar nag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya las gshin nag po' gsol mchod dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i spu gri rdzogasaso gter rgya

gtsaX gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi sgob dpon pa dma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda zim dzi cesapa 'di yang chosakyi bdag po kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgya kyisasangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra'i steng du mchin kha na phyar sbyong sman gang drag zhig phob zhes zhe sda rdo rje la bskul phyir rtso zhags mda' las myur ba'i gdams pa gtan la phab pa'o/ yi ge pa ni slob bu smon sems kyis bgyis pa sarba ma lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rjesnyingapolas bstan srung bdud btsan nag po'i zab sgrub khrag mtsho khol ma bstan dgra'i snying 'byin gyi mde'u dmar po zhes bya babazhugs so: —4( na mdo dzñā ni ḍākki na ye:za ngatsho 11 rgyal ba' dab po padma ngas gcas pa srog dang 'dra ba ya zab bcud gdams pa snyang phyung ba bayo sgrub brag mtsho khol ma bstan ram yā 'jig rung dur khrod g.ya' gangasaganas rgyu 'grul dben pa 'i gnas su phyin:mi 'bral 'grogs phyir bla rdo dang brten pa ra bzhug phyir sgrub gtor bca' dgyes bskang slad du mchod sa bsags khrus dang gtsang sbra sngonadugarṣa rnal lor lha ga4rṣa 'dzan gyas srung ma sgrub pa'i ramapa na hūṃ gyo rang mdun dug khrag khol ma'i klong:mi ro rta ro bsnol ba'i steng:bdud 'dul bgo rgyal snying hphun ni/sngo nag srin po khros pa'i nyams:spyan gsum bsgrad cing am gtsigs bsdams chu srin mgo bo'i rmog mo la:dar sna lnga yi rtse phran brjed:me rlung khu 'bang bu yug 'phro phyag g.yas btsan zhags dmar po yis:dam nyams dgra bo'i ske nas bcing g.yon pa btsan mdung ngar ma bsnams:nyams pa'i snying rtsa 'byin par byed lcags khrab

bgo zhing 'khor gsum brgyan dar dmar ber chen rlung gis bskyod chibs su bra bo g.yu rngog bcibs: gong thag glo snyed sbrul las byas gser sga g.yu stan mdzes pas brgyan: dar tshon sna lnga'i 'phan yab dang: mgyogs pa rlung gi bang rtsal can bsam pa'i yul la skad cig sleb me glog dud sprin 'khrigs klong bskyed 'khor du bdud btsan mched brgyad dang: 'byung lnga'i btsan dmag bye ba 'bum nyi rdupa 'khrigs pa lta bus bskor: rang srog 'od zer lcags kyu yis: gar bzhugs gnas nas ye shes pa: spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la bstim: snga rdo sgog 'khor rten la bzhugs: rgyal bstan srung byir gus phyag 'tshal las byed pho nyar mnga' gsol lo: gdung dbyangasarol mo'i sgra yis bstod: nyam chags 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bshags: rang srog 'od kyis srung ma bskul: dam tshig gnyan po rjes dran nas: srog snying lhud byung bdag la thim: gang bcol phrin las sgrab par bsam: tho na ga tsan tri du ste king ga ra sam ya phe dzaḥ brgya stong losogasabarjod gyur na 'bod rtagasamatsho ma khyad pa ra 'phags o na ga tsan tri du

gas/: bhe zhing ga ra sa ma ya dgra la rbad:to 'dzan ldan pa yang yang bzla rbad rtag du su thung bar nges oṃ na ga tsan tri du bhe king ga ra sam ya dgra bo'i tshe srog la hab hab:shā byeb 0〈cob:mā ra ya sod bsad rtagasamado na surma ma byu bar:g.yel ba med par brtson pa sgrub sam sru:de nasaganod 'tshe'i dgra bo de:gri mtshon sogasakyisabatsan thabasal brlag phyir byang bu gcag rgyug kyi:rno mde'u skru gri ngar ma bstan de mang gla ma'i byang ku ni sna la sor brgyad zhi sa gor bzhi steng stab g.yon du bskor ba' rgya:leb la dgra gzugasapho slo yi snying nar smo dang dza lto sbyor ming rusamal gsum brisapa'i mthar:rno ngar mtshon cha'i 'khor lo na:rtsibasabacu hūṃ dang mchan la ma :phyi rim theb pa las sngags na:hu ma dhi pa du bhe he sha rbad tsa tri nag po cho cho rgyug rgyug bring bring shag shag tshar tshar thog thog yer yer zung zung hur thum rgyug 'gyelarbad:dgra bo sgo mo' srog rtsa snying rtsa brla rtsa gtub:sha la ya ya rusal 4ba 4ba srog la rngub rngub dum bu shi dum bu shi sha hūṃ hur thum rgyug 'gyel sod:ces brisate mthar dza khram dgod kung shul sa dang dug khrag byug de nasadrag po'i 'phrod sbyor nyan bdud btsan rgyu lam brag ro gsu bskor la gnad nas bskul ba ni gtor skyemasabashamasal 'gugs gzhug bya byin rlab rol mo' sgra bcagate hū bhyo dza:las ba den 'bar ba e yi klong:bdud

btsan 'khrug pa'i da la nas: dgra gsod shan pa srog gi bdag: phung 'gyed nag po gnad nas bskul: brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra bo sgrol ba'i lasal bzhengs: do nub nyid du nyung thum sod: bdud btsan 'bar ba mched brgyad po ma thogs gsang ba'i las la bskul: sha khrag gtor skyemasa'adi bzhes la bstanadagra'i tshe dang srog la rbad: do nub nyid du hur thum sod: btsan dmag bye ba 'bum sde yang: bstan dgra'i gshed mar drag tu bskul brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhesal: do nub nyid du hur thum sod bdag la rgol ba'i dgra bo de: pha khu nye ba spun yin kyang: chosaskyong khyod kyi zasaskal gtad: dgra bo'i sha ni zan bsazhim dgra sha rol ba'i dusal bab: dgra bo'i khrag ni chang bas mngar: dgra khrag 'thung ba'i dusal bab: dgra bo'i rus pa mar bas sla dgra rus mur ba'i dusal bab: dgra bo'i snying ni zhim zhing mngar: dgra snying rol ba'i dus la bab: do nub nam gyi gong thun la brla rkun jag pa las la gyis: hur thum rgyag 'byel gzer nad phob: mig rtsa

badzra: gcus la ltag par 'then:snying rtsa gtub la myur du sod:khur thum rgyug 'gyel ltas na thongs:nad mtshon dug gi char ba phob:hur thum rgyug 'gyel bzhin du sgrol rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs:dus la bab po sa ma yā khyod nyid sgrub pa don ldan mdzod:bsnyen sgrub lhur len chud ma gsan dgra bo gsod pa' lag dmar gyis dgra srog mar me bsnubs par mdzod dgra khrag kha nas skyugs su chugs bsad rtags mngon sum bdag la sprod:bcol ba'i las mdzod sa ma yā:cesabarjod gtor skyemasadagra phyogs dor zhag bdun tsam las ma 'khya bar dmigs pa 'i dgra bo sgropa bar sa chos skyong mdo na sum 'grub pa gal rno nus byan rlabasabasam mi khyab tha tshom med do sa ma rwa rtagasabyung tsha na 'khor lo nyid mun rub srod 'khor dusasu ni 'khor lo me yi hom la bsregs dgra dpu pha lam yin kya 'jag rdul du brlag par the tshom med sam yuḥde na bska gsol ci 'grub bskyal slar ya 'khrugasabaskang bya ba na gtor skyemasabā lang dpu ldan bshams bsangasasbyangs byan gyas bams na slar rang nyad wa ya nga rgyal gyas bhyo0phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na:nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na:btsan yul zangs thang

'bar ba nas:bdud btsan brdzogs pa'i sras gcig pu:me yi phreng ba gtso 'khor bcas:dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs:snga rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs:snga chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod:bā ling gtor ma'i brngan pa phul:'khru zhing gdug rtsub cho 'phrul bzlog zhi zhing byams brtse ldan pa yis:phrin las rab 'byams gegs med sgrubs:'jig rten bde skyid ldan par mdzod nad mug mtshon 'khrug rgud pa kun:zhi zhing gzhes pa ra mjad gu gsolaḥdus la bab po sa ma yā brgya stong la sogasaci 'grub bskyal gnad des ldog pa'i rkyen las rgyal rab 'byams phrin las gegs med 'grub the tshom med do sa ma wā e ma rgyal ba'i dab ro pa dma saṃ ba wa' ma 'o sa'agro la thugasarje chagasapa yis snying dang 'dra ba'i gdamasapa rmad byung ba 'brog mi lo tsā chos mdzod 'dzan la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cag sa ra dzu ma 'ongs snyigasama'i rgud pa gso ba'i phyir mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong du dgongasapra mdzod dus kyi cho rol 'tshubs ma lang ba' tsha: sprul dpa 'a bo nus lan rdo rje da 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzan skyongs spel las can ral khur bcu gsum dag la 'doms ro chen bcu gsum chos kyi lam la 'god

ga sgri 'gro don bsam ma khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' log lag tu ma shor srog bdag lnga gdams bcud dbyer med srungasashig spu gri gsum bya ra mel rtse ma g.yel king dkar nag sam ā rgya rgya rgya bdud btsan nag po'i zab sgrubs khrag 'tsho khol ma rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob dpon pa dma waṃ wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'ad 'ang chosakyi bdag po dharma ku mudadang chos bdag kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas gnyis kyis nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldanardo rjes gnas mchog zangs ra 'bar ba'i dge bsnyen gya mdun zur nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda lhag chad med par gtan la dbab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos nyid rang grol gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bstan srung bdud btsan nag po'i gsol mchod byad ma 'joms pa'i tho lum zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍākki ni ye tsha rgarganas las can skal bzas pho slo yi brin las geg med 'grub pa 'i phyar bka' srung bdud btsan nag po yi gsol mchod bya ba' man ngag bstan sam yā ja chang skyemasaphud dmaragator bshams bsangs sbyangs spel bsgyur byin gya brlabs rang nyid la yi rgyal gyis rol ma'i sgra bcas 'di skad do hūṃ bhyoḥ gtum drag dur khrod rngams pa'i gnas: pha 'ong long bu'i sku mkharanas: btsan rgyal srog bdud dmar po ni bka' 'khor brgyad dang yang g.yog 'bum ma lus lus pa med pa kun dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: snga rdosgog 'khor rten la bzhugs: rgyal bstan srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yis bstod khyed rnams dgyes pa bskang ba'i phyir: nyer spyod bdun dnga'angong yon wa: san gcor rab ja chang spems bzang bca' bayong ba wag ga'ib rigs: sa 'ag bzan pa'i ba ling 6: 'jong yon ma tshang med pa'i gcer mig 'phal

'dod yon lnga sman gtor rakta ja chang skyems: bzang bca' btung ba ldag gzhib rigs: sha khrag brgyan pa'i bā ling ta: 'dod yon ma tshang med pa'i gter: mig 'phrulalta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: nam mkha' rab 'byams khams bkang ste: bdud btsan nag po gsol zhing mchod: dkar sham bzhin bzang gsol zhing mchod: snying 'byin nagapo gsol zhing mchod: bdud 'dul 'bar ba gsol zhing mchod las btsan mched brgyad gsol zhing mchod: jon chen mched bdun gsol zhing mchod: sprul pa bsamayas gsol zhing mchod: sku gsung thugs yon brin las bskangs: gsol mchod bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: nad gdon nyer 'tshe zhib dang dgra sngag chem rkun gnod pa bzlog tshe gcig bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed: mthun rkyen 'dod rgu'i char ba phob: gdul bya 'khor slob dbang du bsdus: snyan gragasaphyogs bcu'i pha mthar smogs dam pa chos kyi mnga' 'og tu: 'gro rnams smin cing grol bar mdzod: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos: nub med 'dzin grang spel khyab

ba tshu mdzod: rgyal dbang padma'i bka' dam bzhin: ma g.yel ma 'gying sa ma yā: cethabarjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs gnad de phrin la gang bcol 'thub the tshom med do rdo rje'ibaka' bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal padma nga yi thugs ba da 'di bstan la phang yang 'gro don du grub pa 'i dbang byug khyod la gtad da dung brdar chugs gter du sbos snyigasam lnga mtshang maro na gyur skabs nga sprul nusaldanardo rje yis snyed nasabastan 'gro'i gso su spel 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa 'byung skal med lag tu ma shor cag: snyi ga bu dang 'phrad par shog sam wā rgya rgya rgya gsol mtshod byad ma 'joms pa'i zo lum rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi cesapa 'di ya drag jagasakyi dab phyug kun bzang bstan 'dzan dar rgyasadang drag spyor la re ba che ba dharma gnyi kyi bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo las zhal bshus te dge bsnyen zings gyo can gyi mdun zur nas dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni padma smon semasasosarba maṅga lam/

gtsaX zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bstan srung lha mo nag mo' zab sgrub dug rlung khol ma bzhugs so:gas( na mo dzñā na ḍakki na ye: sa 3spya sgom rgyal ba'i dab po padma ngas ma 'o 'gro la brtse semasakyis bstan srung ma mo nag mo ya zab sgrub dug rlu khol ma bstan sa ma yu de ya dur khrogaya' gangs tshal 'jag rung rngams 'i tshal du phyin ste brgyad tshogs la sa bslang zhag maṇḍal mda' gang dbyab legs bya nal thod dbu su sgrub gtor bya bla rdo srog 'khor brten pa 'a sa phya nang nyer spyod mchod sprin bkramabasangasasbyang byin gyisabarlabs pa ra bya khrus da gtsang sbra sngon du garṣa phyi nang gsang ba' dam rgya sdom ra nyad la ya nga rgyal gyis hūṃ bye rang mdun khrag mtsho khol ma'i klong:nad dug bu yug 'dzabasama'i dbus bhyo las dpal ldan lha mo ni:mthing nag char sprin lhun po 'dra:zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum 'khrigs:khams nag ral ba gyen du brdzes thod pagasum rim dbu rgyan dang:dar sna'i cod paṇa rlung gis g.yeng phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri phyar g.yon pas bhanta sku la brten dar dang ratna rus pas brgyan sku smad

gzig gi sham thabs dang: mgo phreng mi rtsud re sde gsol: mchan khung nad kyi skyal ba zed: srin thod rga gong rol stabs bzhugs: chibs su rgya bong dmar ga bcibs/'phung steng mig gnyis phyir la bsgrad: mgyogs pa rlung gi bang rtsal can kha khrid skem ma chu srin mgo ma mo mched lnga las mdzad brgyad g.yog mo lnga bcu yang g.yoga'abum: mdor na srid pa ma mo yi: bka' dang 'khor na gnas pa ni: ma yam da ma tshig can gyi tshogs: nyi rdul 'khrigs pa lta bur bskyed thugs sgog rdo rje'i sabon las/'od 'phros gar bzhugs gnas mchog nas spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim: bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs brtse bas skyong phyir gusaphyag 'tshal: rgyal bstanasrung bar mnga' gsol lo: dgyes bskyed phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: nyam chags 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bshags bdag thugasa'od kyis srung ma bskul: bzlas pas sgog snying nus mthu kun: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpal du shar: gang bcol phrin las bsgrub par bsam: yo ma ma ro ru phu ru re ma ti

badzra sam ya pho dzaḥ'abod sngag brgyastong khri gosabaskyal oṃ ma ma ro ru phu ru re ma ti ma bhyo dza trī sarba sa ma ya dgra la rbad:rbad pa lasakyi 'khospyor bskor o ma ma ro ru phu rudrag raka re ma ti ma bhyo dza trī sarba sam ya dgra bo sgo mo'i srog snying byung tsitta gtub sarba sha hūṃ rbad sod:bas sngag rtagasamadza byung bar bzlo skabasasu galo mja gnad la yon mamo lasal bskul ba ni gtor skyems ༅masal 'gugs gas bya bsangasasbyangasabyin masanan du bskyal rol lo sgra bcasa'adi skad do hū spyodug khrag me rlung 'dzabs ma'i klong:mu le gting mtsho'i 'gram ngog nas ma cig dpal ldan re ma ti:mched 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas:dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir bskul:sku shugs byung la mthu rtsal bskyed brnag pa'i bstan bshig dgra bo yi:srog snying byung la tsitta gtub:bsad pa'i rtags mtshan myur du ston:mtha' yi dmag 'khrug mtshon cha'i gzeng:dus kyi rgud pa ming med rlog zhing bcu tshang rnams char thum sod:rnam shes chosakyi dbyingasasu drongs:dwas la bab po sam yā:cesabarjodaga' skyemasagatsang sar rkags khyad par nad potshud 'dod na

mdzo dmar rwa g.yon bug chag bral skyon ma gosapa thabasakyisablang de nang mdze khrag bong khrag dang gri snying yug sa'i rakta dang bong nga nag po rta bon dang sre mong te lo'i khrag kyang bsre myo pa'i mi dang khyi khrag sbyar ngan dgu tshang ba'i nya ma la rwa bum la blug bong lpag gis kha gcodaye khaṃ nang du gzhugs bden brdar dmod mo lan mang bskyal de na bzla sngagasabya ba ni skyod ma ma ro ru phu ru na sha ya dgra la rbad: rnye mo la khrag nad sbos skyal gas rim cho cho spril spril sgugs skugs kha pa a phye ye swā shā brgya stong khri 'bum la sogasabaskyal yang cig sngag kyi sbyor ba ni 'ur 'ur tshig tshig zhes zhes myos myosawaka sbos ger nan skyal sbub ci 'grab brjod la thun gyis brab de nasadagra la ldeb pa ni: hūṃ bhyoḥ ma mo nag mo las la rbad khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob: re ti mched bzhi lasal rbad khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob sku yi ma mo las la rbad khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob: gsung gi ma mo las la rbad khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob thugs kyi ma mo las la rbad: khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob: yon tan ma mo las la rbad: khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob: brin las ma mo las la rbad: khrag nad

ba tshu spyo 'bogs dgra la phob skem chen ma mo las la rbad: khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob bran mo bcu bzhi las la rbad: khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob g.yog mo lnga bcu las la rbad: khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob yang g.yog 'bum khri 'bum stong rbad khrag nad spyo 'bogs dgra la phob: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra boyi pha khu nye ba spun lag dang: bu da bu mo chung ma rnams: cho ngus brang rdung 'debs su chugs: 'o dod khrag nad myos su chugs brgyal 'bogs zha grum reng du chugs mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then: 'o dod ngu 'bod 'debs par mdzod 'gro bzhin pa la gdong thug sod: 'dug bzhin pa rnams gza' grib thob dgra bo'i mi phyugasa'akhor dang bcas: me stag chu yis bsad bzhin du: ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod: dus la bab po sam yā: ma mo nag mo re ma ti bhyo: rakta khrag rbab dgra la rbad sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa rje mo myos myos thum ri li li rbad sod: ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis 'ur sga dang cho sga sod rgyob kyi sga dang bcas te dgra bo'i steng du dmag la

mas nas thal ba rdul phran du brlag par bsam la:thun zor rdeb ral ba bsigs dmod bor dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa khrag nad kyi myosapar yang yang dmigs de ni dgra yul nad kyi tshang khang 'khrigs nga tsam med par phongs 'gyur the tshom med srung ma mngon sum 'grub pa gnad du shes de tshe rbad pa'i lasal the mi tshom sam yā skabs su 'brugasabaskang bya ba la gtor skyemasabashamasal byin rgya brlabs rang nyid lha yi nga kha gyis spyoḥgatum drag dur khrod 'asdigs pa'i gnas:mu le gting gi mtsho 'gram nas:dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti:'khor dab bcas pa gshegs su gsol:snga rdo srogashesar rten la bzhugs 'dod yon brgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa bshags:'khu ldog gdug rtsub ma mdzad cig:byams brtse'i ma yis bu zhin skyong:ci bcol phrin lasasgrub pa dang:rig pa mi 'gyur rang zhal sprod gachen nu bum skur grol bar mdzod bgyostong khri khrumalago bskyal gnad desaldog pa'i rkyen la grol sa dang grib bzhin 'grogs par 'byur the tshom med do sam yā e ma rgyal ba'i dab po padma sa bha wa' ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snyang da 'dra ba'i gdams pa rmad byung ba 'brog mi lo tsā chos mdzod 'dzin la gam

ba rte da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pa' rin chen brda la thob cig sar phyo ma 'ongasasnyigasama'i rgud pa gso ba'i phyir mdo khamasardo rje'i rdzong la dgongasapra thob ma 'ong snyigasam sum cu kha ral dus nga spruladapa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad na bstan pa rin chen 'dzan skyong spel la can chos bdag ral khur rnams la spel rong chen bcugasum chos kyi lam la 'god bstan pa'i 'gro don rgya chen geg med 'byung the tshom med do rdo rjergyal po 'a bka' skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum gdams ba da thub par srungs shig phrog bdag lnga bya ra mel rtse ma g.yel king dkar nag dam ldan thugasakyi srasadang 'phrad par shog sam yā rgya rgya rgya lha mo nag mo'izab sgrub dug rlung khol ma rdzog so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya mo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sa wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi cesapa 'di yang drag sngag rolaba' rdo rje kun bzang gis bskul ngor/ brtul zhugs ye shesardo rjenus ldan pas smras te/ zhen med nyal chog rdo rjeskon semasakyas gris pas/ mos ldan dam tshag rdo rje thams cad kyi dpal smon/ sarba ma lam/

ga rte zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung lha mo nag mo'i gsol mchod bdud bgegs sgrol ba'i spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so:gtsa(: na mo dzñā na ḍākki ni ye: 1nasgyu11 bstan sru sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis gsol mchod srog gi gta' ru zungs yo byad dpung ldan bsags pa ra bya bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs dmigs pa sa spel ra nyid lha yi nga ma rgyas bzang shing sna rgasadud pa spro rol mo snyan pa 'i sgra 4sate: hū bhyoḥ kun khyab brdal ba'i gnas mchog dam pa nas: ma mo yongs kyi gtso mo re ma ti mched 'khor sprul ba yongs rdzogs bsam yas pa: ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: bla rdo sgog 'khor brten pa'i rdzas la bzhugs: rgyal bstan srung ba'i pho nyar mnga' gsol lo: lha phyag 'tshal lo brtse ba chen pos skyongs: snyan 'gyur gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'dud do bstod: dgyes bskyed nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga: sman gtor rakā bza' bca' btang ba'i rigs bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen bdun: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod smin mtha' yas pa bya nag mchu ser rta tril

'dod 'jo'i ba: ma rmos lo thog sha rkyang ma he dang: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dpa' skyems kyis: dpal ldan lha mo nag mo gsol zhing mchod: sku yi ma mo chen mogasol zhing mchod: gsung gi ma mo chen mo gsol zhing mchod: thugs kyi ma mo chen po gsol zhing mchod: yon tan ma mo chen mo gsol zhing mchod: phrin las ma mo chen mogasol zhing mchod: ma mo ro kha ma gsum gsol zhing mchod ma mo gtsug gi mched gsum gsol zhing mchod: gas ba las kyi ma gsum gsol zhing mchod: gsang ba'ipho nya rnam gsum gsol zhing mchod: ma bdun sring mo mched bzhi gsol zhig mchod: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro gsol zhing mchod: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsolazhing mchod: ma mo bstan ma bcu gnyis gsol zhing mchod: lha mo tshe ring mched lnga gsol zhing mchod sman btsun g.yu yi sgron ma gsol zhing mched: zhing skyong dur khrod lhamo gsol zhing mchod: 'khor gyi ming sring brgyad po gsol zhing mchod dur khrod ngan ne ma brgyad gsol zhing mchod: bka' 'khor bsam mi khyab pa gsol zhing mchod:

ba tshu khyed rnams gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis:srid pa'i dal yam nad kha dgra la spor dus 'khrug mtshon cha'i gzeng mo zhi bar mdzod:du ru kṣa yi rgol ba mtha' dag sol phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon phyor rnal 'byor dben khrod 'grims pa'i 'tsho ba sbyor:'khor slob 'du ba rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod gsang chen bstan pa 'dzin bsrung spel ba dang khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos:nub med phyogs bcu kun tu dar rgyas mdzod:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā:cesabarjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs rnam bzhi' phrin las gang bcol ba gegasamed yid bzhin 'grub par ra bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grimasadang mthong padma'i thugasazig zab mo nyid 'brog ma lo tsa khyod lasbyin ma brjed brda la bstam mdzod dang snyigasam lnga yi dusaskab su khyod sprul dpa' bo gcag dang 'phrad bstan pa'i 'gro don gegasamed 'byung gter bdag srog bdag lnga la gnyer zab bcud spu gra gsum la bcol gnyer byang king ka ra la gtod dusasu rnam par gong 'phel rgyas ze tshom med do rdo rje' bka' sam yā rgya rgya rgya lha mo'i gsolamachod dgra bgegasasgrol ba'i spu gra rdzog so gter rgya gtad

rgya sba rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma waṃbha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo thim snyi cesapa 'di 'ang chosabadag dharma dang kun bzang gnyisakyi bskulangorabadag 'dra dpa'abo nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni padma smon sems so/ sarba maṅga lam/
bas/ 7 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung gza' bdud nag po'i sgrub rdo rje'i rdzong chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bsgo/: na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: sa ba mas dusagasumargyalab thamasacad kyi phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i gar rigasa'adusapadma kwa ra la mthon mthing ral bsad de 'dud ma'ong pa ldan pho mo rnams gsang chen rdo rje'i sgor zhugasatsha bar chad dgra las rgyal ba'i phyir bstan sru sgrub pa srog gtar zungs sa ma yu deyang dur khred 'jigasaba'i gnas g.ya' ga samatsho gli dag la phyin sde brgyad dreg paras bsla zhig phyi na gapa 'i dam rgya bsdams maṇḍal rmada' ga gru bzhi bya ñtsa gas snod sgrub gtor g.ya sa gcus bya 'khor du rang 'dra brgyad da ri gdong cho la ri g.yon gcusabazha rgyu skar sde brgyad gtor yo te kun gyi rtse'og lkog ma btsang 'byung ba'i khrag byug rgyan gyis spras rnam lnga nyer spyod dzos rtags bkod ja rdo srog 'khor brten rdzas gces de na yi dam las gzhung bsrangs sgrub dzos bsangs khrus gtsang sbra bya de nas khros ma'i nga rgyal gyis skrung ma bskyed pa 'i rim pa ni dza bhyoḥrang mdun dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gnas:me rlung dug khrag 'tshubs ma'i dbus dgra bgegs phongasasri bsnol ba'i steng:ra lasadrang srong ra hu la:sku mdog nag po char sprin mdog dbu dgu khā yi gdong dang bcu:spyan mig rtsa bdun dbyings su gzigs:srid pa'i legs nyes bya ra byed:phyag drug bar bas

badzra: mda' gzhu 'geng dang pos ral gri sbrul zhags 'chang: 'og mas tho chen nad skyal bsdams lto bar zhal hom rab 'jigs gdangs: gzas pa po rnamasahub kyis rngub: sku smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'byil dar dpyangs rus rgyan sbrul chun mdzes: me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs dbus nas: myur mgyogs stag mo'i khri la 'gyeng phyogs bzhi gdong mo mched bzhi dang: sprul pa'i gza' chen rnam pa brgyad: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bcas: rdzu 'phrul rnam 'gyur ya ma zung glog dmar g.yu 'byug khri labarten gsod gcod mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung du ston: spyo bor gsang bdag rdo rjes brgyan: gnas gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: rang bzhinagar bzhugs gnas mtshog nas: spyan drangasaganyisasu med par bstim: de nasaspyan 'dren bya ba na dzaḥ zeg chen bstan pa'i bya ra ba: mig stong ldan pa'i ra hu la gza' brgyadargyu skar 'bangs 'khor bcas: ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsol gdung ba'i 'bod do da tshur byon: ma g.yel ma 'khyang sa ma yā: rlo na ga rakra ra hu la sarba sam ya pho

de na bsasasugasogab ni dzaḥ drang srong smug nag 'od 'phro dang bka' 'khor sprul pa yang 'khor bcas bla rdo sgog 'khor rten la bzhugs bstan pa srung phyir tiṣṭha lhan sam ya st+waṃ tiṣṭha badro: de na phyag la'i bya ba na dzaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra ba: drang sgong gza' bdud 'khor bcas la: rgyal bstan nub med bsrung ba'i phyir: gusapachen pos phyag 'tshal lo sam ya hṝ na mo na ma ho: de na mja 'bul ba ni dzaX nam mkha'i khamasaladabang bsgyur ba'i: drang sgong gza' bdud ra hu la yab yum 'khorabacas dgyes pa'i phyir: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga: sman gtor rakta byang chub sems: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag skyems: snying sna ra yis gsur dud dang zla rgyas zla phrum dkar gyi skyems: ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas bya: gcan gzan rnam pa sna tshogs dang: 'dod yon nam mkha'i mdzod chen pos gza' bdud chen pogasol zhing mchod: gdong mo mched bzhi gsol zhing mchod: dregs pa'i gza' brgyad gsol zhing mchod rgya skar nyer brgyad gsol zhing mchod: yang 'khor bsam yas

༄(ji gsol zhing mchod: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs: dgyes te rnal 'byor byams brtses skyo : 'dod rgu'i longs spyod char ltar phob gzugs canagazugs med dgra bgegs sgrol gang bcol thogs med 'grub par mdzod ma na ga raka ra hu la sarba sa pa ri wā ra ma hā arnya sogs bha rū pa sogs dharma ma hāpañtsa rakta bā ling ta me sa sta na ga na sarba pu dza ho: de nas ma 'a gasrogabya ba ni hūṃ bhyo phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas mchog: baiḍūr lhun po'i kha dog 'chang: sangs rgyas bstanal lhag par gdung: las mdzad chen por mnga' gsol lo: byams dang snying rje'i mnga' dbang phyug: dad ldan gdul bya bu bzhin skyong: 'gyur ba med pa'i dam tshig can drang sgong chen por mnga' gsol lo: rnam rol srin po ltar khros pa'i: zhing bcu'i dgra la rkan sgra ldeb bar chad bdud sde ming med brlag: dug gi spu grir mnga' gsolalo: tsha'aphral nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: dregs rtsal bar snang smog las myar che btsan 'jig rten bdun las 'phags: dregs pa'i gtso bor mnga' gsol lo

log sbyor brtsam pa'i dam sri rnams: khyod nyid mthong thos dran tsam gyis: 'bog brgyal rbad kyis gsod par byed: dgra gshed bgegs 'dul mnga' gsol lo: gang lagazes kyang thal bar rlog 'jigs med rdo rje pha lam dngos gsang chen sngags kyi bstan srung ba: rdo rje'i pho nyar mnga' gsol lo rnal 'gyor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i 'jigs brgyad zhi zhi tshe bsod rgyas: mos bzhi dab bsdus dgra bgegs sgol: gang bcol sgrubs shig sam yā: de nathabastod ba bya ba ni dza phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyanazhing: o rgyan padma'i bstan srung ba: dregs pa'i gtso mchog ra hu la: rgyal ba'i pho nya chen por bstod: gzes po ra yi mda' gzhus 'gems: dam nyams sgog rtsa ral grisagatub: bar chad 'byung po zhags pas 'ching: thabs mkhas rgyal po khyod la bstod: dbu dgus theg pa rim dgu bsrung: sbyan mig 'bum gyis srid gsum gzigs logasbor mkhan rnams lco bar rngab: bstan grang chen por phyag 'tshal bstod sma stod srin po khros pa'i nyams smrad ni sbral mjug kla yi lcam: kla bdud bshos pa'i sras gcig

pa(: pu gza' bdud dug gi sbu grir bstod phan bde'i dpal ster drang srong sku legs nyes ltos 'jin dam tshig can gza' brgyad rgyu skar gdong zla bcas yab yum gtso 'khor sprul par bstod: rgyal ba yongs kyi bka' dam bzhin: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod: rnal 'byoralas bzhi lhun grub mdzod: nad mug dus 'khrug rgud pa bzlog: phyogs las rnam rgyal snang ba stsol: gang bcol sgrubs shig sa ma yā: bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'ithugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gza' bdud chen po'i thugs rgyud bskul: dam tshig gnyan po rjes su dran nas sgog snying zhal nas byung ste bdag la thob: sgrub pa po'iphrin las rab 'byams gang bcol thams cad thogs med du sgrub par bsam: slo na ga ra ra hu la hūṃ dza:ci 'apyob brjod la 'bod par bya oṃ na ga rakka ra hu la ha la ha la dgra larbad: ya yang bzlasate rbad ci bskul oṃ na ga rakra ra hu la ha la ha la dgra bo gnod byed che ge mo hur thum sod: rabatu bzlasapa bsad rtag lupabaden rdzun lagatu longasadangagasal ze ma

med do sam mā skabasasu gsolamachod ci 'grub da 'khrugs bskang za ngu yang yang bskyal gnad desosrung ma lasal khol ma 'bral lusadang grib bzhan 'grogs gang bcol phrin las thogasamed 'grub mthu ya grags pasasasteng khyab dgra dpung pha lam yin kya 'jig the tshom med do som shā ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pa dma saṃ bha wa' ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen po yis snying da 'dra ba'i gdams zab med byung ba 'aprog mi lo tsā chosamadzod 'dzan lagato da dung spel pa'i dus ma ma bab pa'i rin za brda pa thob cig sar rdzu mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzo sa su dgongasabra sdom ma 'ongasasnyigasam sum cu la ral dus o ma rig 'dzinanus na rdo rje dang 'phrad nasabastan dang 'groba'i phan bde spel bstan pa'i bdag po ral khur bu gsum 'byu bka' 'dis ro chen bcu gsum chos la gzud 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungasashig srog bdag lnga skal med lag tu mgor spu gri gsum 'dzan bsrung mel rtse ma g.yel shang dkar nag sam yu rgya rgya rgya gza' bdud nag po'i sgrub pa rdo rje'i rdzong chen rdzogs so gter rgya gto rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma rtsebhasda'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim8ni 'byul zhigakun bzang bstan 'dzin ngor/ 'khrul nag rgad po kun nyis smras/ 'khrul mgo cung bcom dharmasabris/ 'khrul snang zhang bcu'i gshed du shog sarba masgo lam/

bsgotshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bstan srung gza' bdud nag po'i gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:ba tshu na mo dzñā na ḍākki ni ye rar ni snasnasha bstan srung sgrub pa ra byed pa' tshe gces pa'i gsol mja zab mo 'di rin pho srog dang sbrel byasate 'bad pa lhur jang brten la lo sa ma wā de mchad rdzas dpung za bsags lha sngags nyi sa re 'jan gyisabarlabs rol mo sna tshogs sgra bcasate snyan pa' dbya sakyis 'di skad do dzaḥ sngon che padma 'byung gnas kyis bka' dang dam la bzhag pa rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag po ni: drang sgong gza' bdud ra hu la: gdong bzhi gza' brgyad rgyu skar sde: ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: snga rdo sgog 'khor rten bzhugs rgyal bstan srung bar mnga' gsol lo phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: lha jags ting 'dzin gsal bas bstod: dgyes bskyed mchod pa 'bul ba dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag skyems: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang: tshil zhun gsur gyi dud pa sprin: snying sna ra yi sha khrag gis: gza' bdud dug gi spu

mchod: gdong zla gdong mo mched bzhi mchod: sprul ba'i gza' chen rnam brgyad mchod: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad mchod 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum sde mchod gsol lomachod do dgyes pa bskangs khyod la brin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod mtshan ldan ja ma'i sku tshebasrengs lta ba log pa'i bdud sde sgrol: chos kyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang: phyogs las rnam rgyal snang ba stsol: khyad par zhing bcu tshang ba dang: bdag la rgol ba'i dgra bornams kha rlungs dug gi spu gris sod: ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos phyogs bcu kun tu dar rgyas mdzod: dam la ma 'da' samayā cesapa ci 'grub yang yang bskyal gnad des phrin lasagang bcol 'grub phyi nang rkyen las rnam par rgyal dam chosasgrub pa' mthun rkyen spel the tshom med do sa ma yā: rgyal dbang pa dma'i thugasab da 'di 'brog mi lo tsā khyedal gtad da dung ma spel bdo la thob nusaldan rdo rje zhesabya bas ma 'ong sasnyigasama'i dusasu rted bstan dang 'gro ba'i don byed 'gyuraḥ the tshom med do sam mā bka' gas srung shig srog bdag lnga spu gri mched gsum dag la

gas( gnyer 'dzan srung ma g.yel ki dkar nag thugs kyi srasadang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gza' bdud nag po'i gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub ོgas so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o ma gya slob dpon pa dma saṃ ba wa'i bka' bdag 'dra ma/bar za bzasabakod pa'o brda zim lha kha pha rdo rje kun bzang dang /tsab tso rdo rje padma chos/nyal 'dod rdo rje slob ma 'gas/dad dam rdo rje tshig gisabaskul/'khrul dag rdo rje kun nyisasmras/brtson 'grus rdo rje dharmasabris/sarba ma lam/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung gza' bdud nag po'i 'khrugs bskang 'khu ldog tshar gcod bzhugs so:ba rte na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: tsho snang pa dma'i rgyud 'dzin skyes bu yis bsnyen sgrub lhun len byed pa 'i tshe bar pha dgra yasargol ba na srung ma lasal rbad pa gal 'khu ldog gdug rtsub byung gyur na 'khrugs bsnang 'ad nyid med thabs med de phyir las ldan pho mo yi gtor skyemasamachod gtor grangasaldan bsags bas sa sbyang byin gyas brlabs nas slar ra nyid wa ya rgyal gyis snyan pa'i dbya sabacas 'di skad do hūṃ bhyo: khrag mtsho khol ma'i klong dkyil nas: drang srong khyab mjug ra hu la gdong bzhi gza' brgyad rgyu skar sde: ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol dam tshig gsang ba'i rten la bzhugs: bstan pa srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal dgyes bskyed mchod pa 'bul ba ni: sha khrag snying sna ra mazin dang: khrag gi yon chab chu ser gyi: zhal bsil dbang po'i me tog dang: mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zas: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgra dang: 'dod yon mchod sprin mtha' yas pas: ra hu la yi thugs dam bskangs:

gas ldog 'byugs rtsub zhi bar mdzod:gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskangs:'khu ldog zhabrugs rtsub zhi bar mdzod:gza' chen brgyad kyi thugs dam bskangs 'khu ldog 'khrugs rtsub zhi bar mdzod:rgyu skar nyer brgyad thugasadam bskangs:'khu ldog 'khrugs rtsub zhi bar mdzod:dregs pa sde brgyad thugs dam bskangs:'khu ldog 'khrugs rtsub zhi bar mdzod:sprul 'khor bsam yas thugs dam bskangs:gas ldog 'khrugasartsub zhi bar mdzod:rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la:gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa yi gzugs can gzugs med dgra dang bgegs:lo dang zla bar ma 'byeng bar:kha rlang dug gi spu gris sod:bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod:drag rtsal che ba'i byad chos ston:ma bul ma 'khyangs dam tshig can bcol ba'i lasamadzod sa ma yā:ma na ga rakka ra hu la e rda bā ling ta kha kha khā hi snyi:brgya stong khri khrumalamasaskul garṣa skyemasagatsang sar gshegasapar bya gnad desagang bcol phrin lasa'agrub rno nusabyan rlabasabasam ma khyab bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal bdag 'dra padma' thugasathig 'di 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la gto rjesa'ajug don

gtsa( phyir yi ger thob rdo rje'i rdzong la dgo sa rgya sdoms snyigasam sum cu kha ral dus sprul pa las can gcag da 'phrad bstan dang 'gro ba' don chen 'byu zab gsang srungasashig srog bdag lnga skal med la sdom spu gri gsum dam tshag ma g.yel ki dkar nag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya 'khrug bska 'khru ldog tshar gcod rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu hya o rgyan gya slob dpon padma sabha la' bka' bad 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi drag sbyor kun ba nga bstan 'dzan la/drag sngags dbang phyug kun nyis phab/drag po'i bstan pa rgyas pa 'i phyar/drag sngags sgor zhugs dharmas bris/sarba masgo lam/

btsa/ zab gsang rdo rjesnying po las:drag bskul byad ma 'joms pa'i tho lum zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ba rte na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye rgyusgabyu rastostami rgyal dbang padma sa bha wa'i:rjes 'jug dad lan skyes bu yas bsnyan sgrub lhur len byed pa' tsha nyes byed dgra yis rgol gyur na sru ma'i rbad bskul las la dra sa da ya dmar gtor skyams phud bshams 'gugs gzhugasagra sa lan bskyal ba' rjas rnal 'byor la sngagasalan pa yas rol mo'i sgra bcasa'ad skad do dzaX theg chen bstan pa srub mdzad pa'i drang sgong gza' bdud ra hu la:dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dang:o rgyan padma'i bka' dam bzhin:ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos:dka' bas btsal zhing dkon pas sgrub:zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos:ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud nyid tshe 'di blos btang bsgrubs pa la nyes byed dgra bos rgol ba byung wa sngags ting 'dzin phral dwa bcom dam rgya ral bcug mi snyan bsgags:tshe dang srog gi bdwad dwa bab:de 'dra'i rgol ba ma bzod nas:chos stong khyed

la 'o dod 'bod: lus srog 'ben du btsug byas nas: gza' bdud rgyal po las la bskul: dgra sha zo la dgra snying byung: dgra khrag 'thung la dgra rus mur: dgra bo ming tsam med par mdzod: mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then: spyo 'bogs 'o dod brang brdung chugs: bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod: brngan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mngag pa'i las la ma g.yel cig: gdong mo mched bzhi las la bskul: dgra sha zo la dgra snying byung: dgra khrag 'thung la dgra rus mur: dgra bo ming tsam med par mdzod: mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then: spyo 'bogs 'o dod brang brdung chugs: bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod: brngan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngag pa'i las la ma g.yel cig gza' chen brgyad po las la bskul dgra sha zo la dgra snying byung: dgra khrag 'thung la dgra rus mur: dgra bo ming tsam med par mdzod: mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then: smo 'bogs 'o dod brang brdzung chugs: bsad rtags don snying bdag la spod: brngan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhesal: mngag

bsgo/: pa'i las la ma g.yel cig rgyu skar nyer brgyad las la bskul: dgra sha zo la dgra snying byung: dgra khrag 'thung la dgra rus mur dgra bo ming tsam med par mdzod mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then spyo 'bogs 'o dod brang brdung chugs bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod: brngan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mngag pa'i las la ma g.yel cig: lha srin sde brgyad las la bskul: dgra sha zo la dgra snying byung: dgra khrag 'thung la dgra rus mur dgra bo ming tsam med par mdzod mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then: spyo 'bogs 'o dod brang brdu chugs: bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod: brngan pa'i mched gtor 'di bzhes la mngag pa'i las la ma g.yel cig yang 'khor bsam yas dgra sha zo la dgra snying byung dgra khrag 'thung la dgra rus mur: dgra bo ming tsam med par mdzod: mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then: smo 'bogs 'o dod brang brdung chugs bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod: brngan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mngag pa'i las la ma g.yel cig pho rgyud

skyes pa rtsad nas chod: gri thabs nang dme 'ong du chugs mo rgyud bud med mngal nas skom: yug mo'i sbar 'dzeng 'thabs su chugs: chung gsum byis pa rdul du rlog: lo tog sad kyis bcom bzhin mdzod: nor phyugs phongs brlag stor du chugs: phu nu nye ba ming med rlog: rang bzhin 'chi ba kun la yod: glo bur nyung thum rgyug 'byel sod khyod la nus pa yod gyur na: bdag gis sgrub pa chud ma gsan: brnags pa'i dam nyams a mu ga'i: glo mchin tsitta sgog dbugs bcas: da lta nyid du lto bar rngub: dgra bo ming med phrin las mdzod dus la bab po sa ma yā: ma hrī tri shag ri ri na ga tsitta tram̐ ma ma yo za 'gram ha he ge sha la dgra bo nni mo'i steng du 'ur ba 'ur ba: rgyug rgyug bring bring shag shag tshar tshar gtub gtub chom chom ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod garṣa skyemasadagra phyogasador dmod pa bor snyo thal mo rdeb sgra bsigasadrag po'i la byed do gnad de ldan pa 'a rnal 'byor gyis dgra dpu pha lam yin kyang 'jig bden rdzun lag tu longasad gsal ngesoshesogating nasa'akhrung bar 'gyur the tshom med do sam yu rgyal dbang padma'i thugasabacud 'ad khye'u chung ye shes

—41: khyod la gtad da du ma spel brdo la thob rdo rje'i rdzong du rgya sdom da ཿ ma 'o sa rnyi gas ma lnga yi dus khyod sprul las lha na gcig gis rnyed bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed de bar srung sa shig srog bdag lnga gdams bcud ma zag spu gri gsum g.yel med so sru kai dkar nag sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya gza' bdud nag ngo 'i drag bskul byad ma 'joms pa 'i tho lum rdzogasasoḥ gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya orgyan kyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag dra ma/khar chen bzas bkod 'o brda thim ñtsā kha sda khu dkar rnal 'byor kun bzang da : kha zhe med pa 'i tshig 'tshol dhame'i ro ra kha phywa li nus ldan rdo rjes phab kha 'jamasabande smon sems zhes byas bris sarba madma lam

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bstan srung gza' bdud nag po'i za ngu 'khu sdog tshar gcod bzhugs so:—4( na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: rgyaspaste mi chos skyong las la khol ba yas rtags mab maro na sum 'byung ba' tshe dgra la chosaskyong rbad pa' rjes mkhon bsdums byed dgos byu gyur na za du 'ad nyad medathabs med de phyar gces pa 'a srog ltar zungs sa ma yā ja chang skyams phud dmar gtor bshams bas sasbyangs byin rlabasanan du bya rang nyid la yi nga rgyal gyis chos skyo mdun du mngon sum gsal da nas za ngu 'ad nyidabarjod dzaḥsngon tshe phyag rdor pad 'byung dang:rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tha tshig bzhin:'bod do rbad do gza' bdud rgyal:yab yum 'khor bcas dgra la rgyug:dgra bo'i bla tshe srog gsum kun:me stag chu yis bsad bzhin thongs:don snying mngon sum bdag la sprod gal te dgra dang mkhon bsdums kyang:za ngu'i dmag tshogs slar ma ldog:dgra bo mi phyugs 'khor bcas rnams ma zad bar du za ngu gyis:dmigs pa'i chos srid tshe bsod rnams:zos lhag med pa'i sa la gtug:brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di

bzhes la sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gis:bcol ba'i phrin lasa'agrub par mdzod:ma 'da' badzra sa ma yu cesabarjod garṣa skyemasagatsang saragashegs lolalasathog med 'grub par 'gyur byan rlabasarno nus bsam mi khyab bden rdzun lag tu lo sadang gsal padma'i snying zhig zab pa'i skor thugasakyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sam yu rgya rgya rgya gza' bdud nag po'i za ngu 'khru ldog tshar gcod ོgsaso gcer rgya g.yo rgya sbas4 zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o ma gyi sgob dpon pad rtsebha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar za bza bkod pa'o brda thim snyi cha ba'ag bral ba sa bzang dang /cha lugasam ngesapadma chos/chal chol jags rgan kun nyi smras/cha phal slob bu dhas bris/sarba masgo lam/

ba rte zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: ma cig mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam: rang byung gi rgyud ka nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas lag 'chang zhes bya ba bzhugs so: pa(: dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo nargagaza/ma gzod nas rnam dag chos dbyings spros pa bral: lhun grub rol ba sku dang ye shes mdzod mi shigs spros pa bral ba'i gshis lugs la brjod bral ro mnyam chen por phyag bgyi'o: dmigs med chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams su: lhun grub ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen gyis: rol rtsal rig 'dzin 'khor gyi tshom bu la: klong chen mi zad pa yi sgo byes nas: ka dag mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang nyad las dgongs pa zang thal ngang nas rnam par gling:skem ho yab kyi dgongs pa snang srid dag pa che: yum gyi rang bzhin dmigs med zang ma thal dbyer med dgongs pa mnyam pa nyid du dag: sgra tshis bzong pa bal ba'i ye shes mis 'bar ba'i za bangar 'ams sa zam par sar: ye shes sar si cho rol bsam mi khab las lar gangal ba'i ngapal nga zam pa ra sar:

tshig brjod pa bral ba'i ye shes kyis 'bar ba'i rta bdun khams su rnam par sbar ye shes gar gyi cho rol bsam mi khyab las ldan gdul bya'i dpal du rnam par shara.ad pa ha yashe sa chaso datsangs brdal khyab spros pa bral yod pa ma yin gzugs dbyibs mtshan ma bral: med pa ma yin 'khor 'das mched pa'i gzhi phyogs dang 'dza'adu dmigs su med pa'o: 'gro dag 'ong ba gcig dang tha dad bral phyi nang bar med stong pa chen po la yid dpyod mtshan ma'i rtog dang rnam par bral rang la rang thi 'bras bu yid smon bral: chos rnams kun gyi snying po rnam par dag log 'khrul 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa: zhabrul ba'i spun thag gzhi ma bdag nyid gcig de la dengabarten lhan skyes ma rig pa: de las de 'thas kun btags 'khrul ba'i chos: shes rab chen pos rnam par brdal gyur na ma grub mi dmigs 'dzin stangs ka nas dgadapyad pa'i tshe na rdzan mtshang mthong bar 'grur: phung po rang bzhin ma grub 'ja' tshon bzhin: snang ba'i chos rnams rten cing 'brel 'byung ste: sgyu ma'i dpe bcu'i rang bzhi

༄(: rdzun pa'i chos kun btags yul dang kun byed mkhan po stong: phyi yi nam mkha' gnas tshul stong pa nyid: nang gi gshis lugs mnyam gnas brdal ba'i klong:gsang ba'i rang bzhin zang thal 'ub chub don: mi shigs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rang bzhin can: gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa'i brtan pa dang: 'khor 'das klong du bzlums pa'i bsdus zhes grags dag mnyam ye shes gshis sad rtogs pa'i dbyings: ro mnyam dgongs pa rdo rje lta bur gzhal: sna tshogs snang yang sems nyid gcig gi klong:sems rtogs 'gyu yang rig pa chos sku'i ngang brdal khyab de bzhin nyid du la zlos shig: dag pa sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes dben dngos rtog mtshan mar 'dzin pa a re 'khrul da ni theg mchog rgyal po'i ngo bor ltos: 'gro drug 'khrul 'khor snang ba chos so cog gnas 'gyur ngang las gnyis su ma grub so: gnyis med mnyam brdal sems rtog gzhi rtsa chod: gzhi med rtsa bral mthong ba jo bde sted: zag bcas dkar po'i snga ris rnam par stong nag po sdig spod gshis la dngos ma grub dge sdig

gnyis kyang 'brul rtog jo yis bzhag: bde sdug myong ba kun rdzob rang bzhin no: da ni dgongs pa zang thal nyams len la: gnad du dril bas phan bde'i nyi ma rgyas phanabyed lha zhes bya ba rtog btags tsam: gnod byed 'dre yang mtshan ma tshig tsam mo: lha 'dre zhes kyang gshis la dngos ma grub: rang rig de bzhin nyid dbyings lha ru blta gzung 'dzin gnyis rtog bar chad bdud du shes: lha sgrub 'dre bskrad mnyam nyid gnad skyongs na: zang thal kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa mthong: lugs su 'byung ba'i snangab chos so cog: lugs ldog de bzhin nyid du dag mnyam rol: ka nas dag pa'i gshisalugs 'gyur ba med: lhun gyis grub cing yongs su rdzogs pa'i don dngos po mgrub chos kyi dbyings nyid dang: rang bzhin dag tshul me long g.ya' bral bzhin: med mnyam dag mnyam dgongs par 'ub chub brdal: ma chags dri bral so sor rtog pa'idabyings: dri dag gshis grol bya ba lhun gyis grub: rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba chos kyi sku lhun grub ro mnyam chen po longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rjes mtha' bral ye shes

ba / 0 sprul ba'i sku so ma rang grol mnyam nyid brdal khyab sku: spros bral don gzigs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhal yon tan bsgrangs las 'das pa stug po bkod dga' chen chags pa bral ba mngon par bde dgos 'dod kun 'byung yon tan dpal dang ldan ma chags dri bral bde ba can gyi dbyings: las rnams lhun rdzogs dag chen bkod pa'i zhing ma rig dri sad sa ye shes yon to rgyas mi g.yo rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur ba med rtsol med yon tan lhun rdzogs rin po che: srid las skyes kyang skyon bral padma bzhin: rtsol med dgos rgu'i bya ba ngang gi 'grub: rigs ni dbyings des chings ba nyid la'o: gnyis rtog mchan mas mi bskyod brdal ba che: phyogs dang mtha' ru ma lhung rdo rje sems kun la brdal zhing 'dod 'byung ratna'i rdzong: blo rtog mtshan mas gzhal bral snang mtha' yas: dag chen don gyi gshis lugs spros las 'das: stong nyid sangs rgyas mkha' dbyings rdo rjer gnas dgos 'byung ratā'i klong la padma brdal: dag chen las kyi mkha' la sna tshogs 'gro: bde gshegs thab chub

rgyal kun klong dgu'i mdzod rang byung ye shes nyid du lhun gyis grub: lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i mkha' dbyings ni: kun la brdal zhig yongs su mnyam par grol theg pa'i dgongs don rim dgur a tir rdzogs: 'khor 'das lam gsum mnyam pa'i spyi gzhi ni: rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs 'gyur ba med lta ba gza' gtad bral ba'i stong pa che: sgom pa rang grol ye shes gnad skyongs ba: rtog pas mi spro 'jin pas mi sdud pa har sangs rang yan gsal sgrib mtshan ma bral: stong 'dzin kog pos 'go 'khor g.yang sa bral gsal zhes ched 'dzin myong zhen rnam par dben 'thibs cing nag la rmongs pa'i gti mug bral rtsal sgo 'gags pa'i had po kun gzhi'i gdangs skyam la yal ba byang ba'i rang bzhin can: rmugs la tib pa gti mug sgo 'bar ba: sdud du med pa'i 'thor ba phyogs su gyes: ha cing rgod de rlung gi rjes su 'brang gang yang nyams kyi shun pa mtha' dag ste: dbyings su gtor cing sgron gsum bral ba'i mkha': zang thal 'ub chub bde klong ngang la yan gtad so bral ba'i lta ba

tsa( mkha' ltar dag: 'dzin rtog med pa'i sgom pa zang ma thal: spang bla bral ba'i ro mnyam spyod pa che: ye shes ma 'gags sku gsum bsam mi khyab: thegamachog kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa yin: ngo bo stong ba'i sna tshogs bden chen 'gags: rang bzhin dag pa 'i gang shar sku gsum ngang: gshis lugs mnyam pa'i rtsol medasnying rje rgyas gsal ba chen po sgrib g.yog dri ma dben gnas pa'i rang bzhin ngang las g.yo ba med: rtogs pa'i yon tan gdengs bzhi'i drod 'tshal 'byol: mi g.yo bani gdong lnga 'gyengs ba bzhin: dma' ba'i theg rnams rtsol sgrub zil gyis gnon: mi gol ba ni khrims bdag mdun phebs bzhin: zhi dul bag yod lhod la dam tshigadag: khrel med gsum gyi ngang la gzu bor gnas gol shor nor gsum gegs las rnam par rgyal: 'dun ma lnga 'grub brten bya bcu gcig dang yon tan drug gi 'doda'abyung nor bu nyid: rig pa'i rtser btags ye shes chen pos mchod: ro mnyam dgongs pas gsol ba legs btabs na: chags thogs bral ba'i nyams rtogs yon tan

kun: rtsol med rab rgyas zad pa gsum par skyol bzhag thabs bzhi dang grol lugs nyi shu rdzogs: shes rab chen pos shes sgrib phra ba bcom: chos zad blo 'das chen po'abyams su klas: mi 'gyur gdod ma'i mgon po' rgyal sa zin: slar yang gdangs kyi 'khor ba dong sprugasaphyir: dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes rol ba'i sku: longs spyodardzogs dang rnam par sprul ba sogs: gdul bya'i chu snod dwangs ba'i dpal shar te: ma g.yos bzhin du gang la gang 'dul ston: gabrupa snang sgyu ma'i 'khor lo bcom byasate thim la ma rmugs nang gsal rgyal sa la: tshom bu gcig tu 'ub chub 'byams klas 'gyur: zhes gsung ston 'khor rdo rje'i sgra dang bcas: gshis gyi rgyal sar ro mnyama'ub chub so: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: e ma: rgyalaba'i dbang popadma saṃ bha wa' ma 'ongasa'agro bar thugasarje' brtse chen gyi snyi byung lag mthil bkram pa 'i gdams zab ngas 'brog mi lo tsā chosamadzod khyod la gto da du spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa 'i rin chen brda ras mdzod cig dgyes sde mo mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong la dgo sa bra mdzod ma 'o sa snyags ma surma cu kha ral dus sprul nga dang mi gzhan dpa' bo ni 'ari gas bral nus ldan 'dus

gtsa( pa rtsal gyas rted nyid la mi gzhan chos bdag rnams la 'doms bstan pa 'a ba dan phyogs bcu kun tu bsgrangs gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og man zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa 'i rten 'brel yod de bar zab bcud srungs shig spu gri gsum skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya yas snyang zags su ma shor gi dkar nag skal ldan snying ga bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gas rgyud ka nas dag pa'i sa sargyas lag 'chang zhesabya ba rdzog so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob daro na padma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi 'od 'bar nor bu g.yu byir du da ni/ 'od 'khyud shel bum 'bras bkang bcas te bskul/ 'od gsal rnal 'byor sngags nag kun bzang dang / 'od brgya'i dad ldan chos bdag dharma pa/ 'od mad sa la brten kairte rang grol zung / 'od ldan dgo sa pa 'i mdzod brtes padma dbang /'od chags thugs rjes bskul ba'i ratna sogs 'od gsal rdzogs chen la cho sa du mas bskul 'od ldan gshis sad nusaldan rdo rjesasmras 'od gsal mar me la brten — dmas bras 'od kyis 'gro khams rmongs mun sel gyur cig dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba mgi lam/
badzra 7 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: snyigs ma'i gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i tho lum ma cig khros ma nag mo'i bka' them byang bdud rtsi'i bum bcud zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

badzra: na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye sgomasagarngo mithasnyemyu mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen spros mtha' bral: lhun grub sku dang ye shes gsang ba'i mdzod bde stonga'adu 'bral med pa'i ḍakki de mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod: mi 'gyur bsam yasalhun grub gtsug lag dbus: mnyam med ston mchog gu ru thod phreng rtsal/zag med thams cad mkhyen pa'i ting 'dzin la: mi g.yo lhun 'byams chen por bzhugs pa'i tshe: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā dang: gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i skyes bubacu dang gsum: las smon 'dzom pa'i gzungs ma dang bcas te: ston 'khor phun sum tshogs par gyur ba'i skabs 'od dkar rgyal gyis gang ba'i bkra shis dus ma hwagu ru'i dgyes brtse'i rnam 'gyur gyis: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos sgo phyes: khyad par rmad byung mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i sde gdon 'dul khrosam nag mo'i chos skor gyi/bsngas pa'i las kyi rnam grang rim pa kun: bka' rtsis phyag rgyas btab so ma brjed zungs: sa ma yā: byin rlabasache zhing bar chad bsal ba'i thabs/

badzra: gdug pa kun 'dul dngos grub mchog stsol sgo: rmad du byung ba ye shes gsang ba'i lam: gang 'dus bka' rtsis btab na 'di ltar ro: cha lag las kyi pa nyi shu pa: gsol 'debs byin rlabs 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang: byin 'bebs 'od kyi drwa ba zhes su grags sgrub pa gsang ba'i rgya can rdo rje'i rtags mdun ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i lcags kyu dang: tshogs bsags gter gyi bum pa bsod nams rdzong: bskang ba beeḍūrya yi chun 'phyang dang: gter srung bskang ba phrin las lhun / grags: gnam phud gnas yul bsrung ma'i bskang ba dang: klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po'i zab sgrub dang: gsol mchod dgos 'dod kun 'byung bya ba'o: las gshin nabadug dri khol ma dang: gsol mchod dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i spu gri'o: bdud btsan nag po'i zab sgrub khrag mtsho khol: gsol mchod byad ma 'joms pa'i tho lum dang:mo nag mo'i zab sgrab dug khrag khol: gsol mchod bdud bgegs sgol ba'i sgra gri'o: gza' bdud nag po'i sgrab pa rdo rje'i rdzong: dreg bskal gsol mchod za ngu 'khya

bskang bcas:rno ba'i mde'u spu gri reg gcod bstan sngon 'gro rnam khyen lam bzang byin rlabs rdzong 'pho ba ye shes sgo 'byed tshogs bsags thabs: byin rlabs gnad bsdu rdo rje'i grong 'pho'o: gtor 'bul phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba: bstod pa dad brgya'i zer bskul bya ba'o: bskul ba dmar nag glog zhags khol ma dang: bskul ba dus bab tshig mda' dmar nag grags: pho nya dgos bskul dgra bgegs rdul brlag dang mkhyen dpang gzu dpa nga gser skyems rim pa'o: drag po'i 'dul las dam sri tshar gcod dang: 'dul dkar 'khrul snang rgyun gcod bya ba'o: mkha' 'gro'i me gtad bar chad sgo bsregs dang: gshin po rjes 'dzin thar ba'i them skas grags: lasabazhi'i sreg blugs phrin las lhun grub dang: bshags pa mun sel ye shes sgon me'o: rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba tshogs chen rab rdzogs dang: tshogs bsags bsdus pa 'dod 'byung nor bu'o: ma tshang kha bskang las rim bco brgyad pa byin rlabasadabang mchog rdo rje'i rdzong chen dang bstul zhugs gsang dbang rnal 'byor dam pa'i lam lo rgyas

badzra dad dang mos pas rgyud bskul lo gsang rgyud ka nas dag pa'i lag 'chang rgyud: don rgyud lhun gyisagrub pa thig le'i rgyud: gnyis med bde rol dga' bzhi'i 'byung khung rgyud: rmad byung rtsa rlung thig le rang grol rgyud: rgyud bzhi'i che ba bsgrags pa'i lo rgyus so lung byang mkha' 'gro'i rgyang glu zhes su grags mkha' 'gro'i dris lan nyi shu rtsa lnga pa: yongs su rdzogs te gsal bar bkod pa'o: ma brjed brda la thob cig rje 'bangs tshogs: zhes gsung thams cad rjes su yi rang ngo: ma hā gu ru'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor: slob dpon thugs dgongs gnyis su med par gyur sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: ma cig khrosam nag mo'i bka' zem byang bdud brtsi'i bum bcud rdzogasaso: gter rgya gtad rgya: sbasargya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu rgya:o rgyan gyislob dpon padma so wa'i bka': bdag 'dramakhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim:3gi: ces pa 'ad 'ang chos kya bdag popadma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang / chos kyi bdag po ral khurakun bzang bstan 'j-in dar rgyasakyisabakra shis lha reg dang tsher raku'i phreng ba

zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bdud bzhi rtsad gcod gyi gdams pa: byin rlabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod:ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud zab mo: sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

da mi na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: ཿ spo/ gzod nasarnam dag chos sku spros mtha' bral lhun grub sku dang ye shes rol ba'i mdzod smra bsam brjod bral ye shes rol ba'i gshas 'bum phrag yangs pamimakha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo ma'ongasalasacan skal bzang pho mo rnams gsang chen lam mchog rnam par spyod pa'i tshe med du ma rung sngon 'gro'i gdams pa 'di srog dang sbrel nasabartson brgyasanyamasasu longs sam yu de yangalasarim bcu gsum dag gi bstan dang po gsol ba gdab pa 'i rim pa ni sgo gsum zol zog bral ba' mo gusakyis bla ma mdun mkhar gsal la 'di skad do ku dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo lungartogs dam chos ma lus pa'i 'byung khung 'phags tshogs dge 'dun rgya mtsho yi gtsug rgyan rigs 'dus drin chen bla ma de mkhyen no:bdag rgyud byin rlobs gzung 'dzinagyi ri brnyil:chags sdang a 'thas mdud pa de grol nas tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa ru khyed mkhyen:re ltos g.yin med bla ma la rten bca' thugs rje brtse bas mi'ador bar skyongs mdzod:gnyis pa dal yor rted dka' sgom pa ni brgya la lan gcig rnyed pa yi gru bo:dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten bzang po:tshogs smon las

gtsa 'phro 'dzom pa yi legs bskyed: don ldan snying po lha chos kyis 'tsho bar dpal mgon rig 'dzin bla ma de mkhyen no: gsum pa zla ba mi rtag sgom pa ni phyi nang snodabacud sgyu ma yi 'khrul 'khor mi rtag rmi lam gar bzhin du bsgyur nas thog med dusanas bslu yun de ring bas da ni mi rtag skyo shes kyis bskul bar: mtshan ldanaskyabs gcig bla ma de mkhyen no: bzhi pa 'bor ba sdug bsngal blo sbyongs ni khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas kun: bzod med sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang rba klong: thog medadus nas mnar yun de ring bas: da nas nges par srid rtsa de chod par: bslu med gtan gyi mgon po de mkhyen no: lnga pa rgyu 'brasabasru med sgom pa ni mngar skyur sa bon btab palas 'bras smin: de bzhin dge sdig gang bsags pa'i rgyu las 'bras bu bde sdug sems kyi kyang myong nges: dge sdig ngo shes 'jug ldog rang gzab par: kun mkhyenamagon po bla ma de mkhyen no: drug pa skyabasasu 'gro ba'i rim pa ni na mo mtshog gsum smra gsum rtsa gsum gyi ngo bo: rtsol med rang byung rig pa yi zhal ras: spang blang smib g.yog

pra pagaya ngangazhas rangangarangashasalagapa5sa 8dudad skupasasu padapa/ngas bla nga shagalugadupa mamard ༄ga pyang4la /zhu sangaskudag ma mapa rnamad shaparapasrid gsum gyi btson khang: dbang med las nyon sdug bsngal gyi 'dam rdzab spyod pa'i dmus long 'gro khams de bsgral phyir zang thal rig pa mngon gyur du sgom ste donaganyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas de thob mdzod: brgyad pa mkho khrul ba'i rim pa ni 〉 stong gsum rab 'byams mjes ldan gyi bkod pa: rang lus phung khams dag mnyam gyimachod pa: semasartog rang grol rig pa yi maṇḍal: sku gsum rgyal ba sras bcasal gusa'abul: bdag sogs tshogs rdzogasasgrib pa kun dag mdzod: dgu pa tho bsarayan lag bdun pa ni dmigasamed rang grol sku gsum gyi bkod pa mngon gyur ngo mtshar dad pa yisaphyag 'tshal: 'khor 'das ro mnyam mchod sprin de gusa'abul: ma rigagazung 'dzin dri kun kyang mthol bshags: zag dang zag med dge ba la yi rang: gang 'dul theg pa'i chos sgo de phyes nas: bstan 'dzin kun kyang 'da' med du bzhugs

da 2 gsol: dge ba 'khor gsum dag pa ru bsngo 'o: phyam gcig gdod ma'i btsan sa rang zin shog rsā pa sgrob sbya samakha' 'gra'i sgom bzlasan phaṭaX bdag lus nang snod bcud kyi rol ba rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings su yal te: skad cig lhun grub gsal snang gi bkod pa: dag mnyam zhing khams rgya tshad dang bral klong:chags padma nyi zla yi gdan steng: bdag snang skad cig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang spyan gsum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno da3gyi mche gcigs: smin ma me 'bar dbu sgra yang gyen brdzes phag skad ngur ba'i sa gsum gyi gnyid skrog thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna yi 'phan 'phyang nyi zla'i snyan cha ba 'bar su legs mdzes phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod kyi gri gug g.yon pa 'khor ba 'ub chub kyi thod khrag dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams kyi rgyan spras tha mchog kha ṭaṃ mchan g.yon du brten zhing: zhabs gnyis gar gyis srid zhi yi sgo gnon: ye shes me dang 'ja' 'od kyi gur 'khrigs: snang stong gnyis med 'od sku ru ba 3

do:de yi spyi bor pad zla dang nyi steng longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje'i dbyings phag mo dmar gsal ra ga'i mdangs 'dzin ci zhal gcig mdzes 'dzum spyan gnyisamakhar gzigs shing 'od 'bar:dbu skra gyen brdzes sna ltag g.yas phag ngur:dbu rgyan cod paṇa ratna yi phreng ba gzig sham rus rgyan pad phreng dang dar dpyangs:kunardzogs phyag gnyis gri thod de bsnams shing:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur stong gsal gyi rol ba 'dzin med sgyu ma'i lha sku ru gsal gdab:de yi spyo gtsug padma dang zla steng/chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo nyid mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum zhing gzi 'bar:gcer bu mnyam bzhag dkyil drung gi bzhug shing stong gsal sprobasdu bral ba yi ngang nas 'dzin bral rig pa'i rang mdangs su bskyed do:bdag nyid khrosama'i thugs ru nyi steng rdo rje sngon po nas tsam gyi lte bar:nyi zla kha sbyor ga'u yismrabs su:rig pa hūṃḥl sngags phreng gis bsgor ba'i 'od kyis bdag sogs sems can rnams kun gyi:las nyon bag chags gnyis snabhe gi dri ma:sngar ma me 'phrad ji

btsam bzhin du bsregs nas: ga ga ma'i lha sku ji bzhin du mjal nas wa sngags chos sku'i rol pa ru 'byams klas: cha badzra kro ti ka li baṃ0 nyariḥniḥ4sarba pā paṃshirnyi ku ru ye swā snya yeng med sto 'jin gzer gdab ci khrub bzla rigs bdag phag mo'i thugs ka yi 'od kyis: bskul te bdag snang 'od dmar gyi gong bur 'phos te phag mo'ithugs klong du bsdus so: slar ni bdag nyid wa ra ti'i thugs gar 'od lnga 'khyil klong baṃ dmar la sngags kyi: phreng bas bskor bas nad gdon dang sdig sgrib: nyes lhungakun kyang sbur ma dang me bzhin: bsregs nas stong gsal 'od sku ru bskyed la lha sngags chos sku'i rol pa ru 'byams klas: ma badzra wa ra hi baṃ nyariḥniḥ4sarba pā paṃ shirnyiku ru ye swā shā lha sngags ting 'dzin gsal ba ci nusabazla rigs bdag kun tu bzang mo yi thugs ga'i 'od mthing gis bskul bdag snang yang ltem zhu: dbyings yum la bstimasan bzang mo'i thugs gar: 'od thig kong du aḥyig la sngags kyis: bsgor ba'i 'od kyis gzung 'dzin san bcom nas: 'dzin med lha ska'i rol pa ru 'byams klas

gang shar rig pa'i ye shes su dag mnyam: snang grags rig gsum lha sngagasakyi ngang nas:yin badzra samanta bhā tra 83 mgayozang thalarang na ci 'grub bzla 'khor 'dasadag mawa gyi slogo rig pas 'phro rtog lasapo gi sgong rgya garṣa bgo gam med rang grol na da'iglu gyer ro dharmā kā ya saṃ bho kwa ya nirma kā ya sa ma ti sirnyi a a āḥ mthar ni smra bsam brjod med chosasku'i ngang som ra grol ngang lakhrumasasu klas rsā༄ga bla ma'i rnal yor rim pa ni phaṭa: rang snang dag pa chos nyid kyi klong du: bde chen 'pho 'gyur bral ba yi zhing khams: brda rtags bkod pa phucatshogs kyi dbus su: ma chags pad zla nyi ma yi gdan steng: rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar gsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum zhing 'od 'bar: gri gug thonga'adzin gar stabs su bzhugs shing: dar dang rus pa ratna yi rgyan 'phyang: dmar ser ral pa g.yas 'khyil gyi gdengs ga sna tshogs padma mdzes pa yi byas shing: spyamegasum mkhar gzigs dga' bde yi nyams rgyas: mdun mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le yi dbus su: rgyal kun 'dus zhal drin chen gyi bla ma: mtshung bralasar ha pa yi rnar

da pa rol:dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug gi nyams rdzogs:zhal gcig phyag gnyis he ru ga'i cha lugs thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna yi cod paṇa dmar sera.e rag ljang sngon gya dbya ngas pa:sgom thag dkar khra mdzes ldan gyi rna cha:rus pa'i rgyan drug ratna yi do shal:ma lus kun rdzogs rol stabs su bzhugs shing phyagagayas ḍa rus rtsa gsum kun sdud cing:g.yon pas bhantas dngos grub kyi gter stsol:snang dang stong pa gnyis med kyi skur gsal:dwangs gsal 'od klo lo paṇa dang riga'adzin sangs rgyas byang sems rje 'bangs kyi tshom bu:ma 'dres 'ub chub chen po ru gsal gdab:kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje yi sa bon rnams las 'od zer dkaradamar mthing spros te:rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun spyan drangs gnyis med du ma ro gcig tu bsres te:phaṭaḥngo mtshar dag pa sku gsum gyi dbyings nas gnyis rtog mtshan ma'i ma gos pa'i bde gshegs:sras bcas ye shes rnam rol ni mtha' yas:ma lus mi lus lus pa yang med par:gnas 'dir gdung ba'i spran 'dren

gyis 'bod na: sgrub mchog bu la dbang bzhi de bskul phyir: rdo rje'i gar gyis myur ba ru byon nas bdag rgyud smin cing grol ba ru mdzod cig: gu ru sar ha pa sarba sirnyi hūṃ:smo gusalo med na ci 'grub bzla bceganyisagasalab gdab pa'i rim pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gnasaka dag 27gasku'i pho brang nas don skye med ston pa rdor 'chang la: bdag rnam gsumadad pas gsol ba 'debs yul zhabrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs: rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bu'i nyams rtogs thon tan rgyas gyur cig gnas lhun grub longasasku'i pho brang nas don 'gags med ston pa dga' rab la bdag rnam gsum dad pasagasol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul sngang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs zang thal gyi rig

gas pa rtogs pa'i mthus:sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis:bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig:gnasartsol bral sprul sku'i pho brang nas:don dmigs med ston pa shrī seng la bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs:yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos:donabadag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi:chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs:zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus:sems 'dzinapa grol bar byin gyi rlobs:rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig:gnas rang gsal dag pa'i pho brang nas:don mkhas grubamañdzu mi tra la:bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs:yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos:don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs gzhi ka dag shesarab zab mo yi:chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs:zang thal gyi rig pa stogs pa'i mthus:sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs:rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin

khas kyis: bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig gnas rang byung durakhrod chen po nas: dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug sa ra har: bdag rnam gsum dadapasagasol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dresamakhyen par byin gyi dzābs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bu'i nyams rtogasayon tan rgyas gyur jeg: gnasamached rten bdebyed brtsegs pa nas ma mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang chen la: bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs yul 'khrul snang gzung dang dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogasapa'i thathus sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs: rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas byur cig: gnasarnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang

ra na nas: rje o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs yul zhabrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ches: don bdag med rtogasapar byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyirlobs: rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig: gnas dag mnyam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal grub dbang rje 'bangasanyer lnga la bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shesarab zab mo yi chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byinarlabs kyis: bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig: gnas thab chub mnyam pa'i pho brang nas: dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung la bdag rnam gsum dad pas

gsol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen parabyin gyi rlobs zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs: rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyasagyur cig gnas la stod ting ri'i bla 'khor nas: pha dam pa sangs rgyas rgya gar la: bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzinapa'i chos don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig: gnasazangasari mkhar dmar dgon pa na: mamakha' 'gro lab kyi sgol ma la: bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs: yul gsal snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs

rapho gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig gnas gsang chen yang dben dam pa nas: dpal grub dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje la/bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi/chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bu'inyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig: gnas brtul zhugasadaben pa'i yang khrod na dpal rnal 'byor bdud 'dul rol rtsal la bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba'adebs yul 'byul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi

rlobs zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs: rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyuracig gnas rang snang don gyi 'og min na: dpal gar dbang bdud 'joms rdo rje la: bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzinapa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus/sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs: rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig: gnas mi shig dag pa'i pho brang nas: dpaladrin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la: bdag rnam gsum dad pas gsol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs gzhika dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dres mkhyen par byin gyi rlobs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs: rje bla ma bsgom

bsto pa'i byin rlabs kyis bu'i nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas gyur cig: gnas rtse mo rnam bkod pho brang nas: don rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma la bdag rnam gsumadad pas gsol ba 'debs: yul 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: don bdag med rtogs par byin gyi rlobs: gzhi ka dag shes rab zab mo yi: chos ma 'dresamakhyen par byin gyi rlobs: zang thal gyi rig pa rtogs pa'i mthus: sems 'dzin pa grol bar byin gyi rlobs: rje bla ma bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis bu'i nyams rtogasayon tan rgyas gyur cig: lus dal 'byor don ldan chos bzhin spyod srid mtsho las sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs: las mi rtag sgyu ma'i rol bar mthong: don sgrub tshugs zinapar byin gyi rlobs: srid 'khor ba sdug bsngal rol bar mthong: don zhen log skye bar byin gyis rlobs: las rgyu 'bras bsgru med rgyal ba'i bka': las blang dor mkhasapar byin gyis rlobs yul nyon mongs dug lnga dgra ru shes sems chags sdang zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: gnas mi med dben pa'i ri khrod du chos rnam dag 'grub

par byin gyis rlobs: yul nges med ri khrod zin pa dang: don brtul zhugs nus par byin gyis rlobs dbyings stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gshis: don lta ba rtogasapar byin gyis rlobs: blo las 'das zang thal rig pa'i zhal: don ji bzhin bsgom par byin gyis rlobs: re dogs kyi mdud rgya grol skyen gyis: las spyod pa mtharaphyin byin gyis rlobs gang shar kyang rang grol don rtogs mthus sku bzhi yi dpal du byin gyis rlobs 'pho med kyi rgyal sa zin par shog zang thal ba'i rig sku jibazhin mjal: gshisagrol gyi kun bzang sathob shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: brgyagasum dab bzhi len pa 'i rim pa ni phaṭaḥ rje btsun grub mchog sa ra ha mkhyen no: bdag gi lusadangartsa yi sgrib kun dag: sku gsang bum pa'i dbang mchog gis smin cing sprul pa'i sku yi rnam rol du 'phos te rnam smin rig 'dzin thob pa de e ma: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa rjebatsun grub mchog sa ra ha mkhyen no: bdag gi ngag rlang smib pa kun dag nas: gsung gsang bde ba'i dbang mchog gis smin cing: longs sgod rdzogs sku'i rol ba ru sad

ra pa de tshe dbang rig 'dzin thob pa de e ma: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rje btsun grub mchog sa ra ha mkhyen no: bdag gi yid dang thig le'i sgrib bcom nas: thugs gsang shes rab ye shes kyisasmin grol: chos sku'i rnam par sad cing rang 'phos te: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin thob pa de e ma: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rje btsun grub mchog sa ra ha mkhyen no: bdag gi sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sgrib bcom: ka dag tshig gi dbang mchog gis smin nas: ngo bo nyid sku'i rol pa ru sad de lhun grub rig 'dzin thob pa de e ma: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa rje btsun grub mchog sa ra ha mkhyen no: ja ma'i dgongs rgyud byin rlabs dang dngos grub 'od phung mthing nag rnam pa ru byung nas bdag gi snang gsum shes sgrib de bcom nas: rig pa rtsal gyi dbang mchog gis smin grol: dgongs pa zang thal ji bzhin par rtogs cing: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku gsang du 'phos te mchog gi rig 'dzin thob pa de e ma phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bdag snang 'od zhu ja ma ru bsnga'o: thugs dgongs dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur te rmad byung kun bzang rgyal sa de

zin zhid:'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa yi dpal thob dag mnyam thab chub chen po ru 'byamasaklas:a a āḥphaṭa:cesabarjod kadagasto mtha' bralaba'i pa dbyingasarigazunga'ajug pho po'i don la blta de ni ja ma'i dgongasargyud byin rlabasakun ring du mi thogasaslob ma nyid la 'pho nyamasartogasapon ma yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas phyi nang gsang ba'i bar ma zhi ba dang salam mthar phyin zung 'jug 'ja' sku 'grub sla ba'i don chen 'grub pa snyang po' chos skal ldan rnamasakyi brtson pasanyamasasu longs g.yel ba thang lhod ma byed rigasokyi bu 'ad 'dra' nyams len srid pa gsum na dkon bden rdzun lag tu longathadang nge shesagasal skal med lag tu ma shor3/rgya e ma rgyal ba' dbang po pa dma sa bha wa'i ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen po yis snyong gi yang bcud gdamasapa med byung ba grub chen 'brog ma lo tsā khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dusal mabab pas rin chen brda la thob cig sar rdzu mdo khamasardo rje' rdzong der dgongasabra thob gter bdag bzang phyir sgog bdag bzhi laganyer thub par srungasashig badzra sam mā skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya nusaldan 'du pa rtsal gyi dpaladu shog bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'byung gyur cig sam yu rgya rgya rgya jon 'gro rnamamakhyen lam bzang rdzogasaso gter rgya gto rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slobadapon padma sgobha
