ra ma wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o bdo tham snyi dad brgya' nyi 'od 'bar ba kun bzang dang /dad dam gtsang ba dharma kumud pa/dad ldan dharma kaitta smon sems zung /dad brtson ratna sar la sogs pas/dad rten bla ma' rnal 'byor yang yang bskul/dad pa des bslangs mkha' 'gro'i gas mdzod brda/dad zas gshin zas spyod pa nus ldan pas/dad dam gtsang ba' nga na legs pa ra phab/dad ldan yi ge' risabyed smon sems sogs/dad pa'i 'khor los 'gro khams dab bsgyur shogasarba maṅga lam/

gas zab gsang rdo rje snying po las ma rtsig khros ma nag mo yi 'apo ba ye shes sgo 'byed dang tshogs bsags byin rlabs bang mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye 4 za 6lo/1cas 111zopadma' rgyud 'dzen skal bzang pho mo rnams yang gsang rdo rja' lam la sas pa' tsha snyang dang 'dra ba'i man ngag dran grol lam 'pho ba ya shes sgo chud zhesabyabam sam mā lusasosadal phab bde ba'i stan la gnas skyabasa'agro yosaskyed sngon du 'gro ba yi phaṭa:snang srid bde chen dag pa mkha' spyod zhing:ngo mtshar yum chen lnga yi dal dbus su ma chags ge sar mdangs ldan pad zla'i steng:bdag snang mi shigs ye shes mkha' 'gre'i sku:ljang gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum sgeg bzhad:dar dang rus pa ratna'i rgyan gyis spras:bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gri gug thod khrag brten:'ja' 'od lnga ldan klong na dwangs ba'i sku:snang stong 'dzin med sgyu ma'i rol par bskyed:sku dbus a wa dru ti bzhin bzang ma dkar la dmar mdangs mthing ga'i rnam rol can:drang srab snam gsal mtshan nyid bzhi dang lngan:yar stsa bde chen 'khor lo thal gyi

har: mar sne rkang mthil gnyis su tshigs kyi 'gags: gnas lngar rtsa 'khor thig le phra mo klong: yum chen lnga nyid dkar ser dmar ljang mthing: rusapa'i rgyan rdzogs brtul zhugs rol ba'i tshul gar stabs gri gug thod khrag dku la brten: stong gsal 'dzin med sgyu ma'i rol par bskyed: gtsug dor 'khor lo 'og min chos sku'i zhing:ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa lhun gyis grub: rkang mthil thabs shes thig le nyung 'bru tsam: dkar dmar mdangs ldan nyi zla'i dal steng brten: 'khor lo lnga brgyud gtsug tor zhing bkod rgyal phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de nasagasol ba 'debasapa' rim pa ni kyeḥ skye med chosasku kun tu bzang po dang: 'gagasamed long spyod rdzogs mdzad rdo rje 'chang: rtsol med sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' la: gsol ba 'debs so 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes: mkhasagrub dbang phyug shrī seng ha dang: rdzogs chen ston pa dga' rab rdo rje rtsal o rgyan slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la: gsol ba 'debs so 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes: grub brnyes dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā dang: bdud 'dul rdo rje dpa' bo rol ba rtsal:

sa'i bdud 'joms gling pa rgyal kun gsang mdzod 'dzin: gsol ba 'debs so 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes don gnyis mthar phyin rtsa ba'i ja ma dang dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i zhal bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍākki'i dkyil 'khor la gsol ba 'debs so 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes: ma dag sgyu ma'i 'dzin zhen rang sar grol 'pho chen ye shes rdo rje'i gsang lam la: brten nas 'og min dag pa'i zhing dbus su khyad chos drug ldan rgyal sar byang chub po: phaṭa: ces 'i sgra bdun dag pa ra bzlasate mkha' 'gro lnga yi gsang lam brgyud te gcug tor 'khor lo 'og min gyi zhi la spar te gtad med rang grol rol bar 'byams su klas de ltar sbya ba'i gnad la ma brten pa ra dus la bab tshe grol bar mi 'gyur ro rtson 'grus drag posatha lhod med — ra sgom nam zhig 'pho ba'i gas pam maro na du 'gyur sam yu de nas tshogs bsag sbyin gtong rim pa ni phaṭa: dbyings las rig pa khros mar bzhedas zhal phyag rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs phyag g.yas gi gug god tsam gyis: bem po lpags phyes sa gzhi khyab: slar shang bam sdi thod pa brag: rang byung thod pa'i byed pur bab: de nang gzugs kyi

phung po brten: a thung ram yig rlung gi bskul: ye shes me 'bar gzugs phung zhu: sbu ba phyir lud zhing chen steng sha ri khrag mtsho rus gram khrod: skang tshil lha ba mar khu 'byil: sbu ba 'dod yon nam mkhar mnyam: go ro tsa na byang chub sems ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par bskyil ma uhūṃ gis byin gyis rlabs: ha ho trī yis 'dzad med spel o uhūṃ ha ho hrī: lan gsum ḍa dril sgra 4 'di skad do phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa sangasargyasachosadang dge 'dun dang: ja ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sogs: dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron rnams la: mchod sprin mi zad rgyan 'khor 'bul phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' chen brgyad: phyogs skyong bcu dang 'jigs byed dgu: dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi 'bul: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon dang bgegs rigs stong phrag brgya cu dang: 'byung po log 'dren tshogs rnams la: 'dod yon lnga lngan phubhe po 'bul phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dmyal ba yi dgas dud 'gro dang wa dang wa min bar do ba: khams gsum sems can thams cad la:

sa na gces 'dzin bcom te sbyin par 'bul: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa khas zhan dbang chung nyam thags dang: zha long 'on lkugs tshogs rnamasal mchod sprin mi zad rgyan 'khor 'bul: rkyen bral bde ba mchog ldan gyur: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lus kyi mchod sbyin phul ba'i mthus: ja ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig yi dam lha tshogs mnyesagyur cig mkha' 'gro dam can bskang gyur cig: bgegs rigs len chags tshim gyur cig: rigs drug 'dod pa bskang gyur cig: thams cad ngom shing tshim gyur nas bde ba mchog dang ldan par shog phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun: sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig pa bzhin: chos sku spros mtha' bral bar brdal dmigs med brjod bral chen por āX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de ltar gnad dang lngan pa yi tshogasardzogasasgrib pa dag pa da zab lam 'pho ba'i sgo 'byed nas don gnyis mthar phyin sangasargyaso'agyur the tshom med do sa ma yā e ma rgyal ba' dbang po padma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs rje brtse ba yis snying da 'dra ba'i ya zab rmad byung ba 'brog li lo tsā chos mdzod 'dzin la gtad da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pa 'i rin chen brda la

thob cig sa ra dzre ma 'ongasasnyigasam sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad na bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel lasacan ral khur chosabadag rnams spel rong chen bcu gsumomang gsang lam la'agod 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungasashig srog bdag lnga skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum lasacan bu la sprod cig king dkar nag sam ku rgya rgya rgya 'phob yeshesasgo 'byed rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gye slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gza bkod pa'o brda thim snyi cog bzhag rnal 'byor kun bzang bstan 'dzin dang / cog ger gnas pa'i chos bdag dharma sogs/ cog sgar ba ya slob ma du mas ngor/ cog cog chor mgo chen bsas sasmras/ cog sprang jo bdesgon semasazhesabyas bris/ sarba maṅga lam/

‘ btsasdo: dam chos thug gter 'dus pa lasaḥgater srung sha za mched gsum gyiḥmangon rtogs gnam lcags spu gri bzhugs soX —8sde: na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni yaḥ 41rgyushā chen shan du 'jig pa'i dur khrod du phya nang gsang ba' dam rgya bsams na' thod nang du sha khrag gas brgyan pa 'i gtor ma zur gsum — ཿmnyen lhug gsum dngagator chung bzhi nyer sbyod 'dod rdzas bā ril sbung dar thag gdug sogs mdzas pa ra bya dkyal 'khor dbus su bkod pa ra bya sman raka gtor ma rnam lnga bkrams sgrub jo bsangs sbyangs nan du bya ra nyad bdud 'dul drag moyi bskyed rim ngang nasa'adi skad do bhyoX rang mdun me rlung dud sprin 'tshub ma'i dbusaḥrakta rba rlabs 'phyo ba'i klong dkyil duḥsaphuḥbhyoḥlas byung ba'i ma chen moḥsha za ḍakki misnying rlon 'phrog maḥkhrag mdog zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bzod dka'i nyamasaḥspyan bsgrad mche gtsigs zhal nas ha ha dgodaḥkhrag ral gzings shing dug khrag char ba'abebasaḥdam rtags dpral bar me tog tshom bu'i dbusaḥgaser gyi rdo rje phyed pa 'od zer 'baraḥsnyan cha du las byas shing rin chen brgyanaḥmi lpags rlon pa sku yi rgyan

du gsolaḥ mgo phreng sbrul chun dar kyi dpya ngas pa mdzesaḥ nu ma phrag bkal 'o khrag rgyun 'beb cingaḥ zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur glog sprin dbus na 'gying phyag g.yas dgragasod spu gri ngar ma phyaraḥ g.yon pas zhing bcu'i don snying zhal la stobasaḥ 'jigs rngams srin mo 'bros 'dra'i sku ru gsalaḥ g.yas su phyag bsnyen chu srin gdong can maḥsmug nag khros ma lcags kyu bhan dmar 'dzinaḥ sbrul dang sgyu ma slog gi zhags pas brgyanaḥ g.yon du bka' nyan dred gyi gdong pa canaḥ dmar gsal chags nyams rgyas shing 'bru tshigs bltaḥ phyag g.yas kha ḍi g.yon pas nad skyal bsdamasaḥ rus rgyan mgo phreng me yi 'od zer 'baraḥ gnyis ga'i zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur bam gdan rol shar du dur byed nag mo mun pa'i mdogaḥ phag dkar mi ro'i rgyan cha byas pa khridaX dgra sgog gcod pa'i sha za 'bum gyis bskoraḥ gtso mo'i bka' nyan bstan la lhag par gdung lho ru kha kha mthing nag bya rog gdong spel ser nad kyi sgral chen bkal ba khridaḥ dgra snying 'byin pa'i sha za 'bum gyis bsgoraḥ ma chen bka' la nyan zhing dam la gdungaḥ

gtsasdo 7 nub tu hu lu sgrug nag 'ug gdong maḥ shin tu khros nyams ser 'phar mtshon bkal khridaḥ dgra dbugs sdud pa'i sha za 'bum gyis bskoraḥ kun kyang gtso mo'i bka' nyan phrin las sgrubaḥ byang du he le ljang nag spyang gdong masaḥ lce spyang khyi nag bla gsod mang po khridaḥ dgra bo rdul brlag sha za 'bum gyis bskoraḥ thams cad bstan la gdung zhing dam la gnas ma chen sgog sngags kun gyi sa bon lasaḥ 'od 'phros bde chen dbang gi gzhal yas nas dur khrod rakta'i rba klong 'khrigs pa lasaḥ ma chen 'khor bcas sngon gyi tha tshig bzhinaX dgyes pas zhal bzang brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur bcasaḥ dam tshig bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib bstimaḥ rang sgog 'od kyis pho nya zil gyis mnanaX de dag srog snying bdag la rab 'dus teḥ bka' nyan 'bangs byed ci bcol sgrub par bsamaḥ bhyo ma hūṃ tsa dur mu kha snying kha rag mo dung dung 'dus 'dus dzaḥ smrabacad dam rgya byas te zhag bdun bsgrub sgo brdu thug chom sgra 'byu me stag 'phro bska gsol mnyesapa 'a thabasal nan du 'badaḥsam yuḥ spyo ma hūṃ tsitā yakra sim sim atsica sirnyi sta ཿ dam rgya byasate zhag lngar

bzla par brtson bud med tshogasa'adu rab la zhal gzigasathob sam yuḥ bhyo ma hūṃ snying kha rasmo yasmo zlog bhyoḥ gas rtagasabyu tshe 'di nyid bzla pa'i thub sam yaḥ bhyo ma hūṃ ḍakki kwa li rkang pa ye yi dgral theb sbor dzaḥ ga bdun bzlasapasadagra ba'i steng du 'gro sam ya bhyo ma hūṃ lcagasathig khol bur phobaḥ ming ka dur bkram dzaX zhi la nag mo dun dzaḥ sa ma ya raku gho hanya jagasa'adishub bur brgya rtsa bzlo bong khrag gzha la dur sol 'jog dpa 'a bo bsad pa 'i rka gis brngan bden pa brdar bsadagra meng de sha za mkha' 'grosaye ger bra bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsalaḥ sam yaḥ brtel ba za ngu dragabaskang 'bul dgra dpu pha lam yin kyang brlag nang du ma bzhin gdung sems che 'di sgrub yon tan bsam ma khyab sam ā skabasasu sngagasakyi kha nyi 'bul zhang bstod pa niḥ hūṃ bhyoX padma'i zab gter bstan pa'i gnyer skyong zhingaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs gcig puḥ dgra la gshe zhing bgegs la za rngamasacheḥ dug gsum rtsad gcod sha za mkha' 'gror bstodaḥ de ltar sha za sbunagasum gya srog sgrub tsitta dmar po 'ad gcig brgyud lasani 'chor ma ru spel rgya che na bka' chad 'byung mkha' 'grosan ldog rang la 'bebs de phyir bsdamasaspel mkha par gyisaḥ sam yaḥ rgya rgya rgya e maḥshin tu zab pa

la/tsasdo: thugathakyi bcud bstan sru drag sngags lasakyi mtha'aḥrnal 'byor bstan pa 'dzan la spel rang 'dod gsod gcod mkhan la sba bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug dpal du shog sam ya rgya rgya rgya gu hye bdo thim snyi zhes pa 'di 'ang lu zin kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas nas skul ngor kho bo bdud 'joms nam mkha'i rdo rjes man nga ga zab mdzod kyi sgrom rgya las zhal bshus te dag pa ra pha ba pa 'a ya ge pa na lu zin pa dma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bgyisapa dge legs 'phel sarba mape lam/

ge rdo dag studra las ༷chos skyongs dgra bla'i bskul byang bsdus pa glogs zhags 'khyugs ma bzhugs soḥ'o na mo gu ra weḥ ma cas dmar gtor ༅mas la khrugs gamasabya rol lo sgra sbar ra glu 'a sa bsaḥm g.yel dgra bla mthu bo cheḥm g.yel chos skyongasadrag /dro canaḥm g.yel dpal mgon drag shul bdagaX ma g.yel chos skyongs dam tshig canaḥbasgolas myur mthu ldan gdung sems cheḥdapal ldan brag lha mgon po dang thugs kyi sras mchog yang 'khor dgu blon po sdong ra dgra 'dul rtsalaḥbatsun mo g.yu lcam be ta btsunaḥlha sman bdun cu rtsa drug bcasaḥbaskul lo rbad do las la ya chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥmagyogs pa chen cing rno mchen thogasaḥmathu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byungaḥdo nub nam gung tshun chod la bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaX ming gis 'bod cing ska nas 'thenaḥbla dang srog dbugs dwas gcig drongasaḥsmo 'bogs brang bsang cho nges chugaXdrag rtsal khyad chos mi

g.yel ba'iḥ brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas ni gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaX mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaXbaswo lasal myur ba'i drag rtsal can myes po rma rgyal spom ra dang 'khor tshogs stong dang dgu brgya poḥ lcam sring sum cu rtsa drug dang lha sman lha mo lnga bcu brgyadaḥ yang 'khor bsam mi khyab dang bcasaḥ bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥ mgyogs pa zhen cing rno mtshon thogasaḥ mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byung do nub nam gung tshun chod la bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaḥ ming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'thenaḥ bla dang sgog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chug drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'iḥ brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas niX gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzod brde gnyan nasalha grogasabartse ba poḥ dge bsnyen che grags g.yu yi rtseḥ san po bzhi dang sdong ra brgyadaḥ gtso brgyad g.yog khri sprul ba 'bumaḥ thams cad nyid kyi cho rol steḥ bka' nyan

sgo sprul pa yang sprul bcasaḥ bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥ mgyogs pa zhen cing rno mtshon thogasaḥ mthu rtsal bskyed la drag byerdodo nub nam gung tshun chod laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo deḥ nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaḥ ming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'thenaḥ bla dang sgog dbugs dus sadrongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chugaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'i brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas ni gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyamabazhes la ming med mdzodaḥ ba༄ dam chig gcig tu bsre ba moḥ snyi nam dpal gyi dbang phyug rgyalaḥ grogs mdzad ma chen bcu gnyis dngaḥ lcam mo bdun brgya nyi sdolha sring gangs dkar phyug mo da ཿ nye bstod mched lnga yang 'khor tshogasaX bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥ mgyogs pa zhen cing rno thogs mthu rtsal bsted la drag shul byungaḥ do nub nam gung tshun chod laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo deḥ nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaX ming gis 'bod cing sga

'thenaḥ bla dang sgog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chug drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'i brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas niḥ gtor maskyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥbaspo bka' nyan lasakyi pho nya baḥ ri bzang rdza bkra 'phan phyug rtsalaḥshan pa rdo rje khyung drag dang pargyal 'phan phyug btsan mched bdunaḥ tha tshigs su 'dzin stag rtse dngaḥ las myur brag dkar khra phyug 'phanaX bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chosasheg sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥmagyogs pa zhen cing rno mtshon thogasaḥ mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byungaX do nub nam gung tshun chod laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaḥming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'thenaḥ bla dang sgog dbugs dus gcig drongs: spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chugaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'i0 brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas niḥ gtor ma stems dang dgra bo bcas mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥbazwaḥ dgebasnyen dam can rdo rje legasaḥ mched 'khor sum brgya drug

sgo cu'i sdeḥ mgar nag spun lnga khyung 'phan rtsalaḥ nor spel las myur lha rtse dngaḥ tho len stag dkar shing lha moḥ ko shing jo ti dmar nag sogasaḥ bskul lo bod bye rdo sa la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥ mgyogs pa zhen cing rno mtshon thogasaḥ mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byungaḥ do nub nam gung tshun chod laX bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaḥ ming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'thenaX bla dang sgog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chugaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'iḥ brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas niḥ gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥbasaḥ rgyal dbang padma'i tha tshig 'dzinaḥ zo dor rnga la stag rtse dpalaḥ dgyes bskyed dngul dkar mdangs bzang maḥ dge bsnyen g.yu yi phreng ba canaḥ nor bdag sil bo sil dmar dang0 a ti mthon po she ne dpalaX basmral lo rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥ mgyogs pa zhon cing rdo mtshon thogs mthu rtsal bsted la drag shul byung do nub

nam gung tshun chod laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo deḥ nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyang ming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'thenaḥ bla dang sgog dbugs dusagacig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chugaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'i brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas niḥ gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥ bswoḥ la rgang mthon poganyan gyi rigasaḥ spor bo gdong la brten pa'i btsan ri rgyal phyug mo bdud kyi steḥ gangasabazang mtsho mig klu yi dpalaḥ lcagasaganyan stags gsum rtse 'dzin rgyal gser gzheng khra mor zhal phyogs kun bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaX mgyogasapa chen cing rno mtshon sgogs mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byungaḥdo nub nam gung tshun chod la bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye'am reng ba gar gnasakyangaX ming gis 'bod cing skra nas2thenaḥ bla dang sgog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chugaḥ drag rtsal khyad chosami g.yel ba'iḥ brngan pa'i dpa' skyemasadam rdzas niX gtor ma

'o/ skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥbago bkra shis rdzongs chen sa spyod gnas mdzod lnga gsang ba'i dpal drug dngaḥ bco1)rdo che ba'i khams srid skyongasaḥ dpa' bo'i rang bzhin thabs la mkhasaḥshes rab mi mo gsang spyod 'byed rdo rje'i rgyugs ging skar ltar 'khrigasaḥ ma tshogs pho nyagayos dang bcas bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaX mgyogs pa chen cing rno mtshon thogasaḥ mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byung do nub namagung tshun chod la bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo deḥ nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaḥ ming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'thenaḥ bla dang srog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chugaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'iḥ brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas niḥ gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcas mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥb༄3 dang po'i mdangs 'char sbas pa'i yulaḥ 'go grogs brtse ba'i pho nya baḥ pha ri g.yas nas bya ra byed tshu ri g.yon nas mel rtse mkhasaḥ na ba spangs nas

gso byed 'gyedaḥ rdza brag khrod nas srung skyobs mkhanaḥ 'babs pa chu las phrin las myuraḥ skye ba shing nas brtse gdungs cheḥ 'bod tshe snyan gsang bskul las myuraḥ dam la gdung zhing bsgrub la brtseḥ mtha' mi'i gnya' gnon rang srid skyongasaḥ byams la dgyes shing rtsub la khro smug po gdongs gi lha mgon che gzi bor gnas pa yongs la brtseḥ dam can pho nya g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ bskul lo rbad do las la yaX chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaḥ mgyogs pa chen cing rno mtshon thogasaḥ mthu rtsal bskyed pa drag gul byungaḥ do nub nam gung tshun chod laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo deḥ nye'am reng ba gar gnas kyangaḥ ming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'azenaḥ bla dang srog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chug drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'iḥ brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzasaniḥ gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaX bcol ba'i phrin las tha tshig bzhinaḥ ma g.yel myur du grub par mdzodaḥ cesabaskul ga' ma dgra phyogasardeb dmagasabaskul 'ad la nan du bya rang nyid

——4 lhar gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer rdo rje'i rang bzhin spros de pho nya rnams la phogaḥ sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas ki bswo cha sgra dang bcas deX dgra dpung la sna tshogs kyi char phab nas thal ba rdul phran bzhin tu brlag laḥ gzas pa po ming med du btang bar bsam moḥ dmod bor sgra sprugasathal mo brdab dar nag g.yab la bskul 'bod byaḥdagrang dpung rdul brlag 'gyur ze tshom re da do sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ lcam mo g.yu yi ral ba 'bru gcig mas brda tshag ra las bskul don tshag 'di bkrol bstan da 'gro la gsosasman 'byung phyir bkod dge bsaphan 'byung gyur cigaḥ sarba ma lam /
——rjo dag snang lasaḥdapal ldan drag shul bdag po lcam dral dgra bla'i dpang bstod slung rta 'bul ba bzhugs soḥ

—13 na mo gu ra leḥrten 14ji dpalaldan dgabla'i dmag tshogs rnams ngo so mtho snyo phrin las kunaḥthogs med yad bgo grub pa'i phyir dpang bstod slung rta ka 'dzug bstanaḥs ma yāḥde ya rasa'ajam dri bral ro ra rin chen lnga dang bzang po drug bsresapasamatshal snag gang rung gis ba dan bkra shisabacugasum pa ཿzhal shes ltar du mdza par bkod phun tshogs gza' skar 'phrod 'dzom nyinaḥrol mo sna tshogs sgra snyan smirarna tsur char bzar ting 3dzan bstan shugs sel sa na nga dgyes 'bye ro la mi rta rgyan 2do gas go marga pung ma rab brjod cing mthun 'jug gas bas du da spros la phye ma — bamaḥ'abyu sman sna tshogasachag kya gad ba shel tshag khri dkar stong nag bsags dar za sna lnga'i 'phan yab 'dzug dpa' bo skyes pa'i bas 'bod 'ur rnal 'byor snyan pa 'i glu dbyang gisaḥ.e ma nga5nasaspros bral chos dbyings nam mkha' la ༷lhun grub rten 'byu sgyu 'phrul mdzod chen poḥthogs med mos mtshor mnyam pa'i ltad mo'i dpalaḥnub med gaṅga'i rgyun bzang 'dod 'jo'i sprinaḥstong gsum mi mjed khamasakun yongs spad pa'i dpal lngan mgon po dgra bla'i dmag tshogs kyisaX dgyes bskang dpang bstod rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyar sngagasadrug phyag drug a ka ro yis spel baspo

—6rdo dgongs sngon beeḍūrya zhun ma'i dkyil 'khor laḥ dbyar rnga stong khyab sgras bskul yangs pa yis zlos gar bsgyur ba thabs shes gnyis su medaḥ mgon po dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes byir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs 'pho med rdo rjer mnyam pa'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ lha mi 'bral ba med pa'i ka ba 'dzugaḥ phri ba yongs su gang ba'i phywa g.yang khugaḥ snyan grags phyogs med khyab pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ mi mjed phyogs khyab bkra shis dpal dbyings suḥ mun sel snang ba'i sgon me lha'i nor buḥ nyon mongs gdung sel tsant+ra thab shes zungaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥbaskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangasaḥ 'gyur med mtha' grol mchog tu dbu 'phang bstodaḥ chos skyongs mi dang 'grogs pa'i ka ba 'dzugaḥ dpal 'byor srid nor rgyas pa'i phya g.yang khugaḥ dbang thang rlang rta dar rgyas dngos grab stsolaḥ 'gro khams bde legs dpal 'bar phrin las mdzodaX rab 'bar chos dbyings gsal ba'i da

la stse bde bkod thabs kyi rang bzhin bkra shis rtags mi 'gyur shes rab mchog dpal rgyal srid bdunaḥ zung 'jug gnyis med rol ba'i rdzas mchog rnamasaḥdapal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs zil gnon stobs ldan rol par dbu 'phang bstodaḥ bstan srung mi la gabor ba'i ka chen 'dzugaḥ dbul phongs nor gyis phyur ba'i phywa g.yang khugaḥ phyogs kun bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dngos grub stsolaḥ phan bde bstan pa dar ba'i phrin las mdzod yangasapa'i bar snang rdzu 'phrul rlabs kyis gcod glang po thal dkar cang shes gser gyi spuḥ bsam 'phel gter kha 'dzom pa'i thab shes zungaḥdapal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangasaḥ srid gnyis rdzogs ldan ltar mtshor dbu 'phang bstodaḥ pho nya sgrub por 'grogs pa'i ka chen 'dzugaḥ dpal 'byor lha dang 'gran pa'i phyu g.yang khugaḥ srid gsum srog la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol0 rkud zhi legs smon 'phel rgyas

'o/ brin las mdzodaḥ mi nub rgyal mtshan rtser bsgrengs gser gdugs 'ogaḥ bkra shis kun gyi rtse mo dpung rgyan dpalaḥ rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i mthus bskrun dro rmi shes dal0 dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed daro sa 'dzin dag pas bska saX mdzad pa mthar phyin stobs kyas dbu 'phang bstodaḥ bka' sdod mi dang 'grogs pa'i ka chen 'dzugaḥ bsod nams klu dang mnyam pa'i phywa g.yang khugaḥ chos srid nub med skyong ba'i dngos grub stsolaḥ rnam rgyal phrin las rgya mtsho grub par mdzod mthun pa'i grub sbyor rnam bcu dbang dang ldanaḥ shes rab brtse chen stobs kyi snying ngo/ dngaḥ baspu med shes rab gsang ba'i sham 'dogs bcasaḥ gnyis med rol pa chen po'i 'phrul rtsed kyisaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bska saḥ'akhor ba chos smar rol pas dbu 'phang bstod ༷ dam can mi dang 'grogs pa'i ka chen 'dzugaḥ rnam sras dpal la 'byor ba'i phyu g.yang khugaḥ don gnyis lcan gyis grub

pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ gang bcol thogs med dus grub phrin las mdzodaḥ dag gsal mkha' dbyings rlabs gcod ga ru ṭaḥ gangs la 'od 'byug 'dzin pa'i gdong lnga baX gnyis med rol ba chen po dga' chen dbyid: yongs dag sems kyis ma bzung rdo rje'i gsangaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed da ngos 'dzin dag pa sa bskangasaḥ mi g.yo stun po ltar brtan dbu riphang bstodaX srung ma mi dang 'grogs pa'i ka chen mdzugaḥ gter bum dpa pa la dbang 'byor phywa g.yang bugaḥ gzhan snang zil gnon stobs brgya'i dngos grub stsolaḥ dge legs gzhi 'dzug thogs med phrin las mdzodaḥ bkra ba 'jum ldan bsil skong stag pho dngaX shes rab treg le 'dzin pa gzig mo steḥ gnyis su med pa bde chen rol ba'i dpalaḥ kun 'byung yongs su grub pa'i mthun sbyor kyangaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes bye ra 'bulaḥ bskang bya sgong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangasaḥ g.yu rgyal rdo rje grub pa'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ bka' nyan mi dang 'grogs pa'i ka chen 'dzugaḥ 'dod ster

'o/ dpag bsam shing 'dra'i phywa g.yang khug mthu che dpal brtsan nus mthu'i dngos grub stsolaḥ smon pa'i re 'bras gegs med phrin las mdzodaḥrdo rje'i khrab mo (11 shes mda' dang gzhu gzhom bral go phub rno ngar mdung zor griḥ 'dzam gling skyes bu'i dpa' chas yo byad kunaḥ dngos por ma bzung chos dbyings rol ba'i rgyanaḥdapal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaX bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangasaḥ phas rgol rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbu 'phang bstod mthu ldan mi dang 'grogs pa'i ka chen 'dzugaḥ rab 'byams nor gyi sprin 'khrigs phywa g.yang khugaḥ dgra bgegs drungs 'byin mthu yi dngos grub stsolaḥ mtha' yi dmag bzlog rgyal bstan dar rgyas mdzodaX thabs mchog nam mkha' mdzod dpal gzhal med khangaḥ shes rab 'dod rgu'i sprin 'khrigs rgyang bu steḥ gnyis med yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'byung khung gteraḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs dregs tshogs yongs brgyad mchog gi dbu 'phang

bstodaḥ lha srung mi dang 'grogs pa'i ka chen 'dzugaX brtan g.yo' dpal 'byor rgya mtshos phywa g.yang khugaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan rab rgyas dngos grub stsolaḥ chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ ye shes lnga dbyings mtshon pa'i mda' dar dang sgyu 'phrul rten 'brel don rtag 'phang bkra gnyisaḥ stag gzigs snod bzang bkram pa'i zung 'jug sprinaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaX bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangasaḥ tha tshig 'dzin pa'i pho nya'i dbu 'phang bstod gnyer 'dzin mi la 'khor ba'i ka chen 'dzugaX chos nyid khyon mnyam chos can phywa g.yang khug grub pa brgyad la dbang 'byor dngos grub stsolaX gegs bzlog mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ snang ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje ḍā ma rtsa stong pa 'gags med dril bu tang tang shag mtshan 'dzin bral ba grags stong mchod pa'i mchogaX stong khams chos smra'i khyab pa'i pu dza yangaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul bskang bya sgong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs dam tshig sgog ltar

(2 'chang ba'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ bka' srung mi la 'grogs ba'i ka chen 'dzug skye rgu'i mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i phywa g.yang khugaḥ sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'dzin nusarten grub stsolaḥ phrin las rnam bzhi gang bcol thogs med mdzod0 rdza spangs khrod brten sha dkar sman rwa mdzesaḥ byang thang na mdzes 'brong nag dar brgyan skrudaḥ gnyisamed bde byed bse ru ratna 'chang: nor gyi bye brag chos skyongs mchod 'os rnamasaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmag tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzinadag pas bskangs ༷ rdo rje che ba'i dbaja phyug dbu 'phang bstodaḥ gnyer 'dzin mi la 'go ba'i ka chen 'dzugaḥ tshe srid chos dpal zas nor phywa g.yang khugaḥ nyams rtogs yonatan 'phel rgyas dngos grub stsolaḥ gsol btab 'bras bu smin pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥbabaste ches dbyengs mkha' gtong brdal ba'i dar bo cheḥ mi nub ba dan lce gsumasrid pa'i dpalaḥ gang yang nub med bskul 'bod rgyag byang canaḥ steng gi 'phral rkyen bzlog pa'i khyung 'byug ldingaḥ bde legs dpal spel rta bdun ri bong 'dzinaḥ bar na

'dod yon rgya mtsho'i rnam par sgrudaḥ gegs bzlog don grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpalaḥ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon niḥ bkra shis g.yang 'khyil phyogs kun dge ba'i daraḥ bdud dpung zil gnon stobs ldan yongs kyi rtenaḥ lha bskang gnyan bskul klu grogs byed pa'i rdzasaḥ gtod 'gugs dgra 'joms 'dre 'dul rdo rje'i rgyaḥdakar phyogs dbu bstod nag po'i sma phab byedaḥ gnam gyi 'ju thag sa yi rten phur yinaḥ rin thang bra pa ba ting 'dzin 'phrupa mo cheḥ 2dod yon bkod mdzes tshad bzung mi btub paḥ steng 'og bar bkod stong gsum khyon brdal ba'iḥ 'pho med rtag pa'i slung rta rab 'bar bsaḥ mthu chen brag lha mgon po'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ sras mchog gzi ldan 'bar ba'i dbu 'phang bstod yum mchog yaka be ta'i dbu 'phang bstod blon po dgra 'dul dbang phyug dbu 'phang bstodaḥ ri bzang rdza bkra phyug po'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ shan pa rdo rje thog rgod dbu 'phang bstodaḥ rdza rgyal btsan byug mched bdun dbu 'phang bstodaḥ tha tshig gsum 'dzin stag rtse'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ dge bsnyen gnod

shan pa dgra la rngams pa'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ las pa mtshon brdar 'debs pa'i dbu 'phang bstod za ngu gsod sgrol byed pa'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ rbad na mthu stobs che ba'idabu 'phang bstodaX bos tshe snyan gsang can gyi dbu 'phang bstodaḥ bskul na las la bang mgyog dbu 'phang bstodaḥ btab pas mi 'chor brlag mkhas dbu 'phang bstodaḥ lhasrung g.yas su rgyal ba'i dbu 2phang bstod pho nya g.yon du rgyal ba'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ sbyin bdag dgra las rgyal ba'i dbu 'phang bstod bsrung bya bgegs las rgyalaba'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥ rnal 'byor bsam pa 'grub pa'i dbu 'phang bstodaḥkai kai chos nyid dbyings las chos skyongs bskulaḥbaswo bswo bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ca cha lha min bdud dpung pham par mdzod: de gsum chos skyongs mnyes pa'i dam bsgrags ste sgrub mchog bcol ba'i las mdzod sa ma yāḥdam can rnal 'phyor sbyinabadag 'dzom pa yiX rten 'brel mthun gsum legs pa'i sgo grub nasaX rgyal bstan 'dzin bsrung spel ba'i phrin las yangaḥ nub med gang ga'i rgyan bzhin 'byung ba dngaḥ

—1) srid gnyis skyongs ba'i mthun snang lha yis sbyoraḥ mtha' yi dmag bzlog skye rgu chos lam gzudaḥ dge ba bcur spyod 'bras bu ya mtshan canaḥ rdzogs ldan snang ba'i sa gsum yongs khyab pa'iḥ dge mtshan smon tshig gegs med 'grub gyur cigaḥ cethadang rten 'brel snying po bskyar 'dod gsol smon tshag ga 'osabya de nasadapang mkhar bstod pa ni gru bzhi bgam ldan pa brtsiṭaḥ smon tshig 'dod pa 'i bsto 'ur bcas yo 'khyogs bral bar brten gzhugs soḥ gzhi la bum gter bza po 'dzug snying po zung 'jug legs nges byaḥ kha bad dung rdos mdzesapar brgyanaḥ sngags da phyag rgyasabyinagyi brlabs bkra shis bden grub sngon du garṣaḥ 'u gsal rṣa 'dzan brtan ngo yas bsaḥ bkra shis gser gyi mdangs 'bar gzhi ma la phul byung yid bzhin bsam 'phel ratna'i gteraḥdabang chen dpal ster lha mo'i mkha' la bstimasaḥ phyi nang 'byung snyoms nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhiḥ bde legs dus ston 'bras bzang smin par byedaḥ brjid ldan dpal gyi dpang mkhar gru bzhi paḥ lha rdo dung las grub pa'i kha bad mdzesaḥ rnam rgyal lha'i mdzod 'dzom pa'i snying po gzhugasaḥ 'go ba'i lha bsrung brten gnas bca' ba'i dalaḥ

rnam dag yongs grub shes rig rdo rje'i 'phrulaḥ phyi nang bar gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod steḥ zad pa med pa 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i noraḥ nam mkha'i mtha' klas kun bzang ro rtsed bsgyuraḥ dpal ldan chos skyong bskang ba'i rten du 'bulaX 'pho med rdo rje'i rol par brtan bzhugs gsolaḥ dgyes brtse'i 'od 'bar rdo rje'i rwa gur klongaḥ 'jig bra bsrung ba'i rgya las 'gyur med mdzodaḥ khyed mchod sgrub mchog las ldan pho mo paḥ 2dod rgu mdzad med gaṅga'i rgyun bzhin stsopaḥ dpal mdangs bsod nams yar ro sa ‘ ltar bskyedaḥ brgyad zung nyer 'che'i phyogs rnams ming med stongaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan lo bzang 'dabs stong sminaḥ dgra sde bgegs dpung ming gi lhag mar gyur ༷ bsring smung rta rab 'bar snyan grags spelaḥ bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug theg mchog nyin snang 'byed don gnyis lhun grub 'gro ba'i dpal gyur doḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs mdza pa mthar phyin 31gaX cesabarjod bkra shis rgya za bya de nas bsrung bkod bya ba la ratna lnga bsresa'abyu mar gyis me tog tshom bu bkod byasate snyan 'gyur glu yi 'di skad doḥ eḥ dzadagadabyingasami 'gyur gas‘

(27 ba'i nam mkha' laX rten 'byung nyi zla gza' skar bkra ba bzhinaḥ sems nyid 'pho med chos kun 'byung gnas laḥ rig pa 'od gsal 'char ba'i rtags gcig driskod ri rgyal lhun po g.yo 'gul bral ba laḥ 'dod yon thogs med bsam yas sprin 'khrigs ltaraX phyi nang tshogs 'dus 'byung ba lnga gzugs la ye shes 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i bsrung gcig bkod ma dros zlum 'khyil tshad bzung bral ba laḥ gdengs khas bsrung ba'i ratna bsam yas bzhinaḥ bsod nams dbang thang slung rta'i dpal kha laḥ mi nub rnam thos sras kyis g.yang gcig bkodaḥ la la 'khrungs ba'i dpag bsam ljon bzang lasaḥ 'bras bu 'dzad med rdol ba'i rten 'brel bzhinaX rted dka' rin chen gru gzing thob pa la don gnyis grub phyir tshe yi rtags gcig bkodaḥ 'dzam gling skyongs mkhas 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal gyis 'bangs rnams zil gnon srid gnyis skongs mkhas bzhinaḥ las dbang mthus bsted bsod nams bzang po'i gzhiḥ rnam dpyod ya rabs brjod pa'i mdzes gcig bkodaḥ lha mi dpal gsum 'dzom

pa'i dbang srid laḥ thams cad dge ba'i mngon brjod bsngags pa bzhinaḥ mdo sngags bstan pa 'dzin bsrung spel ba laḥ yon mchod bsam pa lhas bsrung mthun gcig bkod rgyal mtshan rtser bsgrengs mchod bkyags bsam 'phel laḥ gsol btab 'dod pa'i re 'bras stsol ba bzhinaX dgra bla dpal ldan brag lha mgon po laḥ gsol btab 'di phyi'i don 'byung dge mtshan bkodaḥ skyobs pa'i lha dgu 'go ba'i lha lnga yang bsrung bya 'di la 'bral med 'grogs pa yisaḥ dam tshig srog sbrel rdo rje'i rtags 'god naḥ dge mtshan yongs su grub pa'i shes pa stsolaḥ cesabarjod me tog sil ma bkrams dga' ston bya zhag rol mo sgrogs che bayo dpal 'bar gang bsam 'byu don kun 'grub par the tshom medaḥ sa ma yuḥṭwāṃṭwāṃ ṭwāṭwāṃ ༷ / ༷dī /ṭwāṃ ༵ /zlor ༷༷ snag rdo ṭwāṃX ma/༵ ༷ ṭa ga la byung mngon bstod 'di don lnga rig mod nusaldan 2sartsalagyisaḥmakhalha reg rin ོ skyes 4 bskul smon lam 'phro bayo gab sbas med par bkod
zab lam gsang ba snying khrag lasaḥ mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i gdam pa thar ba'i gru gzing zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

pas na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye /gathonas 2 0 don dam mi ga gsang gsum bde pho dbyings lhan skyes ra med gas ma byang chub sems rang byung ye shesasatu bzang po la 'du 'bralapa' ma bral ba'i phyag bgyi'o bdag 'a na gzhi rtsa drung nasa'abyan pa dang shes rab 'od gsal pho pa'i lam bsgom pa gang gis sngon du 'gro ba'i blo sbyongasachos tshogs smon la 'phro ldan rnamasabartson pa'i zungs sam yu dang nga dal spyor rnged dka' bsgom pa ni kye sngor/ bsags bsong/ ra/mas bzang po'i 'bras bu las bskyed pa'i dal 'byor mi lus rin po che:yang yang rted dka' thar pa'i gru gzing 'dir zob med lha chos 'grub par bla ma mkhyen gnyisapa 2sabyasomi rtag bsgom pa ni phyi nang snod bcud mi rtag chags 'jig stong:skye 'chi'i rang bzhin srid gsum ston sprin 2dra:skye bo'i tshe 'gro ri gzar rbab 'dra na:mi rtag 'chi ba dran par ja ma mkhyen:gsum pa lor ba'i sdug ba la bsgo pa ni khamasagasum gang du skyes kyang sdug bajal gzeb rigro drug du kha bzod med khri mun du:'gyur med bde ba thang cig tsam med mnar:'khor bar zhen log 'byung bar bla ma mkhyen bzhi pa rgyu 'brasabaspu med bsgomapa na dgesdig

sa ju las kyi rnam smin bslu ba med: bde sdug snang ba sems kyis byed dang myong las 'bras bslu med rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du blang dor mi rmongs spyod par bla ma mkhyen: thon mongs sngon 'gro bsgom la blo sbyongasabya lnga pa theg za skyabasa'agro bsgom pa na phaṭa: sgrib bral ye shes skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum: rtsa rlung thig le rnam dag byang chub sems ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor mchog: rdo rje phag mo skyabs kyi dam par bsgoms drug pa bla med sem bskyed bsgomasapa ni phaṭa: ma gyur 'gro ba mkha' mnyam sems can rnams rten 'brel lugs ldog srid pa'i btson khang las rig pa 'od gsal dbyings su ngal bso phyir: smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: bdunapa maṇḍal lathul go tshogasabasagasani phaṭa: stong gsum 'jig rten bkod pa'i yo byad dang: bdag lus phung khams dbang po'i brgyan dang bcas: semasanyid rnam dag thig le'i bkod mdzes pa sku gsum lcan grub phag mo'i drung du 'bul: brgyad pa sgrab sbyangasamakha' 'gra'i bsgomasabazlasani phaṭa: skad cig snang ba sgyu 'byul zhig pa ltar chos nyid spros

mtha' bral ba'i ngang du brdal gsal snang 'gags med ye shes cho rol las: rnam dag bkod mdzes zhing khams phun tshogs dbus: ma chags padma thabs shes nyi zla'ikhar: rtog med ro ste (ཿdmar 'phro 'du las: bdag snang mi shig rdo rje phag mo dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzums sgegs pa'i sku: zhal gdangs ljang 'dril spyanagasum smin ma 'bar: dbu sgra snum 3bopa thod skam dar sna'i mdzes: nyi zla'i snyan cha rna ltag phag zhal ngur: dur khrod chas rdzogs phyag gnyis gri thod bsnams: zhabs gnyis gar stabs kha ṭwāṃ mchan du brten: rus brgyan dar dpyang ye shes me 'bar klong: snang stong gnyis med 'od gsal phung por bskyed: spyo bor 'ja' gur gting gsal yangs pa dza rgyal ba kun yum chosasku kun bzang mo: mthing nag gcer bu brgyan med 'od phung 'bar: zhabasaganyis dkyil krung phyag ni mnyam bzhag mdzad: g.yo med lhan ner chos nyid dbyings la brdal: bdag thugs pad zlar 'od dmar dga' 'byil klong: bosathar sngagasaphreng g.yon du 'khor ba las: 'od zer ye shes me ltar rab

58ཿ 'bar ba'i: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib ma lus pa: sbur ma me 'phrad bzhin du lhag med bsregs: slar yang phyi nang sgod bcud ma lus pa: bsregs sbyangs lha sngags chos sku'i rol par sad: dag mnyam de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la blta: o badzra wa ra hi maḥnyariḥniḥsaḥsarba pa paṃ shirnyi ku ru ye swā sna bye ba'am ni khri 4ma ci khrub bzla bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis 'od zer gsang lam nas: kun tu bzang mo'i thugs las wal gyis byung: rang thim 'od dmar zhig gyur chos skur bsdu: bdag nyid kun tu bzang mo'i thugs ka phu zla steng 'od thig sbubs su āḥdakar la: sngags phreng 'khor zhing bzlas pa'i zer 'bar nas: 'khor 'das dag mnyam bde ba chen por brdal:bdag snang chos skur gzhig cing rig par blta: a a a badzra sa marnya bha tra sa: brgya stong la sogasaci 'grub dag par bskyal 'khor 'das dag mnyam klong chen rig pa'i ngang: nirma ka ya sa ma ti siji tshe: saṃ blo ka ya sa ma ti sirnyi ā dmarma ka ya sam ti sirji hūṃ: dmigasagasal gnad dang lngan pa'i yang yang brjod mthar ni sprosabral chosadabyings lcag par bzhag: phyi

nang gsang ba'i sgrib rkyen dag pa dang tshe bsod lang tsho gong nas gong 'phel rgyas dgu pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni phaṭa 'di ltar sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig pa ltar: chos dbyings klong brdal gsal snang 'gags med ni: rnam dag 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen zhing: dag mnyam kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings su chags bral ge sar 'bum brdal nyi zla'i khar bdag snang rdo rje rnal 'byor dbab mo dmar: zhal gcig phya ga gnyis chags 'dzum sgegs nyams rgyas: ring pa 'i tshul gyi spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigs sna tshogs dar dang ratna rus pa'i brgyan dbu sgra thod cog padma'i gdeng ga mdzes: zar bu g.yon 'phyangs zhabs ni dor stabs rol dad brgya'i ge sar g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur can gsal stong 'dzin med 'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong brgyud pa dgu ldan rig 'dzin yongs lus dpal: rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje phag mo'i sku dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis gru gang tshad: zhal gdangs lcags 'dril spran gsum mkha' la gzigs smin ma me 'bar dbu smra gyen du brdzes:

sa ཿ thod skam dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur nyi zla'i snyan cha rna ltag phag zhal ngur phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa'i bhan thod bsnams zhabs gnyisagarastabs rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes 'ja' 'od klong du sgyu ma'i phung por gsal: deyithugs klong pad zla bshad pa'i khar kun tu bzang mo mthing gsal tshon gang ba: rgyanamed gcer bu mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma dam pa dang: sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bskor gnas gsum rdo rje'i snying pogasal ba las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas spyan drangs gnyis med ro gcig 'dres par gyur phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa: dag pa mkha' spyod chosadabyingasapho brang nas: rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang: gnas gsum 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams: rdo rje phag mo'i rnam rol gar bsgyur gyis: sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru ha ri ni sa sirji hūṃ: phaṭa skyabasaganas kun 'dusabla ma rin po che: mchog gsum rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor la: smo

gsum gus pa chen pos gsol ba 'debs zhing rdul grangs mnyam lus sprul phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid 'dod yon kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum sdig sgrib nyesalhung mthol lo bshags rnam dkar dge ba'i las la rjes yi ring: theg gsum chosakyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs zag bcas zag med dge rtsa 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig kun bzang rgyal sa zin par shog: ma cig ye shes mkha' 'gror gsol ba 'debs: dal 'byor chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'chi ba mi rtag dran par byin gyis rlobs: dge sdig blang dor dran par byin gyis rlobs: 'khor bar zhen log skye bar byin gyisarlobs: gzung 'dzin rtsad nas chod par byin gyis rlobs: a 'thas mdud pa grol bar byin gyis rlobs gzhi med rtsa bral mthong bar byin gyis rlobs rig pa zang thal rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: 'jur bsgoms blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum rang zhal mthong bar byin gyis rlobs: gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par byin gyisarlobs chos

52: dbyings ma bu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs: phyam brdal rdzogs pa chen po a la la: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de nasadabang bzhi len pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: skyabs gcig bla ma rdo rje phag mo dgongs: gsang gsum bskul pa'i 'od zer lnga ldan byung: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bum gsang shes rab tshig gi dbang thob cing:sgo gsum rtsa rlung thig le'i bag chags dag nyon shes sgrib tshogs ma lus sangs gyur nas: sku bzhi'i sa bon thob cing dga' stong 'bar: rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun gyis grub: bskyed rdzogs ka dag lhun grub snod rung gyur: lhan skyes don dam bla ma'i zhal mthong nas: gang shar rang rig ye shes a la la: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rig kun 'dus zhal bla ma rin po che: chags med bde chen 'bar ba'i zer gyis zhu: bdag snang dang 'dresa'od gsal 'khor lor sad: ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang la yan: blo 'das 11sa bral rjen pa a la la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ces brjod la ka dag spros mtha' da bral ba lhun grub ye shes chen po zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i nga la lhug par bzhag go bcu pa 'pho ba ma bsgoms sa sargyas

ni gzhan las byung ltar brtson pa'i dge legasa'aphel tshogs rdzogasasgrib dag dbang dang dngosagrub thob the tshom med do rdo rje pa dma'i bka' ma yu yi ma lnga brgya'i 'gro bdamu long mi dge bcur rtag par spyod cing lasanganakho nar 'da' tshe thung nad mang nor dbul 'jigs pa'i mnar 'di phyi phung ba'i kla sgo'i dbang du gyur de tshe lasasmon ldan pa re mamasan ri dwagasasmasam bzhin du ri sul snyogs rnal bos gosagyon dman pa'i sa'adzan cing lta bayas 'beb rdzogasapa chen po bsgom spyod pa masa'adzeg sor byang sngag sdom bsrungs zung 'jug rnal ma'i jon la yeng med mdzod dang po sngon 'gro 'ari cid gnad du brtson bdud ba'i rtsad gcong gzung 'dzin semasal bdug gang shar chos la zhen pa gting nasachod brtul zhugagaye shes rnal dbab gshis la shog go lo thos shes tsam du mi 'jog par nges shesago ba yid ches myong ba thob ye samed 'khor yug dam pa'i chosal 'bod nor gyi yang rtse'aphags pa'i nor bdun spyod 'dun ma mthar thug bya btang rnal 'byor legs blo phug gtad chog skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum lha gcig o rgyan nga la gsol ba thob grogs mtshog chos skyongasasrungs ma bran du bkol bslu byed 'jig rten chos brgyad rgyab tu bor grub zin med pa'i bya 'phro rbad kyisachod mnyes pa gsum gyi bla ma bsten pa dang khrel med rnam gsum srog gi gzhir bzhag cing gol shor nor sogasagegs dang 'phrang bsgral nas kuyang blo

sa sgo bde mtshog gi gsang lam skyo sa:mi chos kha la mi nyan lha tshugs 'dzin nye 'brel 'khor ba'i sgrogs la gdung thag chod myos byed chang dang brel byed 'khor phyug sbongs 'jib myong rdzasakyi du ru la mi spyod 'drera'adzan tho co mi che dag mnyam skyo sa nams len skyon la ma blta mnam ba'ag nga dge sbyor dgra ru ma 'dzan rjesathob skabs snying rje than la ma brtsi rgyun chagasabarten 'gro phan don gnyer mi chung byang chub sems tshe gcig sangasargyas bsgrub na pha ma'i drin g.yo khe rdzun gyis 'tsho na rang gzhan mnar 'di bde phya skyid 'byu na phun sum tshogs bdag 'dra padma'i phyi rab 'gro ba la brtse ba chen po'i zhal chemasagadam pa yin da lta spel ba'i dus la bab pa min ma 'ongs lnga brgya skyobs phyir brda la thob las can snyid ga bu dang 'phrad nga ra shog rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong du dgo sa pra gtams ma mo mched gsum gter gyasaganyer 'dzin mdzod skal med riṭa lam spel a tham rgya ma shā rgya rgyargya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyi ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag popadma tshasa'amil gyis dar da rdo rje'i gsungs gas skul pa dang nye gnasadharma ke ratna sa ra gnyis kyis yang yang bskul ba dang mo ldan chosagasal zhesabya'i shog gu dngadar bcas bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa 'a bo nus ldan 'dus pa phyol gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda ras las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa dge zhang bkra shis par gyur cigasarba masgo lam/
zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las:mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo la brten pa'i myur lam 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas bzhugs so:

sa snye/ na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye (14 — mchog tu mi 'gyur lhan skyes ye shes gshas bde za 'du 'bral med ba 'a rig ba ni 'pho 'byur spros bral don gyi pha ga mor gnas sku gsum klong ya sapho por phyaga'atshal lo padma bdag ga rjes lajug lasaldan rnams tsha gcig sangasorgyas samatshog bsgod pa la dka' ba med pa ma bsgom chosalnga las zab lam thos grol 'pho ba' gdams pa bstan sa ma yu de pang sbyang pa sngon du ma btangabar das 5 'pho bar bya ba cung zad dka' de phyir sngon 'gro'i chos kyas rgyud sbya sa nas than min ba ma'i rnal 'byer gyis sman byed de nas phyi nang sto ra lad sagasum legs par gsal pa 'i rirma pa 'di bzhen jo phaṭa rang snang dag pa bde chen mkha' spyod zhing yum chen lnga ldan ye shes gsal ba'i klo :ma chags padma thabs shes nyi zla'i khar bdag snang rdo rje phag mo dmar gsal sgegs:zhal gshig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum chags nyams 'bar:nu 'bur bde chen gsang ba'i padmo rgyas spyan gsum mkhar gzigs dbu skra gyen du brdzis:phag zhal ngur ba'i dug gsum 'khrul rtog bshig thod skam dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur nyi zla'i snyan cha rus pa'i rgyan drug spras stag lpags sham thabs dar dang ratna'i

༄80 mdzes: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa'i bhan thod bsnams: zhabs gnyis gar stabs bsgyur zhing 'ja' 'od klong: snang stong 'od sku gru gang gsal la 'tsher:sku darsha'i a wa dhu ti bzhin bzang ma: dkar dmar mthing ka drabhe sa srab snum gsal 'bar: shel bzhin 'od ldan mda' snyug sbu gu tsam: mar sne sprul pa'i 'khor lor tshig gis 'gags: yar sne spyi bor har gyis sangs ba la: snyeng dbu'i rnam shes 'od lnga'i thig le ni gsal 'tsher snum 'dril che chung 'jams 'dril tsam 'dar 'phar lang ling 'od dang ldan par bskyed: spyi bor ma chags padma 'dab brgyad steng: rig kun yongs 'dus o rgyan rdo rje 'chang: dkar dmar mdangs ldan he ru ka pa'i chas: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje bhanta 'dzin bcu drug mdangs ldan 'ja' 'od klong na bzhugs bde chen bskyed mdzad mtsho rgyal 'khril sbyor rol: sku dbyings dngas gsal rgya mtsho lta bu'i klong: rgya bod lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rdzogs: de yi spri bor thabs mchog zla ba'i steng: bcom ldan mi basmod rdo dzeesems dpa' ni dkar gsal zhal

gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril brten: zhabs ni phyed skyil longs sku'i brgyan chas rdzogs: rigs lnga yab yum dkyil 'khor bsam mtha' yas: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bkod pasku la mdzes: dngas gsal 'od phung 'bar ba'i klong du bskyed:de yi spyi bor shes rab nyi gdan la: skye med chos sku kun tu bzang po mthing gcer bu mthing gsal mnyamabazhag skyil krung bzhugs: gnyis med yum chen kun tu bzang mor sbyor 'ja' 'od klong du snang stong 'od kyi sku: 'dzin med stong gsal gnyug ma'i lha ru bskyed skugasum rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis: thugs rje brtse ba'i bdag la rab dgongs nas: zab lam don dam mchog gi 'pho lam phyes: sku bzhi'i btsan sa zin parabyin gyis rlobs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa de nasagasol ba 'debasapa 'a rim pa ni kye skye med chosesku kun tu bzang po dang: lhun grub 'gags med longasasku snang mtha' yas thugs rjertsol bral sprul sku padma 'byung: rig 'dzan lo paṇa rgya mtsho'i tshom bur bcas: gsol ba 'debasaso 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes:ka dag sprosabral bde chen kun bzang mo rang

sa bzhin 'od gsal rdo rje phag mo dang blo 'das ye shes khros ma nag mo'i sku rigs bzhi las byed gdong can sga ma sogs gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod gas/ lam phyes: bka' drin mnyam med a ma mtsho rgyal dang: 'gro ba 'dren mdzad mkha' 'gro zhi 'od 'bar: ma chags dri bral bde chen mandar bde stong klong bskyed 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro la: gsol ba 'debs so brdal khyab gsang lam phyes: dbyings rig 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa dang: phyam brdal rdzogs chen rgyal sa zin pa dang:'ja' lus 'pho chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: snyan pa'i sgra gsum dag gisarnam shesaspar sku gsum klong brgyud chos sku la bzhag de na tshe dang bar chad bsol ba da snying rje chen lo sbyin garṣa bya ba ni phaṭa rang rig 'gagasamed ye shes ni skye med klong las mkha' 'gror sad zhal phyag brgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: byams pa'i sbyin gtong dpal du shar: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phung po gan skyal bgyil ba las: rang byung gri gug tshad tsam gyis lpags pa bshus te sa gzhi khyab: sha khrag rus pa 'dod dgu'i dpal: mi zad ye

shes bdud rtsi ni kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du brgyur: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dag pa dbyingasakyipho brang nas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can sde: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa: sangasargyas)stagadangadage 'dun dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sde chos sku longs sku sprul sku la: bdud rtse bam gyi tshogs mchod 'bul: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ye dag kun tu bzang mo'i gdangs: rang grol bde chen tho ra hi: mnyam brdapa /bros ma nag mo pa: bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogs mchod 'bul phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:ton mongs rang grol mkha' 'gro bzhi: chad med las byed ḍakki ma: sgo bzhi skyongs mdzad lha tshogs la: bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogs skachod 'bul: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dur khrod chen pornam pa brgyad he ru ka yi gnas mchog bcu: yul chen sum cu rtsa gnyis na: bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gror tshogs mchod rebul phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang dag pa'i dbyings dang 'jig rten khams smyongs mjad 'bum khrag mkha' 'gro la: bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogs mchod

skus 'bul: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: khamasagasum rigs drug gnas skyongs ba'i 'gro ba nyam thag sems can la: zad med byang chub sems mchog gis: sbyin pa chen po garteng bar bgyi phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rten mid 'ja' tshon lta bu la gnas bcas bgegs rigs lan chags mgron: kun la snying rje chen po yis gces 'dzin sgyu ma'i phung po'i mchod phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa: tshos nyid don gyi rnal 'byor ngas: gzung 'dzin rtog pa rab bsgral nas: mchog tu bzung ba'i phung po nyid: sbyin pa chen po'i thabs su gtong: dkon mchog mtshad pas dgyes gyur cig: yi dam la tshogs thugs dam bskangs: ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes pa bskyed: chos skyongs srung ma mchod cing bskaja :tshogs rdzogs dbang dang dngos grub thob snang srid lha 'dre tshom gyur cig: khams gsum sems can ngoms gyur cig lan chags bu lon kun byang nas: gdod ma'i btsan sa zin par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bdudabazhi rtsad gcod brtul zhugs kyis: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa gzhig gyur cig a 'thas mdud pa grol ba dang byar med ri

khrod zin par shog:sha khrag gzan du bsgyur nus nas:lha 'dre'i 'gro don 'grub par shog:stong nyid snying rje bsgom pa'i mthus:'khor ba dong sprugs nus par shog rig pa ye shes rtogs pa yis:ma rig mun pa sangs bar shog:ji lta ji snyed rdol ba las 'khrul pa gzhi la sangasabar shog:mdzad bya mched byed mchod yul kun:sgyuma'i gsal 'khor zhig pa bzhin:chos dbyings spros mthang bral ba'i ngang:phyam brdal rdzogs pa chen por bzhag:a āphaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:dge bsngo ga na lagadab 'angagasum yong dag za porabazhag gnad de tshog rdzog sgrib pa dag dab dang dngo gruba'abad med 'byupasamashā yem rgya ba' dab po pa dma ngas snyi gi ya bas gdam pa'i skor shin tu zab 'i bka' rgya ba ma'ong 'gro yo3 pa'i smran khye'u sa khyad lagato rgyal spyon rgyal mo tsha ba' ro la gab ma mo mgo gsum nyid la gnyer badzin log lag tu ma shor cag snyi gi bu dang da par shog sam lda rgya rgya rgya gu rgya la ce 'di pang sgrub brtson rnal 'byor spya dbang byug dam papa5 tsha 'ape gyomatsho dang rang slob chosagasalorgyas pang yang bskul ro ra bdag 'dra nus 7na she rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba' ba ris lasashas bshus de dag par phab pa dge leg 'phel sabo maṅka lam/sarba dza pa bha ma/
zab lam rdo rje phag mo'i chos skor them med las: sngon 'gro lhan 'thab rim pa blo gsal 'jug ngog zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

canarka na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: ba sga — bdag 'dra padma saṃ bha was ma 'o sal ldan don go du nye bar mkho ba' cha lag brtan:de ya rdor dril byin rṣasani oṃ badzra tsitta sa ma ya / cesardori bso1 la 'di skad do hūṃ e snang ba ma 'gags thabs mchog rdo rjer shar rigs lnga yum lnga sems dpa' sems ma'i dal kun bzang yab yum bzhugs pa'i pho brang che khye 'gyur ye shes rdo rje'i gzung 'dzin gcod: au dharma dhartu āX go dri 'a du bsil la di skad do hūṃ a stong nyid blo 'dasashes rab dril bu'i gzugs: rnam pa ra snang mdzad ) pa' bo dpa' mo'i dal: chos nyid rang sgra sgrogs pa'i pho brang che snyan 'gyur gsungs dbyangs dril bus ma rig dkrogs: ma dzñā na sam yā hūṃ ā de nasardor dril bskor go.ud rgya byas la gyi g.yas pa thabs mtshog rdo rje yis: khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gzhesas: g.yon pa shes rab dril bu yis: 'gro drug nyon mongs gnyid ) krogs cing: zung 'jug lam la rab brten nas thabs shes 'gyur med mngon du bya: ma badzra gyurje dmarma hūṃ a: de na thod rnga byin posani hūṃtso snang stong gnyisamed dpa'

sa — bo yab yum bzhi: 'gyur med a ra li dang pho sgra sgrogs: rtsa rgyud bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sdud: thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'gugs pa'i rten du shar: hūṃ badzra tsitta rsha ma ya e a ra li ༷nga dza pho : cesabarjod la dkrol marma 4da do de na rkang gling byin masani hūṃ ho gsang ba med byung mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i rten phra gsang skad snyan sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor gzhig: stong nyid chos kyi rang sgra 'gyur med sgrogs bdag med don dam rtogs pa'i dpal du shar: hūṃ e ye ka ṭaṃ sa ma ya dza: pho : de nasab4 chu byin masani sne rin chen lasagrub snod du sgoyig las bgegs mthar khro rgyal yum mchog rlung 'byin ma: 'phro 'dus 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur: dam sri 'byung po gzhes pa'i rdzas su shar: ma a dṛ te hūṃ phaṭa swā 1 nyer gog dgagisabyin gyisatsos de nasamar thabyin masani oṃ sā bha was sbyangs rin chen snod du tre las mi zad gter: gyisaphyi nang gsang ba'i mchod smin ni so so'i lnga mo'i rol gar dang bcas nas: mchod rdzas rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mtha' gas khyar: ma badzra sma ra ṇa sa de na sposabyung bya ba ni oṃ

tsandan a dkar dri zhim bzang drug spos: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i zer 'phro ba: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i daphyid du gyur: cha badzra dhu baṃ putstsha me gha spra ra ṇa sa: de nasachosaskyong ga' ma byin masan gtor snod bhanta gru gsum yangs pa'i nang:dri〉〉las gyur dgra bgegasapho mo rnams mngon gsum gas pa btab bden pa chen po yis: nus mthu brdar pa 'gugs pa'i las byed pa : na mo bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chesaskyongasabaden stobs kyis: gzugs can gzugs med dgra dang bgegs skad cig nyid du khug cig dza: dza:shā baṃ ho: dbyingasanasathun mtshon char bag pa'i: sha ri khrag mtsho mkha'

sa ni— mdun sprul pa ni: pho nya lcags zhags sgrogs dril thogs pa yis: dam nyams ma lus dbang med bkugs la bstim: na mo rtsa gsum bsrungs ma rgya mtsho'i bden stobs kyis: gzugs can gzugs med dgra bgegs gang yin pa bstan dang phan bde tshe srog bar gcod pa'i: 'byung po ma lus dmigs pa'i rten la khug dza hūṃ baṃ ho: cesabarjod bkug ci bsgral bstab grub nasasu lag gtor byin rlabasarim pa 'ad lta ra ro ā las bhanta lcang lo can gyi nang lhag ma'i gtor ma sha ri khrag gi mtsho 'dod yon lnga ldan zad med mchod pa'i sprin: kun bzang nam mkha'i mkha' dang mnyam par gyur: ma āḥhū ha ho /: lan gsum brjod cing gtor ma byan rṣasani: eX yig las bskyed lcags khang gru gsum nang: gtor ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rigs: ngo bo bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi la: rnam pa 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs par gyur: tho āḥhūṃ: ha ho hrī lan gsum rjesasu brtan garṣa byin rlab ni rin chen snod du bshal chu'i gtor ma ni: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i rdzas su dmigs: zad med dpag yas nam mkha'i mtha'

klas gyur cha āḥkaka kaka gsum de nas bro mnan bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor snod bhanta gru gsum 'og rol du dam sri nyul le 'byung po ma lus pa mngon gsum brub cing 'thib myos nub par bsam: na tho: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dang don dam rdo rje phag mo'i nus stobs kyis: 'byung po dam sri nyul le 'gab 'dre rnams:gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og du khug ༅ gsum rjesasu: dzaX hūṃ be ho phya ga rgya bzhi 'gugs zlang sdom myos su bya'o bro mnan brjod 'a smon rga na gtor gzhed ratna 'bar ba'i nang:phan bde'i lang tsho'i gang bar dmigs: sarba sukhyepuṣṭi ku ru ye swā1 de nasamaja pa byan masanaḥbadag mdun dkyil 'khor lha tshogs las sprul pa'i: grangs med mkha' 'gro mchod sprin thogs pa 'phros dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rang bzhin can rdo rje'i gar bsgyur spro ba'i gter du spel: rnam lnga la sogasadag gisamaja de nasabastod pa'i po pa ni rigs dang dkyil 'khor las byung mkha' 'gro rnams sku yi gar bsgyur phyag nas rol mo 'khrol: zhal nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis wa tshogs la: bstod pa glu yis

sa 0 mchod pa 'bul bsam zhing: rgyasabasdusagang thad nas bstod par bya de nas slar bdag mdun gyi gnas so sor thim pas mthu phyin nus pa dang ldan par bsam la: denasab/ga pa bsngo smon dang bsdu ldang lasogasagrubanasaslar rang gisnying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i: sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams mdun gyi lha lam gangabar pyon nas su: bkra shis bden tshig sna tshogs tir tir brjod phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i me tog sil ma bkram: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho dar bar mos: rten snyingagyisabaskul bkra shisamatha' rgyasabya gnad desatshogasardzogs sgrib pa dag zu nang gsang ba' gegasasel zhing mchog dang thun mo dngos grub 'byung ze tshom med do sa ma ya srog bdag gsum gyisathub par srungs skal medarnamasal a tham rgya lathacan bu dang 'phrad par smon rgya rgya rgya bka' srung sde lnga'i thub par gyisashag maṇḍal gu hye mnagad snyibarda thim cesapa 'di yang chosakyisabadag po padma tshasa'achal gyi bskul ngor/ sngagatha'achangaspyosaldan rdo rjes tshig nag bcos bslad med par brda ris las bshus pa sarba ma lam/ bha dza ha ram/

sa ཿ zab lam phag mo'i chos skor them med las dbang sdung zil gnon lta ba'i rgyang glu dpa' ba'i nga ro bzhugs so:na ma dzñā na ḍakki ye: 'a 'i lta ba'i gdang ba.oṃ rig pa yi la drangs 'dzan pa gzharwa phub shes rab dar bslangasanas bdag med ོ po'i ngang nasaphaṭaḥsgra spir phaṭa nyezhe 'khrul las kyis 'phang ba'i'agro: dug lnga'i dbang gyur bgegs tshogs rnams: 'dzin med rig stong mkha' 'gro ma'i: ye shes lnga yi klong du bshig phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:kun rtog dug gsum g.yo b.las: chags khro gtum pa'i bdud bgegs rnams: 'od gsal sku gsum mkha' 'gro ma'i: dag pa dbyings gsum klong du bshig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:ma rig bdag 'jin 'khrugs pa las: brgyad khri bzhi stong bgegs tshogs rnams: rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i: ka dag stong chen yangs par brdal: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:phyisgod 'byung ba lngar brten pa'i: gnas gdon dam sri bdud bgegs rnams: dag grol mkha' 'gro sde lnga yis: 'od gsal yangs pa'i klong du bshig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nang giphung por

brten bcas pa'i: lus gdon 'byung po bgegs tshogs rnams: mnyam nyid gdan gsum mkha' 'gro ma'i: ye shes chen po'i ngang du bshig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lasanyon 'dzin chen rab 'thas pa'i rgyal bsen 'gab 'dre 'byung po rnams: byang chub sems kyis gzhir drangs nas: bdag med stong par zil gyisaganon mtshog gsum sku gsum bden pa dang: lha sngags phyag rgya nus mthus stobs: dbyingasagasum mkha' 'gro'i brtul zhugs kyis: nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum dang: 'brel ba'i bgegs dang 'byung po rnams pho gdon rgyal po rang sar gcod mo gdon dam sri dbyings la gzir gti mug klu gdon zil gyisaganon nga rgyal sabadag dbang du bsdus phrag tog 'byung po tshar bcad nas: sku gsum ye shes ngang du bzhag: smra bsam brjod bral ngang la blta: khamasagasum dbang bsdud zil gnon thob phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: cesabarjod dam sri zil gyisaganon bar chad g.yul las rnam par rgyal gzu 'dzan bdud bgegs rang sar gcod shin tu zab pa 'i chosaskor 'di srog bdag gsum gyi bya ra gyis sngag bdag rgya mtshos thub par srungs sam yu

sa ma rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi bee sa lasacan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog mapha brda zim:cesapa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po padma rma 'phel gyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rje'i mkha' 'ayo brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lam/

sa pa them yig med pa'i skor las: skyabs yul bskyed pa'i rim pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: bas dad 'i rten bzang dkon mchag rin po che mdun mkhar skyabasayul gsal gdab 'di skad gyer rang mdun ma chags padma 'dab stong bkra: thabs shes nyi zla bral bam ro'i khar rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje phag mo la brgyud pa dgu ldan rig 'dzin bla ma dang: yi dam lha tshogs gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i lha bsrungs ma dam ca mtsho sprin ltar gtib: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag la dgongs par bsam thugs sgog 'od kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas spyan drangs dbyer med bstims la ro gagyur badzra sa ma ya dza dza: skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed tshogs bsags yan rdzogasanas dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs mo'i mthus bdag gi rgyad smin cing rab tu grol bar bsam: de yang sgrub pa 'i cha lags su padma bdag gis legs pa ra bkod lnga brgya skyobs pa 'i dpa 'a bo che nusaldan rdo rjer 'phrad pa ra shog sam yu
rgya ces kya chos bdag dam pa padma chos 'phel gyas bskul ngor nus ldan rdo rjes bras pa dge legs 'phe / sarba masgo lam/

sa ste ma āḥsnochos dbyings dag pa rabs 'byams klong yangs su:snod bcud 'dod yon bkod pa'i yo byad dang:rang lus phung khams sems rtog dang bcas pa ma bsgyur ye rdzogs phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis brlabs:dag mnyam kun tu bzang po'i sprin chen po'i:dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon rnams yongs gang gyur:nam mkha' mdzod sngagasalan bdun da rten snying brjod de spel bar bya de na bskang ba' thabasal brtson tshogasaganyisayongs su rdzogs par 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya cesakyangachos bdag ——'a ngor sngagasanag nusaldan rdo rjes spel bstan pa' 'gro don 'byung gyur cig dge'o legs so masgo lam

sa ma tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa ni na mo: rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyis bdag: rang byung rdo rje phag mo'i sku: sprul 'khor yongs rdzogs rol gar bcas gdul bya smin phyir zhing 'dir bzhugs: bdag lus rdul snyed grangs sprul nas: sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba'i bkod pa yang chags 'dzin bral ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ma rig las nyon dam tshig nyams: gnong 'gyed drag po'i mthol lo bshags: skyes bu gsum gyi rgyu 'bras la dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang ngo: theg pa rgya mtsho las byung ba'i: gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor du gsol: sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa 'dzin mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa yis: dge tshogs ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: sdug bsngal gyis bcing sems can rnams: gdod ma'i gzhi la sad par shog: ces skyal lo de ltar brjod pa' tshogasaganyis rdzogs dbang dang ye shes 'aze la rgyas 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu hye snyi zhes pa 'di 'a smon lam las kyis 'brel ba'i chos bdag dharma'i bskul ro ra bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam//
zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: mkha' 'gro'i nyams len zab mo bzhugs soḥ

༄ go na mo no na ḍakki ye rabadwa sa bde chen lhan skyesam shes dngos mchog du mi 'gyur 'od gsal ba rang byung sku gsum mnyam pa nyad mthon mthing ral ba'i gtsug gisamachod bdag 'dra padma waṃ was snying gi yang bcud gdamasapa' skor ma 'ong 'gro ba'i don phyir bstan lnga brgya dusakyi tha ma la dug gsum bdud kyi cho rola'akhrugs smon log bdud sprul rnams kyisagang ngosabazung med pa' yamasand ldang gsoru mi btubargyal grib 'byung char chu mi snyorma salo nyes shi gangs ldo bra byis than — 'byu nam mkha' dug sprin dmar nag g.yo mtshon cha sa rdos char ba bebs rlu dmar shugasapa 'i gnam thasbrel mi phyug kun la ro ga gtong nasargya 'dre rwa mgo can ro khros pa 'i dud rla sagis nag po gsum sbrel mi bde ston stod na klo gdon dred mgo yis rtsubasa'agyur tshad pa'i 'khor lo bskor byang phyogasaku khu'i khyu tshogathal lcagasamo'i 'gug byed zhagasapagatong bya spu brgyan pa'i klo tshogs kyas khrag gi char pa lan gsum g.yo dug mtsho sngon mo'i ngad pa la 'go yisalan tshwa zhu la thang 'thor ba' me stag 'ga' re ni rkyang 'brong byang gis srid 'dzan lho rgyud gang gi seng ge dang re 'byams nag po 'i stobs rtsal 'gyed da po galu ral thang drug rgyas mthar ni dug gi sbubs su 'thum a yi rgyal po girti'i ming skye phre las kyi rtags legs kyang ra dza srin po'i dbang du song 'di phyi gnyis kung bya byed

sa nirdzu brtsams dung gi me tog bkra ba la ra dza'i sprul pa drug gsum 'byu bstan la khrags gsagaso phran byed rigs ldan sprulapa rnamasapa lnga la la dam sel rkyen gyisayal re 'ga' nges med sal dor gzhi mtsheba'i gnas kyis ro ra smon log dam sri'i sprul pa ni pha la'i mi nga can sme sha can 'byung ba'i dge 'dun nang dme 'khrugs sa kha stong pa 'i yul du gyur ma ring nyeba'i bu dgon gnyas skab sgog mjesapa'i lang tsho dar b.ra'atshams bdud kyis kha rla sa phog sabha dam sri'i klo la bsdu dar zhig rgyas 'i me long nas bcu gsum gser kyi khri 'dzan pa sa ra dze'i skur bzheng sa skye 'gro bslu dmag jag mtshon cha'i bya ba byed rdo rje bdud 'jomasasprul pa 'iskyobs 'jang gi sargang ge sar de yasmo 'khrugasapa'i mi tsam 'gyur shugasakyi gnasagazhi mdzesapa la — na sngags ldan pa'i bla ma dang the'u rang 'grogs pa 'i dpon po gcig bdud kyisasprul pa'i rgyal po gsum 'phra da pa'ibastan pa hor la gtad me stag chu la 'phrad bzhin byed rtso gi dgon gnasame tog la dam sri'i stobs rtsal g.yo ba las bla sprul dge 'dun nang dbyen ston 'on kyang ki la'i lo sgrub 'dzug pad 'byung sprul pa'i skyobasapa ra 'gyur rwa bzha'i gsal dgon 'ga' zhag la smon log gnod sbyin sprul pa yis mi dge bcu yis chos 'khor bsgor 'brel tshad rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'dren lha yi rtse mo'i cod pa ṇa te gnod sbyin rgyal ngo 'a dar la btegs khrag gi mchod pa

da bcas nas sa 'tshamasabazhi ru ga par byed khro chen 'brong gi rwa la brten gser gyi 'od mdangs bsdu lachas rdo ri khro lod bskal bar bsngags rten 'brel ral na phung bar 'gyur rab brtan gsang sngag dgon pa'i gzhir bdud 'dul 'bar ba'i khang da ki la ya yis sgrub sde 'dzug de yi bcu phrag bcu la dge a la ma mtshan skyabs kyis sar:gnub kyi mnga' bdag ra dza des glo bur mi bde co 'dra ngoms:ngesamed ri la byin na dge gserasmad gnas gzhe 'ga' re ya la la dam sri'i ngabang du ca ra la la bdud kya kha la 'tshor la la ra dza'i dpal du sdad la la dme 'khrugasaga'i ma lags byam mabon mje pa' sa mig la zod phreng sprul pa bcu gsum 'byung rtags da rten 'bre' phun sum tshogs bskal bza bkra shisadagon pa la zhang blon sprul pa 'i blo stobs kyis 'od snod khrag ga bskyil pa 'byung 'brong nga mkha' 'gro'i 'du khang la gsar gyisaganasagazhi ri khrod dar grub pa'i bstan gzhi rgyas pa yang srin mo'i dam tshag dus bab nas chen ngo 'a sa de shor kya srid shug kyi mgazlum po la ra dza'i rkyen gyisachu 'jig 'byung rgod ldemasasprul pa'i skyobasapa ra ra g.yu yis mig bzang po ru gsal byed zla ba khros pa las 'bangs kyi rje bo' srog la brdo ga tshom rkun po 'i gnas gzha byed bkra shis gshin nge 'i e klong du nga na sngags rang la ldog pa las klu nad sa bdag rlangs pa 'phyo shel gyi spu gri lag tu lon 'brong mig sta

sa /: ga mo'i sa la 'phyo 'dzamasapa la ya thang dkyil te: rgya hor bdud kyis khra bor gnas ta ra na yis sprul pa bcu rim byon skyobs kyang mtha' ma ru kla 1'i khrim khang chen por bca' g.yul gsal ba'i sgron me'i 'od dpa la ske'u la phog nas 'gugs de yang snyang po sa thig ler bzlum sa ro phyogs sngags pe grub pa'i sar sngar med khro lod bstan pa skyongs ha cing sgrol ba'i las gol naḥ lnga lnga mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad yongs chosaskyong byinarlabs dgong pa yal nag phyogs gdugs pa 'i kha 'dzin byed rnam shes ngan song gsum du mnar la lngan mo'i 'tshogs gsum na rje bo smon log bu gsum byed: 'thab brtsod mi dge'i chos grwa dar rnam sman wa min 'phenapa 'i rgyu gnyan po g.yu yisarwa bar du sngar med ljon shi gsar ba 'khru sa a yis rla sa pa gnam la bsdu rgyal ba'i bstan gzha'i re tog la pho waṃ dkar po'i 'dzin pa'i dus lha dpal sprul pa shar nasa'abyung bstan dgra de dgasun 'byin 'gyur wa la mare pa'i co da pa ṇa te 'tshams nas rlung gis bskyod par nye bsrungs ma las la ma rbad na dam sri nag po'i sbubs su bsdu sbra la gdo sagis brgyan pa de lnga na khro yis ril bur gyur dug shing bdudakyi skyal ba de 'thor sdud rlung gis byed las kyas la khang mod la gtan srid 'dzin chab kyi sa mdo bzang po la yul gnyis khros pa'i khrag char 'bebs sde chen dge bar bdud kyis phog pad 'byung sprul pa byang nas 'ongs de yis

skyobs pa'i dpal du 'gyur mdangs ban go yi ra dza des gser gyisami da pon bla rje bslu bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid bcom rtsekung sprul pa tshe ya mang rang gzhan yul la dme 'byugs ston sde gsum phung brlag byed nasayal hor rgya ra dza'i sprul pa ni shel dkar 'phre ba lus la 'dogs sdig brtsol bshan pa'i bya bar brtson rnam smin ban song gzhi ma lags 'jang gi btsan dmar me stag gis sprul pa dar ba'i mig nasa'abyung pha la'i ming can blo stobs rgyas dgra stur lcagasakyu'i bya ba byed mon nag klu bdud sbrul mgo yi skye rtags phrin lasamig 'dzan pas rang srad chas la gnod pa byed 'ad phyi gnyis ker sdug lasa'agyed bdud kyisogarod sbyin btsan rgod kyi sprul pa nya dge purje'i ming mngon lkog sdag pa'i las gar spyod phyi ma kha 'thor yi dwag 'dzin gzhan mang bdud nag sum brgya yis sprul pa' rgya bal bod yul gang: dmag 'khrugasalasag 'ba' zhig spyod skye 'gro yongasakyisabade skyid bcoms 'di du bstan pa nyams dma' 'o nga sprul bye bas ya 'byed rang skal 'gro ba 'ga' re smin mtsho rgyal 'di la skyo ma mdzad phan pa'i sprulapar smon lam thob zhethagasung so mahā guru rin po che gdam pa 'di nyid su 'byin 'gyur sprul pa 'i 'gro ba ci lta ra skyobs gter gnasagang yin ston pa ca bdag po su byed gsung bar zhu kye nyo gzung ma dmatshig ldan ma 'ong dusakyi snyigs ma la mdo khams ga mo'i rusarigasa'achang

sa ni: nga sprul nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal da lta'i khye'u chung dngo sa su byon: gter rigs bco brgyad don la dbang bka' 'di tsha ba'i rong nasadrangs chos bdag 'byu ban dharma dang las kyi 'brel ba' skyes bu bdun tshag gsabaskul ba' bu mchog lnga sgra tsam thos pa 'i gang zag gsum bskal bar ldan pa 'i gzu ma gcig las smon rten 'brel mthu lasa'adzoms: 'gro don ga zag brgya phrag 'dren shing pho 'byug gi lo mjug nyu dpa' bo zangasamadog tsattar byon bsam yas 'gro la pha na thogs 'byu de rjes sprul — rim lnga 'gyed gdul bya las ldan thams cad 'dren shabha la ru rdo rje 'dzan bod khams kla 1 bcom nga ra byed denasasangasargyasacho sapa'i bar bstan pa 'i 'grodon bsam yas byed che rkyen mdzad phrin bar chad rnams bdag da do rje ka la ya dab drag dme ru ral gcig ma'i thamasacad dbyings su bsdu bar 'gyur diphyir gu ma spyi bor mchod yi dam snyi gi ga'ur brten ma da mkha'a'agro mchod cing bstod bstan srung las kyi gnyer du sgrubs brgyad gsum lnga gsum tshogasabaska gtong dkar nag dkor la chog shesagazab dam tshag sngags kyis rma do rtsa sdom bsnyen bsgrub dben pa 'a ri sul snyogs go ma'imadzad spyod legs par bslabs pha chos lag len kha bska dang man ngag mdo rtsa bcasate bkrol chos bdag slob bur gtad par gyas skal bza skyesatshogs sman pa ra byos de yis las smon phun sum tshogs rtags da rten

'brel yongs su dge nyamasad yon tan nar son cing mdzad phrin mang 'a thang gong 'phel rgyas mi bskru nges pa 'i tha tshag yin ze tshom ma byed sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya ye ma lasaldan khyed cag ma 'ong dus dug gsum rkyenasnang bzlog ba 'i phyir zab lam mkha' 'gro'i nyams len 'di tha slod med pa ra brtson pa 'i zu sa de yang dal da yo byad rnams phun sum tshogasapa grub pa 'i 'phral dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni phaṭa: bder gshegs snying po chos kyi dbyings: lhun grub rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: dmigs med dag pa'i skyabs su mchi: 'khor 'das mnyams nyid ye shes la: spang blangs bralaba'i byang chub sems: ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i ngang gdang bca': lan gsum bya gnyisapa byin pho 'beb pa na phaṭa: skye med rgyal ba'i pho brang nas: dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i sde: thugs dam rgyud bskul byin chen phob dbang dang dngos grub char ltar phob: 31 badzra sa ma ya a we sha ya phem phem: gsum pa mchodardzasabyin rlabs ni phaṭa: snang ba 'dod yon bkod pa yang: dag mnyam ye shes rol pa'i brgyan: ma spangs kun tu bzang po'i gter: 'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod du spel

sa ā hūṃ ha ho hrī: badzra spra ra ṇa sa bzha ba la bskyed ni phaṭa kyi stong pa tho por blta phaṭa: kyi snying rje ye shesabaskyed phaṭa: kyisarag pa rgyu ru spro ka dag yeshesachosasku'i klong ma 'gags lhun grub snying rje'i mdangs: rba:yig gsal 'tsher ldan pa las 'phros 'dus dag pa'i zhing khams dbus chags bral pad nyi bam ro'i khar: rgyu yi sa bon zhu ba las bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bzhad ngom dbu sgra gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan dar sna'i cod pan rlung gis g.yeng: nyi ma zla ba'i snyan cha mdzes phag zhal rna ltag g.yas nas ngur spyan gsum phyogs bcur sdang mig bsgrad g.yas pa'i gri gug mkha' la phyar: phyag g.yon thod khrag thugs gar bskyil: zhabs gnyis gar stabs rus rgyan spras: dar dang rin chen dpyangs pa 'phur: stag shams zhin chen glang go klubs: he ru ka pa mchan g.yon brten: 'od lnga me dpung 'khrigs kong bsted: shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar: gri gug thod 'dzin gar stabs 'gyengs: lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ser: ḍa ru bum 'dzin gar stabs

'gyeng nub tu padma mkha' 'gro dmar: kha ṭwāṃ dril 'dzin gar stabs 'byeng byung du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang: tho ba phur 'dzin gar stabs 'byeng: shar ltor zhi byed rnam rgyal dkar: tho ba g.yas la nor bu g.yon sha la rol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: lho nub rgyas byed tshe 'phel ser: lcags phur g.yas la gri gug brten rkang mar 'jibs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: nub byang dbang sdud lha mo dmar zangs 'dren padma dmar po bsnams tshe sdud rus 'cha' mkha' 'gro 'bum byang shar dbugasalen drag mo ljang: lag na rgya gram sbrul zhags thogs: khrag la gzhibs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: shar phyogasa'agugs byed lcagasangakyu dkar: rang rtags g.yas la bhanta g.yon: gnasakyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor lho phyogs 'ching byed zhags pa ser: rang rtags g.yas la nor bu g.yon yul chen mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag rdzogs: nub phyogs sdoms byed lcags sgrogs dmar: rang rtags g.yas la kha ṭaṃ g.yon: dur khrod bsrungs ba'i mkha' 'gros bskor: byang phyogs myos byed dril bu ljang: rang rtags g.yas la gri

sa gug g.yon he ru'i gnas bcu'i mkha' 'gros bskor:shar gyis sgo bsrungasagayag mgo dkar zhing spags lcags kyu'i phyag rgya mdzad: zhi byed mkha' 'grodrug gis bskor lho yi sgo bsrung seng gdong ser bam ro zhags pa'i phyag rgya bsgyur: rgyas byed mkha' 'gro drug gis bskor nub kyis sgo bsrungs khyung mgo dmar rgyum g.yas la lcags sgrogs g.yon: dbang mdzad mkha' 'gro drug gis bskor: byang gis sgo bsrungs sbrul gdong ljang: klad khrag g.yas la dril bu g.yon: drag po'i lasamadzad mkha' 'gro drug: ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal: phyi rim dregs pa sde bzhi ni: bka' nyan klu gshin btsan ma mo: snang stong 'jigs gzugs sku ru bskyed: gzhan yang dpal mgon sde dpon dang: dregs chen brtan ma yongs su rdzogs: lha tshogs sku dang 'od zer gyis sbyin bdag lha 'dre 'byung po dang khams gsum sems can ma lus pa 'od gsal chos sma'i mkha' la zhig rdzogs pa chen por btsan sa zin diltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: bla ma yi dam

mkha' 'gro'i sde:spyan drangasabadzra sam dza lnga pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni phaṭa 'og min chosadabyingasapho brang nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang:sangs rgyasabyang semasasrasa'akhor bcas:dbyings las thugs dam rgyud bskul lo:gnas 'dir sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:ye shes chen po'i dngos grub stsol:o badzra sam ya dza dza:drug pa bas su g.yo ba na phaṭa rang byung rtsal bral ye shes lha ma bcos lhan skyes ga ga ma yis:sku dang yon tan dkyil 'khor la:gnyis med ro gcig brtan par bzhugs sam ya tiṣṭha lhan bdun pa phyag lalabya ba ni phaṭa:'khor 'dasadag pa rab 'byams la:bzang pha blang dor yul lasa'adas:ma bcos rdzogasapa chen po'i lhar:ngo mtshar yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo:sam ya na mo nyobam pa mja khrul bya ba na phaṭa gzung 'dzin gnyisakyi bsdusapa yis:'khor ba'i ru tra ma ṭaṃ ga:bdag med shesarab ral gri'i bsgal:chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i lha la 'bul rtsa brgyad stong sbar bdwad rtsi dang:chags pa bsgal ba'i rakta basmil:brjid ldan dpal gyi gtor go po:ye shes

sa mkha' 'gro'i lha la 'bul mi rta ba glang khyi yi sha: dbugs sha khrag drod sems kyi dbyings: nam mkha' sa chu me rlung bcas lhan skyes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: 'dod yon ma spang phyi mchod sprin: nyon mongs rang grol ye shes nang: sbyor sgrol byang sems gsang mchod bcas: brjod bral mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul thugasadam bskang ngo nyams chagasabashags gsang ba gsum gyis dngos grub stsol: o ma hā sarba pañtsa putstsha khā hi: dgu pa bstod dbyangasabya ba ni phaṭa: stong nyid dbyings kyi rol pa las: sku dang ye shes lhun grub rdzogs: blo bral bde chen ye shes la: rnams gsum dad pa'i phyag 'tshal bstod: rig pa zang thal rtsa yi dbyings: rang byung bskyod byed rlung gi klong mnyam nyid thab chub byang chub sems: rang grol chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: dga' ba rlung gis gzhur drangs te thig le bcu drug dag pa las stong nyid ye shes mngon gyur pa'i: zang thal chos skur phyag 'tshal bstod bdag ni tshe rabs thogs med nas: ma rig las nyon bag chags kun: rab gnong 'gyod pa drag po

yis ye shes mkha' 'gro'i drung du bshags: badzra sam yā ā rsāpa 'dzab kyisalulalor ni stsa bdag nyid phag mo'i thugs ka phu zla ba'i gdan la kun bzang mo de yithugs klong dga' 'khrul sbubs: nyi zla kha sbyor ga'u phu rig pa boḥyig dmar gsal la: rtsa sngagasargyal po'i g.yas su bskor: bzlas pa'i dbang dang dngosagrub thob 'od kyis 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bcas: srog snying nus mthu ma lus pa: bsdus te srog gi snying por bskyil: gtso 'khor ye shes ro gcig gyur: o badzra wa ra hibaṃḥnyariḥni sa / khrum phrag brgyagasum bzlasapa yis bsnyen pa'i grangasarga rdzog pa'o stsa dusagasum rgyal ba srasadang bcas: ma lus 'od kyisarnam par bsdus bdag thim gzibyin 'bar ba dang: ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho thob mar 'phros 'khor ba chos skur bsgral: tshe bsod dpal yon mthu nus bstims: 'khor 'das dag pa rab 'byams su grol thob rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so ma badzra wa ra nyi baṃḥnyari ni sasarba sirji pha la hūṃX āḥ bye ba bzlasapa' dbang dngothagrub ma lusayongs ོga thob par byed sgrub pa'i sngag 'a tsha ba'o

sa 0 sno thugasasrogs ba spu'i bu ga nas: khro khyung me dpung mtshon thun 'phros: byad ma log 'dren 'byung po rnams: bsad bcom rdul du brlag byas te rnam par shes pa chos skur bsgral: rab 'byams phrin las lhun grub bsam: tho badzra wa ra hi baṃX haḥrijeḥs 'aḥyaḥca65ཿsathabaḥyaḥ gnod byed sarba sha hūṃ ma ra ya phaṭa: lathum phrag gsum gyisalasakun 'grub drag po las kyisasbyor ba'o sam/ ya rgya rgya rgya rjes ram tshogasakyisabya ba la bam ro bza' bcing sha khrag brgyan 'dod yon phun sum tshogs byas la da po byin rlabasarim pa ni phaṭa: rang gi rig pa spyi gtsug nas: rgyang gyi thon de mkha' la bsre: slar yang phag mo'i sku ru ldang: brgyad khri bzhi stong dag pa las snang srid mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gyur: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bem po phyi nang snod bcud bcas bdud rtsi bam gyi tshogs dang bsre: 'dod yon rnam dag ye shes kyis: rol ba'i stong khams khyab gyur cig phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gnyisapa spyan 'dren bya ba ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ka dag chos dbyings pho brang nas: rtsa rgyad rig 'jin bla ma rnams: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grab bcas: bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs
