la byon: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i yi dam rnams mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bcas bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dag pa dbyingasakyi pho brang nas kun bzang rdo rje phag mo yang: nyams rtogs yon tan dngos grub bcas: bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas: bde dang stong pa'i dngos grub stsol: bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: tshad med rnam bzhis pho brang nas las mdzad mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas: dga' stong ye shes dngos grub bcas bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa gnasayul dur khrod he ru nas: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams: lhan skyes 'od gsal dngos grub bcas bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa bka' gsang gnyan gyis pho brang nas las mdzad dbang byug sgo sbongs bcas: phrin las rab 'byams dngos grub bcas: bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:

sa dam tshig dbyings kyi pho brang nas dpal mgon dregs chen brtan mar bcas: tha tshig gnyan po'i dngos grub bcas: bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: stong pa nyid kyi pho brang nas: 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i sems can rnams las snang bag chags bral bzhin par bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa 'dzin rtogs spros pa'i pho brang nas wa srin bgegs rigs mgron rnams kun rngams sems zhi ba chen po yi bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la byon phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gsum pa rga phud mja pa ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rang byung ye shes gnyug ma'i sku dus gsum sangasargyas sras dang bcas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sde bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la rol: byin rlabs dngos grub nyams rtogs bskyed: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' srung tshogs dregs chen dpal mgon sde dpon dang 'dzam gling brtan ma dbang phyug tshogs bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la rol: phrin las bsgrab la rog ldan mdzod: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: 'gro byug khams gsum sems can dang: bgegs rigs

zhin chags mgron gyis rigs: khas zhan dbang chung bcas pa rnams bdud rtsi bam gyis tshogs la rol: mya ngan 'das pa'i sa thob shog: lha dang rnal 'byor pho mor los: phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogasal rol: kho na nyid kyis bcud chen spyod: sku gsum ye shesaslong du stobs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bzhi pa wagasapa'i rim pa ni phaṭa dpang gyur tre ma dkon mchog gsum: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i lha gnas yul ma dang mkha' 'gror bcas: thugasarje'i brtse ba chen po'i dgongs: bdag ni 'khor ba thogs med / sa ma rig las nyon dbang gyur te: sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa la: 'gal 'khrul nong pa gang song yang: snying nas 'gyod pa drag pos bshags mi 'chab mi sted sgog /da sdoms dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsol: yig brgya sabar brjod lnga pa bsgral la bya ba ni 'gugasagazhugasagra saldan bskyal ba'i rjes phaṭa: sku gsum ye shesalnga'i klong nas / bo rang bzhin thugs rjes sku: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag bcas thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs: nyon 'khrul dug lnga'i dbang gyur pa'i: bstan

sa ba 'gror 'tshe ba'i dgra 'dre gdon: ma lus thal ba'i rdul du rlog rnam shes chos kyis dbyings su drongs: gsang sngags che ba'i khyad chos ston: ma 'da' badzra sa ma ya sarba ru tra mā ra ya phaṭa drug pa bstabs 'i rim pa na phaṭa: gzung 'dzan nyamasapa bsgral ba yis sha khrag rus pa phung por bcas: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror bstabs: brtul zhugs ye shes dngos grub stsol: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bdun pa lag ma 'byul ba ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sngon gyisatha tshog la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i rigs 'chang rnal 'byor ma shar nas zhi ba'i las mdzad bdun: sprul pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bcas: 'dod yon wag gtor mchod pa bzhes: rin chen rigs 'chang rnal 'byor ma:lho nas rgyas pa'i las mdzad bdun: sprul pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bcas: 'dod yon lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: padma'i rigs 'chang rnal 'byor ma: nub nas dbang gi las mdzad bdun: spral pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bcas: 'dod yon lag gtor mchod pa bzhes: las kyis rigs 'chang rnal 'byor ma: byang nas drag pos

las mdzad bdun sprul pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bcas 'dod yon lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma dang king dang ling ga stobs chen brgyad dpa' bo dpa' mo 'khor dang bcas: sil snyan dril g.yer sgra sgrogs cing: glu len bro brdung khrigs se khrig dar sna'i cod paṇa lhubs se lhub: ru mtshon sna tshogs sha ra ra: rdo rje'i dam rtags 'od dang ldan: tha tshig gnyan la dgongs bzhin du: 'dod yon brgyan gyis lhag la rol dam rdzas gcang ma'i lhag la rol sha khrag spungs pa'i lhag la rol pha phab bka' yis lhag la rol: rlangs chen dpal seng dam tshig bzhin: za kha sdang byed dgra la ston: myur mgyogs mthu rtsal bgegs la mdzod: rnal 'byer bcol pa'i phrin las sgrubs: ma 'da' badzra sa ma yā: u tsi ṭa bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā ༷ brgyad pa chad mdo brtan ma ni sbya saspelabasgyur gsum grub pa'i phral phaṭa:ye shes 'jig sten las mdzad pa'i dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang phyi nang legs nyes ltang 'dzin mdzad: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu po: bstan dgra sgol ba'i shan

sa 0 pa che: 'jigs byed dregs tshogs bco brgyad dang bod khams skyongs ba'i tha tshig can 'dzam gling brtan ma bcu gnyis sde gter gyi yang snying bcud 'dzin pa'i: sbas pa'i ma mo mched gsum sogs 'jigs byed bka' srung dam can rnams sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: 'jigs tshogs dgra bgegs zhi ba dang tshe dpal mnga' thang 'byor ba spel: khams gsum zas nor dbang du bsdus: gnod byed 'byung po tshar chod cig: zab gsang bstan pa'i sgron me sbor dge 'dun bzhed pa phun tshogs bsgrubs: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: cesabarjod garṣa skyemasagatsang sar gshegs dgu pa bro mnan bya ba na phaṭa: tshos dbyings stong pa'i mkha' klong du gzung 'dzin mtshan rtogs dam sri brub ye shes lnga yis bro ra'i bcoms: dug gsum bag chags 'khrul 'khor bshig: chen med lam gyis bro 'khrubs te: rtog bral kun bzang dgongs pa'i sbabs: ska gsum dgongs par sangs rgyas shog: tshe ā hūṃ swā ha sto byu ya nan: mig cang bstod pa song ba'i rjes rsā pa dngosagrub len pa ni phaṭa: spyomed yeshesabum pa nas:

snang stong sku yis dngos grub stsol:'gags med rang byung bhanta rtsabade stong gsung bcud dngos grub stsol:rtsol bral dwangs ma'i 'od klong nas:dga' stong thugs gsang dngos grub stsol:lhun grub me long dkyil 'khor nas rig stong yon to dngos grub stsal:rtsol med bde ba chen po nas:gcer byung ye shes dngos grub stsol:ma dag 'byung khams phung po 'di:rda rje gsum gyis ral bar rlobs kun gzhi nyon yid sems dang bcas:dag pa sku gsum dbyangs su rlobs:zhabrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos:stong nyid dbu ma chen por sgrol:mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa'i tshad dam them lhan skyes bde chen gtum mo sbor:rang byung dpa' bo'i rgyud bskul te:bcu drug gsum gyis gzhir drangs nas:ye rdzogs chos sku'i dngos grub stsol:rtsa sngagasamathar kā ya wāka tsitta sarba garmā sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥbs/ga gag cing bzod gsogani phaṭa:bdag gi tshe rabs thogs med nas ma rig las nyon dbang gyur te:phyi nang gsang ba'i sdom pa la:'gal 'khyal nyams pa ci song yang:snying nas 'gyod sems drag pos bshags:

sa cha sa ma ya shuddhi āX bcu gnyilobasngo ba smon lam ni phaṭa: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa ni ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i ye gzhi'isbubs: khyab brdal chos sku thob par shog: rsā gsum rtag ra tha' bsal ba ni phaṭa: snang srid snad bcud dag mnyam lha: ma bcos ye rdzogs chos kyi sku: rtsol bral bde ba chenapor bsdu: blo 'das ka dag ngang la yan: a āḥ bcu bzhi sto mtha' ba4 ba ni phaṭa: slar yang tshasasku'i rol pa las: rang byung ye shes chen po'i rtsal: snang stong ḍakki wa rahis: lhar snang phyag rgya chen por spyod: phaṭa phaṭa: lo lnga bkra shisabya ba ni phaṭa yidag nam mkha' lta bu la dag mnyam kun tu bzang mo'i klong: 'khor 'das ye rig gdodama'i gshis: lta ba dag pa'i bkra shis shog bde chen lhun grub nyi zla'i gshis: rang grol ma rig mun pa sel: zang thal ye shes wa ra hi: kun gsal bsgoms pa'i bkrashis shog: jo bral thig le yangs pa la: lngan skes ngasheg ma rang byang ba: zung 'khrug phyag rgya tshol 'byor ma: spang jage bral ba'i bkra shis shog: sngong chen phyogs mtha'

yas pa la gsal khyab ye shes yon tan rgyas mngon byung rang rig rdzogs pa che:lhun grub 'bras bu'i bkra shis shog:cesabarjod me tog sal ma bkram de yi yon to yo sasu ོgas sa ma ya ye ma mtsho rgyal khye'u rmo tsa khyod bdag gi gdam pa thugs thig 'di shin tu zab ci byin rlabasamyur nyamasartog yon tan nang na sbar salam dgong pa'i btsan gzan za thal ye shesaklong nas rdol 'di da phyi ma'i don kun 'grub ze tshom med do sarma ya da dung bstan pa'i gnas ma yin dza brgya dus kyasatha ma la dpa' bo pyod dang 'phrad par shog chosabadag 'bru ya bande 'di padma chosa'aphe la mtshan rtag 'chang galtar kha yo sakyi bdag pa'o 'gro ba' don 'byung the tshom re da shar na su 'i mtshan can pa dge btsun gtam nag 'tshol po 'byung lho nas g.yu sgra'i ming can de sngagasarig grub — 'i dpa la lasa'abyung nub nasakirta' ming can ni dge rtse'i rusa'achang rta lo pa byang nas kun bzang ming can na sngags nag spro thung rig pa hur shar lce'i pha la'i ming can pa dge btsun thos yid nor dang ldan lho nub dzñā na'i ming can pa nyams len gnad la gdu semasache nub byang bra tsa'i mi 'dzan pa snying rusasdug sran cheba'o lasakyisa'abrelaba'i skyes bdun yin dharmā ratā masgo' ming ma hā busa'i mtshan da bcas tshig gis bskul ba'i bu lnga yin phug sdug 'di 'phos dharmā'i ming bye'u mtha' ma pha la'i

༄snye ming sbra sabu ma 'ong padma'i ming sgra tsam thos pa'i bu gsum yin rgyal po'i srasamo sa le sman log pa bdud kyisam bslad na kun bzang dgongs pa skyongasal cha 'di ni sde mig ra'i ming de dag dusakyisa'adzom par 'gyur rten 'brel lag len ma 'khrug ni phan bde nyi zla phyogs bcur rgyas 'gro don mkha' la mnyam pa ra 'o gdul bya bye ba 'dren par ra basmu med rgyal ba'i gtan tshag yin bka' bsrung klu gshin btsan ma mo gter bdag drag mo mched gsum gyis thub par sru shig sam yā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gtad rgya cesapa 'di yang shar phyogs rgyal mo tsha rong nasaspyan drangs ba' ran po che'i shog ser lasazhal bdusarte chos kyis bdag pokhu mud dharmās bzhed ngor phab pa dge'o/dge'o/dge'o/legs so sarba masgo lam:

sa ཿ ho: bla med gsang chen sngags kyis rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur ba 'dis: rnal 'byor pho mo'i thugs dam bskangs rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer gyis zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor mnyes gyur cig: a la la ste bde ba che: ga ṇa tsakra sidhi hūṃ: de ltar gtsang sme bral ba yi: bzang ngan che chung mi sems par: ye shes rol pa'i lam khyer nas: myong tshad theg chen chos nyid spyod: tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas 'grub: sarba sirnyi pha la oṃ āḥhūṃ: cesarol bar bya'o 'ad ya nye bar mkho ba'i phyi ra klo yang sngagasakyisarnal 'byor pas sprang spyon sa phug gab pa'i mi ku su lu pa su 'i spel dharmā'i thugs bzhed 'grub ra shog sarba maṅga lam

sa /ཿ zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: gdams pa yang bcud zab mo yis: gter bsrungs mchod pa'i bya ba bzhugs:caniḥ na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye:shārachan napa skyes mchog gi pho nya mo don dam rdo rje pha ga mor 'dud gdams pa zab lam snying khrags gis ga' bdag ma mo mapo gsum gyis mchod gsol bya ba' rim pa na sha khrag gtor ma ja 4 skyems bā lang rin za bye ma 4sa sbya sa spel bsgyur ba'i byin gyis mas rang nyid yi dam par gsal nga hūṃ bhyo: mdun du me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong: bhyo dza ma:las gter bdag mched gsum ni: khro mo mi bzad drag po'i gad rgyang sgogs: dbus su ye dhar mthing4༅ gang seng dkar mo chen: mi lpags rlon pa'i go bgos yo khra tshig sbrul gyis brgyan kha ṭaṃ lcags phur thogs nas dgra snying 'dren: g.yas su glog ma sprin dmar g.yu 'khrug mkhye: zhe sdang smug nag yog sbrul gyis thul pa stag shams mdzes:thogs thog sa mig mda' ral gri'i byad ma'i tshe srog sngad: g.yon phyogs phung byed nag mo'i rnga mong zhon: rmadangagasaskug pomab bya'i thal pa seng lcags rngams pa'i bgron

sgrul zhags nag po yogatho ba'i bstan dgra rdul du brlag: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro las la 'gyed kun gyis spyi gtsugasardo rje'i dam rtags dang ral ba gyen bajis 'bar ba'i thogs char 'phro: 'khor rtsabadrugamo lo padma'i snyan cha'i dam ldan skyongs: ratna mi mgo'i do shal dar dpyang 'phur dpral bar zla ba lte rgyan nyi ma rgyas:'phur byed skor4༅gshogs pa bar snang gnas su bskyod: nu g.yas bdud rtsi'i nyams rtogs ye shes stsol: g.yen pa' khrag char dgra la dal yams 'thor 'gyeng gzugs srin mo khros pa'i gzugs su bskyed thugs srog 'od kyis gar bzhugs gnas mchog nas: spyan drangs dbyer med ro gcig brtan par bzhugs sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs phyir dad phyag 'tshal: gdungs dbyangs mos gus rol mo'i sgra yis bstod phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: nang gi 'dod yon gzugs sgra dre ro reg gsang ba sman dang rten 'brel rakta 'khyil rmad byung gtor ma bdud rtsi ja chang stems sha khrag dam rdzas bā ling ri ltar sprangs: rin chen sna lnga'i bye ma sprin

ga ltar 'khrigs: sha dgo rna ba bya nag mchu ser dang rta dril bong glang ma he 'dod 'jo'i ba: kar sha pa ni dung gi mig mang ris: mda' dar sna lnga shel tshig phye mar dang: wa shing bsang dud rol mo sna tshogs sgra mdor na ma mo mnyes pa'i mchod sprin gyis gter bsrung sngags bdag mched gsum gsol zhing mchod: ral gcig las byed bcu gsum gsol zhing mchod: bsrung ma phur thogs nyer gcig gsol zhing mchod: bstan skyong ma mo 'bum sde gsol zhing mchod sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskang bar bgyi: nyams chags 'gal 'brul nong pa mthol lo bshags: dgyes brtse'i dgongs shig phrin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde skyongs shig dkon mchog dbu bstod mtshan ldan sku tshe bsrings: dge 'dun rabs spel bshad sgrub yar zla bskyed: pad 'cho bgarṣa sgo 'pha ra bdag pa sprod gsang ba snying khrag nam mkha'i mthar khyab mdzod: bstan la 'tshe ba'i dgra sde thal bar rlog tshe srog gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs bsgal ba dang: byad phur rbod gtong 'jigs brgyad

g.yul ngo gzhoms tshe dpal 'byor ba nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed:khams gsum srid pa'i zas nor phywa g.yang khug:mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs nad yams mu ge bzlog:rdzogs ldan lang tsho dga' ston 'phel rgyasamadzod:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sam yu:64rjogosasnyem4long4mag4ma la khatsalamyur du ba the tsho'idado ༅ rgyargyargyagu rgya ca kyang chosabag 66 bar ngor gsatsang nusaldan pa sasgral ba dag lag 'phal ga'o gsol mchod bsdu pa grang bsogasatsha da nyad kho na ru ba yan skyam gtorabyan gya brlab na phral ra nyad lha masang rgyalargyas ku dad dang dam tshig dpang btsug te:ma mo mched gsum 'bod do byon dam tshig gsang ba'i rten la bzhugs:phrin lasabasgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal:phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul:sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskang ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa bshags:rnam bzhi'i las kyis sdong grogs mdzod zab gter gsang ba'i pha phog gtod:gdamasapa bsrung la mel rtse gyis dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog:dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā cis nus bzlas pa'i phran las 'grub rgya rgya rgya gu hye ces kyang padma chos 'phel kyas bskul ngor nus lan rdo rje' bris pa dge legasa'aphel dge'o

sa : zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las bka' bsrungs sde bzhi'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: chos rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byer ma don dam rdo rje phag mor 'dud bdag 'dra pa dma 'byung gnas sa ma 'ongasalas ldan don go du bstan srung sgrub pa 'i gsol mja bstan sha brag gtoram ja lo skyems bdud rtsi 'o phud bshams nas su phyag rgya jagasakyisabyin mas te hūṃ dza jon tshe padma 'byung gnas spyan ja dza khas jangs dam tshig gnyan gyis mthu ldan pas: bstan srung sgog bdag rnam bzhi spyan 'dren gshegs: sgrub rdzas ja rdo sgog gi 'khor lo bzhugs: gsang jags bstan pa bsrungs phyir gus phyag 'tshal: bdud rtsi 'o ma dkar gsum gtor chen po'i: mi mgon dkar po yab yum gsol zhing mchod dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan ba ling gis: ya ma ra tsa 'khor bcas gsol lo mchod sha khrag ri ltar smangs ba'i dam rdzas kyis: sgog bdud dmar po yab yum gsol zhing mchod: dza gad ja phud gtor ma'i yo byad kyis: dpal lngan re rti 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod:

sku gsung thugs yon phrin las thugs dam bskangs: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nong pa mthol lo bshags: zas nor longs spyod phywa g.yang char ltar phob: 'jig pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba zhi: tshe dpal 'byor ba yar ngos zla ltar rgyas: khams gsum srid gsum mos bzhi dbang du bsdus: byad ma log 'dren bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: rnal 'byor dben khrod 'grim pa'i 'tsho ba sbyor: tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrubs pas lam grogs mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya ces brjod phran lasarab 'byamaso'agrub phya nang gas ba'i bar chad sel dab dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur the tshom med do sam yā rgya rgya rgya gu hye snyi ces pa 'ad yang chos kyi bdag po pa dma chosa'aphel gyisabaskul ngor gter mang nusaldanardo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam/

༄ na ma:gter bsrung gsol bsda bya ba la ja 4 skyemasaphud byin masanas kyi:sngon tshe padma 'byung gnas kyis:sbyan sngar khas blang dam bcas pa'i gter gyis bsrungs ma mthu mo che:sha za mched gsum gsol lo mchod bka' 'khor yongs rdzogs gsol lo mchod thugs dam bskangs ngo 'khu ltog byang:rnams bzhi'i las rnams 'grub pa dang zab gter bsrung ma mel rtse mdzod tha tshig dgongs mdzod sa ma yā cas pa ca ma bsogs pa na phran la yong su 'grub pa ra sa sa ma yu cas kya mtsho bskul ba' ro ra sags nag 'du shes gsum pas spel dga'o/

sku zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las:mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo' dkyil 'khor du:tshags bskang skabs su gtong ba'i mkha' 'gro'i sun bzlog zab mo bzhugs na mo gu ru dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: —— lhanaskyesardo rje phagalo dru thosakyi spyor lobaskor ba'i du4blta 'dzin skyesabudamapa rnams ga pad gan phyir sun bzlogasul trī:gangasaljong bstan pa'igazhi ma che:bslab gsum me tog rab phyug cing:legasabyasanyi ma dar byed pa'i:phan bde'i gter chen rab rgyasashing skye 'gro yongasakyi ded dpon mchog:'di na bzhugasapa'i skyes bu rnams tshe 'phrang bar chad zhi ba dang:rtag brten sku khams bde ba'i phyir:'bumaphrag mkha' 'gror tshogasamachod 'bul 'gal zhabrul dam tshig nyamasachagasabashags:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sun ma bzlog:zhabs pad brtan pa'i bkra shis shog:de ltar grang ldan bskyal yis phyinang 'gal zha ba leg rgasagonganasagong 'phelam the pomed do sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang chosakya bdag popadmamasa' la rgya mtsho'i bskul ngor bdag 'dra nusaldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i brda risal dag par phab pa dge na bkra shis par gyur cigasarba mtho lam/

sa rdzu zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: mkha' 'a144chogs bskang zab mo bsod nams mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: chen ka mchog tu yi'agyur bde chen ye shes daro sa zang thal 'gyur med gnyug ma'i de nyid gshis kun bza rdo rje phag mo' da la ru bsod nams ma tha' yas tshogs kyi bkod nga bstan sha khrag lasogasabaza' 4'a bayo ba'i rigs dum gcig snod du lams la 'di skad gyer 33āḥsno 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu kā pa la: rang byung dum gcig snod du bde stong rdzas: sha khrag dzagad pañtsa a dṛ ta: 'bru sman rin chen dkar mngar bzang po drug: bza' bca' btung ba 'dod yon rnam lnga'i gter phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod rgya mtsho rnams: rtsagasum 'dus zhal rdo rje phag mo mchod: thugs dam skong la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags gzung 'dzin rū tra bdag medachen pos bsal: ye shes gsang ba'i kong du kha lha stobs tshim pa drag lngan mchog gi longs smod rol: lngag gtor bzhes la brin las grab par mdzod bu ru dzrewa ḍakri

ni dzñā na wa ra hi gha ṇa tsakra pūtstsha kha kha khā hi kha hi:de ltar grangs ldan su bskyal tshe phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang tshogs rdzogasasgrab sbyangasadangosagrub thob gan skabasatsha yi gegasasel zhi mthar thugasaskuganyis mngon du gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi cesapa 'di yang padma chosa'athelargya mtshosabaskul ngor sngagasa'achang nu ldan rdo rje shar mar spel ba dge legs 'phel/sabo ma lam/snyi dza ha ram/

da 2 zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i bskul ba brin las lhun grub bzhugs so:na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye ༅/spasgom mkha' 'gro 'dus pa 'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe gtor bskul zab mo bya ba la skyems gtor bshams la byin rlabs nas rang nyid ya dam lhar gsal ngang phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: tshos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas: rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje phag mo'i sku: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gar bsgyur bsam yas rnams: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod gnod byed dgra bgegs brlag pa'i dus la bab ma g.yel gdug pa 'dul ba'i dpa' shugs byung mthu rtsal drag po ston pa'i las mdzod cig: cesabarjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs gnad des phrin lasarab 'byams 'grub the tshom med do sam ya snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya lha cesapa 'di yang chosakyibadag po padam masa' lagyis bskul ro ra sngags 'chang nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bdus te dag pa ra phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam

5) tsho 'idagasto bas sasbyang ni o swā bha wa sogasarnya:rang mdun sgolasarin chen snod yangs shing rgya che gyur pa'i nang:tho las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga zad medanam mkha'i mdzod du gyur:za 'dre shi gshed sgog gcod dang dbugs len gshed ma bla khyer rnams:ro mas tshim 'dod pa'i gter du gyur:oṃ.ā / ༅ gsum sabha ra dang ni.a ka 1du yis byin gyis rlabs de nas zha drag sbyangs bar laca gaḥ'adi la cha rkyen mkho'o zhes dharmās bzhad ngor surya'i spel sarba ma ga lam

༄snye zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las ḍakki yan lag zab mo bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye:tshan/gzod nasarnam dag ye shes sku don dam bya chub sems la 'dud bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse phyir du gdamasapa zab pa' chos skor bstan mtsho rgyal khye'u chungakhyod kyis zungs yi ma lnga brgya du kyi tha ma la nga nyid nus ldan rdo rje bzhed sa kun bza dgongs pa 'i btsan sa zin wa phran gdug pa zil gyisaganon mtha' dmag dusa'abyugasand yam sel de yisabasgo skal zab pa 'igater rgyal mo tsha ro man ga 'ad ya' ga'i ra dwags chu nathabartse grangs tshad rten 'brel bdo sad 'gyur gser ldan stag gi 'jo sgegs dus gurubadag gi snang brnyan dang shelargyas gri gnam lcagasaphur ba yido 'phyo sgroms — cas brgya phrag tshogs pa 'a dbusanas 'byed snyan grags 'dzam gli pha mthar brdal bkra shis dge ba'i lang tsho bshad skal lan gdul bya'i 'du ba rgyas smin grol gdam pa' 'a da sgrub spel log lam bdudalas rgyal bar 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma ya gu bye skabasathogs gdul bya rjes 'dzan phyir mdun gyi dkyil 'bor dbye ba ni phaṭa dza:bdag nyid rig pa'i ye shes las:dran rdzogs don dam lha sku'i

rtsal: mdun mkhar gsang ba phag mo'i dal: ma bskyed rang byung chu zla bzhin: me ri 'dabs 'byar tshul du gsal bsnyen pa sgrub pa la sbyor gto den bum pa sakyisadagang rnaralnga nyer spyod 4sate ༅mas de naswa bha lha sasbyangs bum pa mi dmigasastong par gyur: de yisangang las skad cig gis: lhun grub gzhal yas yangasapa'i dbus (ཿlasargya mtsho'akhyil ba'i slong: padma'i sdong po nyi zla'i khar ( las rdo rje phag mo dmar: zhi 'dzum chags nyamasabade stong 'bar dar dang rus pa rin chen brgyan: he ru ka pa mchan dubarten gar thabs gri thod phyag rgya bsgyur: stag shams mi mgo sbrul chun 'phyang rna stag phag zhal ngur sgra sgrogs: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro sprul 'khor 'byed: 'od 'barame dpung klong na bzhugs: thugs srog 'od kyis rgyal kun dbab: dam ye gnyis med ro gcig bzhugs: mosagus dad brgyasaphyag 'tshal lo phyi nang gsang ba'i mchodapa 'bul nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nob pa bshags:oṃ badzra dzā na ḍakki ni sa ma ya dza dza: tarnyi lhan na mo na ma ho: ma ha a pabye puṅge dma pe sogasashabha ru pa shasto

sa sogs dharma sarba pañtsa rakta bha ling ta khā hi: nyu hrī: bde chen gdod nasaye sangs rgyas: lhun grub rang byung wa ra hi: gnyis med sprul 'khor yongs rdzogs la:rnam pa kun tu dad brgya'i bstod: bum lha'i thugs gar nyi zla'i steng hūṃḥdamar sngags kyis phreng ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus bdud rtsi'i rgyun: bab pas bum pa gang bar dmigs: bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor sngags la brtson de yis ra bang da dang sa grub rgyas slar yang mchad ci bstod pa'i rjes badzra rlu: ye shes semasadapa' dbyings su gshegs: dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum chu la thims pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: de nasalas bum bsgrub pa ni: o swā bha wa sogs lasabum rin chen yangs pa'i nang: bsgyur byed rdo rje rlung 'byin ma:zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro tshul rgyas: sngo nag gtum la bzhengs pa'i stabs rdo rje bhantas phyag rgya bsgyur: stag shams mi mgo'i phreng ba rdzogs 'od 'bar me dpung 'khyil ba'i kong: sngang stong sgra ma'i ska ru bsted: gnas gsum 'od kyis ye shes dbab: ska las dag byed bdud rtsi'i rgyan: bab pas nyes smon srungs bar dmigs

dzunta tshinta sarba bisne shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: brgya sto la sogasabaskyal ba'i rjesaḥl bum bzlasarjesamar bstod la dzñā na ḍakkini badzra a/ ru pa shabha dharma pañtsa rakta bha ling ta khā dhi hū hrī ra ma khro gtum pa'irang bzhin las: bgegs tshogs ma lus mthar bar byed: bde stong rgyun gyis lha tshogs mchod: rlung 'byin pha rol phyin la bstod:cesakyang lam 'dis rkyen mas bzhed pa don ldan phyir nusaldan rdo rje'i bris pa dge/ lha byed 'ed du zhu nas bum chu dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan du gyur:cesabarjod dbang phyir rig me dor bdag nyad lajug pa'i bya bar bslabs ba mar dbang bskur byasakya ru ya na snyang de saga' don du yon po rjes su 'dzan pa la da po ming byang bskyed go ni: ma ma hā shu bye ta sogs ko3nya rang nyid rdo rjephag mo yi: mdun du padma / ba'i steng: shrīḥyig phongs sugyur pa las: che 'das phung khams skye mched kun: gson po'i gnas skabs ci lta bu ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal: de nasabaden sa'abyugs pa ni na tho: mchog gsum sma gsum rtsa ba gsum: bden gnyis bsla med nus mthu yis: tshe 'das rnam shes srid pa gsum: rigs drag bar do gar gnas

sa kyang:skad cig dmigs pa'i rten 'dir khug dzaḥya dza badzra a gu sha dza brgya rtsa lagosaskabasadang bsga de na dbyer med bstimapa ni hrī:'asdig rten 'di snang las thal tshe 'das khyod:khams gsum rigs drug gar skyes sdug bsngal gzeb:de las 'don phyir gzugs ming rdzas mchog dang:ro gcig brten bzhugs dad mos shugs bskyed cig dzaḥdza hūṃ baṃ ho:de nasasbyangasaba' ram pa la da po zha sbyangasacogardog re sngagasadang bsgragasal g.yasasu bskor snyen sarba bisne na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bhyo bi sogasaswā 1de nasophyed mar sbya sabani tang lo gsum po gong ltar du sngagasabasgragasagapon du bskor byasate snyen sum̐ bha ni sum nyu ghristo sogasaphaṭa:de na drag pa'i sbyang ba ni hūṃ /sa' nar bar 0665sa pa'i bag chags 'dre:ngar 'dzin bdag gis bcing pa yis:za 'dre shi gshed sgog gcod dang:dbug len bla khyer phyir deng shig:dragasasngagasathun gyi bskrad byasate 4grud dor lagadon bgagasabasal denasabasrung spyor bsgom pa ni hūṃ hri:snang srid thamasacad rdo rje'i zhing:bgrang pa'i 'khor lo rim lnga'i gur gachos bral pha lam lta bu la:gdon bgegasanam yang 'da' mi nus

oṃ badzra dzñā na rakta rakta hūṃ: denathasdig sgrib bsregasasbyang ni hū hrī lasalasaskyesapa'i tshe 'das kyis spyi bo ltag pa snying ga dang lte ba gsang gnas rkang mthil du: 'gro drug las kyis sa bon ni: mjetshogakhriḥpreskosasnams: gnas pa'i 'od kyis las nyon mongs: rgyu dang 'bras bu kun bsdusabastim: slar yang rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma'i: lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba'i me ro rkyang lam brgyud ting sgron la: thim pa'i ye shes me ri 'bar tshe 'das sna bug nas zhugs te las nyon sdig sgrib phra rags dang: sabon bag chags ma lus pa: bsregs nas stong pa nyid du gyur ma badzra dzñā na wa ra nyi baṃ nyu tshe las 'das pa'i las nyon sarba pa pā a driX su tri pre du dzwa la ram̐ sarba bha smi ku ru ye swā snya gzung sngag brjod la bye mabrab de na bden don gad pa ni kyi rdo tshe 'dasarigasakyi bu: 'di ltar 'khrul ba'i snang ba kun: med bzhin ma rig pa lasabyung bdag nyid gcig pu'i na la rtsa byas: lan stes rtog pa'i yul rdu shar: de ma thags pa'i bden par bzungs: kun btags dbang gis 'khor ba grab: ma myong ma grab mi 'byang ba'i:

sa 0 chos kun sems kyis bzos pa ste: 'gro ba rigs drag khams gsum yul rten dang brten pa'i bkod pa rnams: bden par ma grub stong pa nyid: 'di dang phyi ma rmi lam snang: thams cad rtog pa'i gshes nyams tsam dgeg dang mi dge'i bye brag gyis 'khor ba'i bde sdug 'byung ba las gzhan nas sus kyang sbyin len med des na sems nyid stong pa yi: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i gdangs: dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin tha dad ma sems rang sar tshol: kun shes kun gsalayangs pa 'di: ye shes yin no ma nor shig: de nasakhrusakyi cho ga la da mo la khrusasngon du bto de na sdig sgrib bkru ba ni sno skyeb med pa'i ye shesalas: rgyal kun sku yis byin rlabasachus: tshe 'das lus la khrus bkyis pas las nyon bag chags dag gyur cig rtsa sngagasadang sarba pā paṃ shirnye ku ru ye swā snya sno ma 'gags bdechen ye shes las: rgyalakun gsung gi byin rlabs chus tshe 'das ngag la khyas bgyis pas: las nyon bag chags dag gyur cig: rtsa jagasadang sarba pa paṃ shiṭwāṃ ku ru ye swā 1 phroṃ zhakhrul med rang

gsal ye shes las rgyal kun thugs kyi byin rlabs chus tshe 'das sems la khrus bgyis pas: las nyon bag chags dag gyur cig rtsa jagasad sarba pa rpā shirnye ku ruye swā snya gyi chosakyisadabyingasakyi ye shes las rang byung lhun grub byin rlabs chus: tshe 'das 'di la khrusabagyis pas: gti mug las nyon dag gyur cig: rtsa jagasadapasarba pa shaṃ shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: sgo me long lta bu'i ye shes las: bde chen gsal dag byin rlabs chus tshe 'das 'di la khrus bgyis pas: zhe sdang las nyon dag gyur cig rtsa jagasadang sarba pa shrī shidzña ku ru ye swā snya smi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las dag mnyam rol pa'i byin rlabs chus: tshe 'das 'di la khrus bgyis pas: nga rgyal lasanyon dag gyur cig: rtsa jagasadang sarba pā paṃ shirnye ku ru ye swā snya sno sosor rtog pa'i ye shes las kun snang ma 'gag byin rlabs chus: tshe 'das 'di la khrus bgyis pas 'dod chags las nyon dag gyur cig: rtsa jagasadang sarba pā paṃ shirnye ku ru swā 1 gyi bya ba grub pasaye shes las: rang grol bde stong byin rlabs chus: tshe 'das 'di la

sa khrus bgyis pas: phrag dog lasanyon dag gyur cig: rtsa sngagasadang sarba pā paṃ shirnyi ku ru ye swā snya sno bdag med rtogasapasaye shes las: phar phyin drug rdzogs byin rlabasachus: tshe 'das 'di la khrusabagyis pas: gzung 'dzin las nyon dag gyur cig: rtsa sngagasadang sarba pā paṃ shidhe ku ru ye swā snya de na dug sbyongasan sno ma rig las bskyed phyi nang gis: 'byung ba las byung sdig sgrib dug ye shes 'bar ba'i rab bcom nas: dug tshogs mkha' ltar stong gyur cig: rtsa sngagasamathar em ram̐ḥbaṃḥleḥ'abyung ba bzhi las byung ba'i dug dang grib thams cad shidzña ku ru ye swā 1de na shi brjod ni byang chub snying por gshegs pa na: sa rnams drug po rab g.yos nas bdud tshogs mi bde gyur pa des: khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na: 'phags pa'i bden pa rab gsungs zhing: thub dbang snyan pa'i sga chen des: khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur: mu stegs gang zhig yid 'phrog byed: thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing: tshogasakun dbang du bskyar mdzad

pa'i: khyed la bde legs mdzad gyur cig: de na slob ma bsangasasbyangasani phyi bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros tshe 'das sgo gsum la phog pa'i: rnam smin las nyon bag chags dag snang stong ye shesalha sku ni: rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par gyur oṃ badzra sa ma ya wa ra hi dza /ba ho de nasabumodabang bskur bani (41: bum pa ye shesagazhal yas su rang byung lha yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas lus kyis sgrib pa kun dag shog: rtsasngagasamathar ka ya a nyi ṣiñtsa sa: de na gsang dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ hrī: lhun grub bde chen ka pa lar: gsang ba jags kyis byin rlabasardzogs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ba'i: ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag shog: rtsa sngagasamathar wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā de na rdo rje rga dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ trī: mtshan ma rdzasakyi rdo rje ni: rgyal kun thugs kyisabyin rlabasardzogs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskar ba'i: yid smib dag cing thugs thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsitā a bri 〉〉 hūṃ: mtha' rten bkra shas me tog 'thor de nas 'dod yon bsngo ba ni o su byu sasbyangs la mngun ngu

sa 4 sgrolas rin chen snod: yangs shing rgya che gyur pa'i nang: sa: las phyi nang gsang ba yis: 'dod yon mi zad mdzod du spel ma badzra spa ra ṇa sa: kye ma: jon smon las kyis 'brel ba ya tshe las 'das pa khyod nyid la: nye du 'brel ba thams cad kyis brtse gdung shugs kyis bza' btung bshams: dkon mchog bden pa ra mdar sbran: sems bskyed ya mtshan tshangs bar byas: nged cag lha sngags phyag rgya dang: ting nge 'dzin gyis nus mthu yis: bza' btung ri rab rgya mtshor spel: 'dod yon lnga dang ldan par bsgyur ye shes rol pa'i dam rdzas 'di: tshe 'das khyod la bajo'o sbyin dga' mgu yi rang tshim gyur nas: chags chen 'dzin pa kun chod cig: snang ba zhing khams rnam dag ni: yid la gyis shig rigs kyisabu: de nasamar me sbyin pa ni sno ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me 'dis: ma rig mun pa dbyings su bcom tshe 'das khyod la bdag gis sbyan: ma shes 'khrul dang ma rig rmongs thar bde dag pa'i lam stor mang: sgron me 'di yis gsal gyur cig sku gsum ye shes thob par shog: ma badzra

a lo kai /: de nasa'apho ba'i rim pa la ñtsa khyod lusardo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dbus dbu ma mtshan nyid ldan: chos kyisa'akhor lor pad zla'i steng: rnam shesa'od kyisathig le ni: dkar dmar mthing ser ljang ba'i mdog 'phar 'dar g.yo ba bya rgong tsam: mda' ltar steng gi nam mkhar spar: rdo rje phag mo'i thugs klong brgyud: kun tu bzang mo'i bha gar sangs: aḥphaṭaḥ aḥphaṭaḥ aḥphaṭa: sku gsum klong du gnas par bya: de nasabyang bu bsreg pa ni stsa cesaganyid rtsal la shar ba yis ye shesarnam lnga'i me byung te tshe 'das phung khams skye mched kun: lhag ma med par dzwa la ram: aX driḥ〈chatriḥpremaduḥdzwa la ram̐ sarba pa pata shinta ku ru ye swā hwa cesabasregasachu bkruthajagasokyabawa bkrashi bsngo ba smon lam gdab de yis 'gro ba' don nga 'grub sam yu rgya rgya rgya shan tu zab pa 'i chosakya skor snyang gi khrag la pha nga ba'i phyar klu ga na btsan dang ma dīr gnyer gter thu drag mo gsum labacol thub par gyi shig sam yu skalamed rnamasal a tham rgya las can bu la spel bar mdzod gu hye lha chosapa 'di lang chosakya bdag po padma chos 'phel gyis bskul ro rasngagasaming nusaldan rdo rjes gter dpe gnyis pa las bsgyur ba dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba masgo lam/
zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud zab mo bzhugs so:

sa ske na mo tswa na ḍakki ni ye ja3 yi nasamanyam nyid bde ba che ma skyes lhun rdzogs ye shesaklong kun tu bzang po gnyug ma'i lha mi 'bral chosakya 'khor lor mchod sam ya e ma la ldan bud med ye she mtshorgyal dang grub brte rig 'dzan khye'u chung lo tsā ba dad brtson mos ldan dharmā rtsegha rnams rtse gcig ye sa med gus pa' nyon la zungs lam gyi dam pa bdud gcod zab mo'i sgo tshogasasmon las 'dzomasaskal bzang skyesabu rnams zhugs pa ra'adod pa'i sngon 'gro chos bcu'i sgos lus sems zhi zha dul bar gyur nas slar sem nyid dngasagasal rnam rtog rnyogs ma can dran pa brten nas semasanyid grim gyis bsgrims g.yo ba 'phro rgod yul du thor gyas shar ngang du 'dres tsam ma 'gagasami gnod pa rtse gcig a 'thas 'jur ba'am dran pa'o dran 'dzan ngo bo rang shugasasto pa'i gshis nyams myong stobasakyisasprosamed ngang du brdal rang mdangs tsam gyisagazhan du mi bor ba sprosabralaklong du stong pa'i bzungs dran no de ltar yang yang goms pa'i byed las kyas dwa sa ma stong pa'i ngang der bab kyis gnas snang dang stong pa so sor bcad du med mnyam par gan pa'i rang bab chen po la ro gcig yeng med byungargyal dran pa'o 'bad rtsol rtsub reg yul las 'das pa yis sto pa'i ngang klong g.yo ba med pa ra gnas 'di 'o zhe pa'i bsgoms du yang med la 'di 'khrul sems pa'i yang du med pa ni sgom med tsam la blo 'ad dran par brjod

sa /ju sa lam go rim bsam gyis mi khyab kyang mdor na sems nyad rnal dbab zhi la bslabs donas lam du zhugasapa'i rim pa ni gang shar thad gar gcod pa'i lta ba la dmags gtad phyogs gcig bral ba'i dbu mdang gnasalugs blo lasa'adas pa'i phyag rgya che chosakun gcig tu grol ba' rdzogs chen rnams don gyisadagong pa gcig tu bab pa yin de la lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad gsum las dang po tshasakun gzha ni ma rig pa ngar 'dzina'akhrul ba'i rba rlabs g.yo ba las phung khams tshogs drug 'dod yon kun tu btags klong chen dbyi gsu spros pa'i bkang ba yang sor rtog shes rab rdo rje rnon po yis yong su dpyad na nga bdag 'dod yon chos btagagatsam mabartag bden grub gzhal na stong dngos por rtag pa'i mtshan nyid kun nas zad rang gnasango bo rdo rje lta bu'o snangatsamacha yang rten cing 'brel 'byung las sna yang ma grub stong pa sangs nge ba te yul sangs rgyasasku dang ye shes kya gzhan du ma mchisarag pa chosaskur rdzogs dngosamatshan grub na gzung 'dzan 'chang ma grol dogs yul khams gsum 'khor ba'i yul snang yang gzhan du ma grub sems rtog nyams kyis cha daro sa po ra gnasatshe mkhan po de gang yin dpe ni dri za' grong khyer ji ltar ro ribar bya ba'i phan byed lha da ni gnod par 'dzin pa'i 'dre bgegs thams cad kyang byung gnasa'agro ba'i bdag po kun dag bral 'khrul ba'i snang ba dathu da na rdzun phug rdib desan shes pa dang

po yul du mched 'dzan rtog nyer len phyi ma'i a 'thas so sna tsam nyad nas stong ba' rang bzhin no dpe don rtagasagasum 'brel ba'i chos dbyangasamakha' thamasacad 'ub du chud pa 'a klong chen po ma skyes mi 'gags yod medaphyogs lhung bral 'gro 'o don gcig tha dad sprosalas 'das rnam par thar ba'i mtshan nyid sgom gsum ldan skyon gyis ma gos bar med phyal bar gnas stong phyog ka nas dag pa'i tshul bstan no gdod ma'i gzhi dbyingasachosasku sprosabral zhig rdzogasas rgyas pa sku lnga bdag nyid can khyab bdag pe shesalnga ma ro 4 bar gnas sna grags rag gsum da bying sakyi rgyan du sha sgyu 'gru tha rwa ba sku gsu thugasakyi gad sa gcor 'ad sachos da nga theg pa rgya mtsho rdzogs snang phyogs lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shesaso de ltar bde gsheg snya po' bzhugs tshul ni ci bzhin maro na du gyur pa 'a shes rab kyas lta ba jo bral rjen la byung nas slar gnyisapa nyam su len pa' dusaskabasasu lus ngag yid kyi bya ba dgu sprug btang 'das pa mi dmigasam 'ong sngon bsu spangs da lta'i shes pa rtse mo byung rgyal 'di mthar 'ded bca' bcos sngo yis ma bslad par ngang bzhag rang pan gyi li dga' rer klod kun shes kun gsal kun rig dam pa po 'dzan med 'od gsal sprosapa'i gzeb las grol bum na nam mkha' dbyangasadang 'dresapa ltar chosanyid ye shesatha dad byar du med snang sem rtog pa'i rgong sbubasal grol bas

ra ju gzhan rkyen gang gi mi tshug har sangasange yid 'dod mchog 'dzin mi che lhod por gnas gang shar chos la mi zhen gnad gcig thebs ma gzul mi 'byul 'byul ba'i yul la 'das ma dmag mi dmagasadamigasapa'i yul las 'das ma zhen mi zhen zhen pa'i yul las 'das ma dgags mi dgagasadagagasapa'i yul las 'das ma gtad mi gtad gtad pa'i yul lasa'adas ma semasami sems bsam pa'i yul las 'das ma rtsol mi rtsolartsol ba'i yul la 'das ma bsgrub mi bsgrub bsgrub pa'i yul la 'das ma bsgomasami bsgomasabasgoms pa' yul las 'das gser gleng lta bu dbye bsal byar du med chu brgya zam 'og chud pa 'i gdamasapa 'di'i dma' ba'itheg lam rtsolasgrub zil gyisaganon 'di ni zeg mchog rgyal po'i rang lam yin shesarab rig can dam pa'i spyod yul las rmongs pa'i 'ol tshod tsam gyi phyogasami nye mnyam bzhag bsgomasapa rang grol blo 'dagaso rje thob rkyenangan gnad thog grol ba'i phyir yul 'dzan re dwogs mtshangasal rgol ba'i thabs ngesamed gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim par bya snang ba dngo po'i bslus na thogasabacasabadud mi snang 'drer 'dzin gol na thogs med bdud dug lnga a'athas dbang gyur lha bu'i bdud rnam rtog 'phro 'ded rgya 'byams snyems byed bdud mdor na gzung dang 'dzin pa 'i bcing ba kun bdud du ngesapa'i de la thog bajis bya snang ba rnam rtog 'dres pa slong tshad do 'drethate zhen chagasabyung

na dbang du song shar tsam mul med gyur na chod pa'o yul can 'dzin pa drung 'byan nang ga gcod kun btagagayul 'dzan gzhig pa phyi yi gcod nyag gcig rtsad nasachod pa gsang ba'i gcod zhe sdang gsagasapa pho gdon rgyal po dang 'dod chagasagayo ba mo gdon dam sri'i rigs gta mug 'thibasapa klu gdon gtum po'o nga rgyal shugasache sa bdag bdud pho dang phrag dog 'tshubasapa bgegasarigasa'abyung po yin 'di dag gzhan na mi tshol nang du gcod bdag med shes rab ma pa ba gcod zab mo shes rab tha rol phyin ma'i gnad gcag yin lnga brgya dus kya mtha' la nye ba'i skabs yum don 'di yis bstan pa smad nas dar 'drer 'dzan a 'thas gol ba'i 'ching ma grol dngosazhen yul rlom shan pa dmar lasamakhan cor chung gsang sngagasaspyod pa khrom du khyer par 'dzin a 'thas rmi lam gzhan lasmra bdud bzhi'i dbang du shor ba lkog du gyur 'dre rgod gzhan du yod cesalung bstan 'chad rnam shesabar do khyi bzhin nyul ba la rdzun po che yisaphan thog byung bar skad 'di na gcod kyis bstan pa log par bzungs bar chad dbang du song ba'i bag zon mdzod skal bzang snyel bu log par me 'khyil phyir padma bdag gisasnying gdam bkod pa yin des na lta ba' ltang de ma shor ba snang srid sgyu ma rmi lam ci bzhin spyod nyams len sgom pa'i ngang gdengs ma shor ba rig pa kun gsal phar phyin yum dang 'grogs bya ba spyod lam rnam bzhi yang dag par bag med mi

sa niḥ 'chor dran shes rgyud bsdam nas sto da snyi rje rgya yas theb pa ra 'bad dus kun yul gyi bslang da ma bslang kyang rnam rtog drag la shugs che skye ba'i skabs thol byu phaṭa rgyag 'dzan med dbyings su gtor phya slo lha 'dre'i g.yo bar rang sar gcod nang slo lus kyis nad gdon dbyings su gcod gas slo sems kyis 'gyur rtogs chos skur gcod de na spyod pa ye shesachen pa'o gcod par bya ba dang nga yi ba gcod byed snang sto shesarab pha ṭa kyisabashag gcod yul bdud bzhi'i sna ba ra sar bsgral gcod don sto pa nyid sku maro na gyur na gcod kyi rnal 'byor bde ba' dab phyug legs sa ma ya snyeng dzochen po'i gdul bya skyong sa ba na las ngan rgyu yi lusasems nad kyisamanar sgyu ma 'i sgo yis bsal bar bya ba la lus ro kha lag bkrus pa 'i bag zan gyis bem po dbang tsha sa gan rkyal bkod pa da sha khrag brgyan pa 'i gtor ma bdun da niḥ chang bu bdun re 'byu sna tshogasabyas la ra nyid rdo rje phag ma'i rgyal gyas phaṭa: rang dang bsrungs bya'i rig pa ni dbyer med stong gi nam mkhar spar: slar yang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par bzhengs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: na mo: mtshog gsum ska gsum rtsa ba gsum: bden gnyis basma ba med pa'i mthas: nad pa'i lus ngag yid gadza ma la gnod 'che'i gdon

bgegs 'dir khug cing: tri a garsha ya dza dza: brgya rtsa yo na ci nusabaskyal nad dang nad 'dre bcas pa rnams: bam gzugs bem po ro gcig gyur: tshugyibaṃḥtogadabyer med bstims 'dod yon rbud rlangs 'khrugs par bsam: ma yisahūṃ ha ho hrī: de nas gri gug phyar ba yis mgo dang yan lag rnamalopa lnga phyi sha da ni na khrol bdun byasal mgron 'bod bya ba na phaṭa phaṭa: phaṭa: dbus phyogs chos dbyings pho brang nas: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rnam par snang: las byed 'bum sdes sprul 'khor 'gyed gti mug lha 'dres tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ro mnyam don gyis dpa' bo ngas: gces 'dzin tshogs su 'bul legs na: ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes par dgongs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: las dang rkyen gyisabasdus pa yis mi 'dod nyer 'che'i sdug bsngal dang: mgo bo lus gdon ro gcig par: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gti mug lasabyung nad gdon bgegs sha khrag gtor ma'i rnam pa dza 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror 'bul: chos dbyings ye shes

sa dngos grub stsol phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa lasanyen bag chagasabasres pa yis: chang bu sha dum dang bcas pa snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin: dga' mgu yi rang tshim gyur cig phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa nad gdon lha 'dre'i gnas su bsdu: lha 'dre 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror 'dres: mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i klong du yal: gtso mo chos kyis dbyings su phaṭa: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: shar phyogasagatum drag dur khrod nas:rdo rje mkha' 'gro rab zhi ma: las byed sprul pa 'bum sde 'gyed: zhe sdang lha 'dres tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang byung don gyis rnal 'byor ngas: gces 'dzin phung po tshogs su bshams: ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes par dgongs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis bsdus pa'i: mi 'dod nyer 'che'i sdug bsngal dang: lag g.yasalus gdon ro gcig par: rdo rje mkha' 'grosazhal du bstabs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: zhe sdang las byung nad gdon bgegs sha khrag gtor ma'i rnam pa phu 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror 'bul: me long ye shes dngos

grub stsol: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: las ton bag chags bsres pa yis: chang bu sha dum dang bcas par: snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin: dga' mgu yi rang tshim gyur cig:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: nad gdon bar chad lha 'drer bsdu: lha 'dre 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bsres: mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i klong du yal: gtso mo me long dbyings su phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lto phyogs gad rgyang dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro 'od 'bar ma las byed sprul pa 'bum sde 'byed: nga rgyal lha 'dre'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol rang rig don gyi dpa' bo ngas: gces 'dzin tshogasasu 'bul legasan: ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyesapar dgongs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sngon lasa'aphral rkyen byis bsdus pa'i mi 'dod nyer 'che'i sdug bsngal dang: lag g.yon lus gdon ro gcig par: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nga rgyal las byung nad gdon bgegs: sha khrag gtor ma'i rnam pa rtsa 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror 'bul: mnyam nyid ye shes dngos grub stsol phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:

sa las nyon bag chags bsres pa yis: chang bu sha dum dang bcas pa: snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin: dga' mgu yi rang tshom gyur cig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nad gdon bar chad lha 'drer bsdu lha 'dre 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bsre: mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i klong du yal: gtso mo mnyam nyid dbyings su phaṭa: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nub phyogs pad 'khyil dur khrod nas padma mkha' 'gro chags bral ma: las byed sprul pa 'bum sde 'gyed: 'dod chags la 'dre'i tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang gsal don gyi rnal 'byer ngas gces 'dzin phung po tshogs su bshams: ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes par dgongs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sngon lasa'aphral rkyen gyis bsdus pa'i: mi 'dod nyer 'che'i sdug bsngal dang: rkang g.yon lus gdon ro gcig par padma mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: 'dod chags las byung nad gdon bgegs sha khrag gtor ma'i rnam pa rtsa 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror 'bul sor rtogs ye shes dngos grub stsol: phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa:

lasanyen bag chagasabasres pa yis chang bu sha dum dang bcas pa: snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin dga' mgu yi rang tshil gyur cig phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa: nad gdon bar chad lha 'drer bsdu: lha 'dre 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro bsre: mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i klong du yal: gtso mo sor rtogs dbyings su phaṭa: phaṭaphaṭa phaṭa: byang phyogasarab g.yosadur khrod nas las kyi mkha' 'gro rab gtum ma las byed sprul pa 'bum sde 'byed: phrag dog lha 'dre'i tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol klong grol don gyis rnal 'byor ngas: gces 'dzin phung po tshogs su bshams ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes par dgongs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa sngon lasa'aphral rkyen gyis bsdusapa'i: mi 'dod nyer 'che'i sdug bsngal dang: rkang g.yas lus gdon ro gcig par las kyi mkha' 'gro'i zhal bu bstab: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: phrag dog las byung nad gdon bgegs sha khrag gtor ma'i rnam pa dza 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror 'bul bya grub ye shes dngos grub stsol: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lasanyon bag chagasabasresapa

sa yis: chang bu sha dum da bcas pa: snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin: dga' mgu yi rang tshim gyur cig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nad gdon bar chad lha 'drer bsdu lha 'dre 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bsre mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i klong du yal: gtso mo bya grub dbyings su phaṭa: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: steng dang 'tshamasabazhi'i dur khrod nas: phrin las lhun grub mkha' spyod ma: las byed sprul pa 'bum sde 'byed nyon mongs lha 'dre'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol skye med don gyi rnal 'byor ngas: gces 'dzin phung po tshogs su bshams: ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes par dgongs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis bsdus pa'i: mi 'dod nyer 'che'i sdug bsngal dang: phung po lus gdon ro gcig par las byed mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nyen mongs las byung nad gdon bgegs sha khrag gtor ma'i rnam pa rtsa 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror 'bul lhan grub ye shes dngos grub stsol: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa las nyon bag chagasabasres pa yis: chang bu sha

dum dang bcas pa: snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin: dga' mgu yi ring tshim gyur cig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nad gdon bar chad lha 'drer bsdu lha 'dre 'bum phrag mkha'a'agror bsre: mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i klong du yal: gtso mo chos nyid dbyings su phaṭa: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: 'og phyogasamun galtabasadur khrod nas: sa spyod mkha' 'gro gtuma'abar ma: las byed sprul pa 'bum sde 'byed: ma rig lha 'dre'i tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: blo 'das don gyis rnal 'byor ngas gces 'dzin phung po tshogs su bshams ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes par dgongs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis bsdus pa'i mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i sdugabasngal pa'i: nang rol lus gdon ro gcig par: sa spyod mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ma rig lusabyung nad gdon bgegs sha khrag gtor ma'i rnamapa phu 'bum phrag ya sa pa'i mkha' 'gror 'bul: zang thal ye shes dngos grub stsol: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lasanyon bag chagasabasres pa yis: chang bu sha dum dang bcas

pas par:snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin dga' mgu yi rang tshim gyur ci phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:nad gdon bar chad lha 'drer bsdu:lha 'dre 'bum phrag mkha'a'agror bsre:mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i klong du yal:gtso mo spros bral dbyings su phaṭa:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:bsrung bya'ibla tshe bsod nams ni:'od lnga'i thig le gsal la 'tsher rang byung hūṃ kyis rnam par gnas 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud bstims:mi 'gyur mi shig rgyas gdab po:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:snod bcud snang ba rten brten kun sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig pa bzhin:chos sku khyab brdal ngang du yal ma bcos blo 'das dgongs par bzhag:a ā āḥphaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:bsngo ba smon lam rgya yasagadab phya nangagasang ba' bar chad sel tshe dang bsod namasagos 'phe la rgyas the ma tshom so sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya:skabs su ma da mkha' 'gro rnams bska bar 'dod na 'ad ltar brjod phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:dzams dbyings mi)sten thig le nas ste med ye shes kun bzang mo:'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs:rang byung 'od lnga'i pho brang nas:'gags

med rdo rje phag mo rtsal: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskang: rtsol bral ye shes gzhal yas nas dmigasamed rang byung rnal 'byor ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs: gdangasalnga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: lhun grub rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ga ṇa cakra'i thugs dam bskangs: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa nas: tshad med rnam bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs: thogs med las kyis pho brang nas: 'gugs 'ching sdom myos mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs: rang snang bde chen gzhal yas nas: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs: tha tshig gnyan gyi da la nas: bka' srung sgog bdag chen po bzhi: dregs chen sde dpon brtan mar bcas: ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs

sa dam bskangs: gnasayul dur khrod he ru nas: byi nang gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs: grong khams 'ja' tshon pho brang nas bgegs rigs stong phrag 'byung po'i tshogs: ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs rang grol ye shes rtogs par shog: 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i zhing khams nas: khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: ga ṇa tsakra'i thugs dam bskangs: gdod ma'i btsan sa zin par shog phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: zhen 'dzin blo yis ma bslad par sems rtog phung khams snod bcud bcas: ga ṇa tsakrar dmigs nas 'bul sku gsung thugs mchog myes gyur cig bde stong ye shes dngos grub stsol: lhan skyes chos sku 'jal du gsol phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: 'bar ba'i bzhus pa'i mchod sprin dang dag mnyam lta ba'i bkod pa dang: ma chen lam gyis 'od gsal dang: stong nyid snying rje'i spod par bcas: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i klong du 'bul khyed kyis thugs dang 'gal ba bshags: ma bslad

yul snang dag pa'i bskang:a 'thas bzung ba mthol lo bshags:ma spangs nyon mongs dag pasabaskangs rang gar spyod pa mthol lo bshags ma bcosa'adzin pa dag pa'i bskangs:ma rig dbang gyur mthol lo bshags:ma spangs brtul zhugs dag pa'i bskangs:bdud tshogs g.yin gol mthol lo bshags:ma bsgyur phung po dag pa'i bskangs:gces 'dzin dam bcing mthol lo bshags:ma dmigs 'khor 'das snang ba'i bskang dngos chen bag chags mthol lo bshags:bshags bya bshags byed gnyis su med jo 'das don dam rdzogs pa ches:dag mnyams rol ba'i gnad kyi gzir 'khor 'das mnyam nyid bde ba che phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ja ma'i thugasadagongasardzogs gyur cig:ma dang mkha' 'gro phyes gyur cig 'gro don rtsol med 'byung gyur cig:brtul zhugs ye shes thob gyur cig:ma badzra satwa /:de ltar brjod pa'imakha' 'gro mnyas tshogs gnyis ོgas la sgrab pa dag dbang da daro sagrub ma lusathob the tshom med do sa ma pā gu rgya a ma rgyalaba' dbang po pa dma ngas ma 'ong la ldan don ched du gamasapa snying thig zab pa'i skor

sa niju rin chen 'phrul gyis yi ger bkod tsha ba'i ro la gter du sbas nga sprul bu yis rnyed par shog gdul bya 'bum phrag 'dren par 'gyur bka' 'di ma mo gsum gyis bsrungs thub par gyis shig sam wā lasaldan bu la spel ba da dam nyamasasrog gi dab po bsnub dge mtshan phyogs bcur rgyas pa ra mdzod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gas rgya bdo thim lha ces 'di ya chosakyisabadag po padmachos 'aze la gyis dar da rin chen shog gu bcas yang yang bskul ba'i ro raḥ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul shog las dag ra pha ba pa dge'o dge'o dge'o legs so sarba maṅga lam

pa sa rdo dzeephag lo lasagartsa bsrengs na bsnyen pa kha gasgobyed skabs rtsasngag mthar nad gdon 'jigs pa bcu drug shirnyi ku ru ye swā snyatshe bsod 'byor ba drug ldan puṣṭi ku ru ye swā 1khams gsum srid pa'i zas nor wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā:gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po ma ra yā phaṭa swā snyaphrin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub par gyur cig:dbyangasagasal yig brgya rten 'brel snying gsum gsum bzlas pa' lhag go gso de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa ni holha ga ga rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes:brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las:stsol ba'i dngos grub:skyobs pa'i nus mthu:'dren pa'i dpa' shugs:sgrol ba'i gru gzing ster ba'i ratna:bsgrod pa'i mthu rtsal:rtogs pa'i shes rab chen po mnga' ba'i bdag cag sgrub pa po la thugs dam mi g.yel bar mchog thun mongs gi dngos grub rba chen po stsal da gsol:de nas mchod ci bstod — ra bya 'ad yang cho ga' cha lags su mtsho thugs bzhed skong ba' phyir nusaldan rdo rje'i bris pa dge/sarba marsha lam/

sa zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las mkha' 'gro'i smin byed zab mo bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍasgri ni ye: jugardo don dam lhan skyesaye shes ni bde chen mtshog gi mdza' na slo dab dang daro sa grub kun gyisargyun mi 'bral spyi bo' gtsugasagisamachod bdag 'dra padma rgyal po sa shin tu zab pa' chosaskor las smin byed 'a cag sgo dang po' lam skalabazang skyesabu'i dpa la du bzhag sa ma yu a ma las ldan khye'u lo tsa khyod ma 'ong dusakya tha ma la dpa' bo nusalan rdo rjer bzhedas gser gya bum pa lag tu lon g.yu yi rne tso grogs su bkrol tshogs drug yul la ltad cho byed 'ad na pa lus kyi gdul bya la a ti gsang ba'i thabs mchog 'doms 'bum phrag tsatta'i yul du brten ston pa — dang gnyas su med dam chosathugs gter bco brgyad 'byed las can 'khor gyi tshom bu bkra gnasabazang bde ldan gser gyis lu dusani ka dag zang thal rtogs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i ba dan 'dzug 'gab 'dre dam sri'i snying la 'dzar de dusargyal mo tsha ro nas pha phog gdams pa zab mo 'di chad nas chosakyis bdag por spel skal med rigs 'a gsang rgya sdoms mi med ri la sgrab sa zungs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mchod rgyan mi bcad ltasgomaspyod pa'i nyams len stongs nyams stogs gong 'phel yon tan

sa rdzu gra gug gtor ma nyer spyod bkrams bdag mdun bum bzlasasngon du btang rang nyid 'jug pa'i chosatshangs rjes slob ma gral 'khod khrusabagegs bsal bsrungs 'khor bden don maṇḍal phul de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kye bye rgyal ba yongasa'adusardo rje 'chang: rigs kun bdag nyid ja ma dgongs: zab lam ye shes phag mo yis: dbang mchog yongs rdzogs gnang bar zhu ga gsum zhusal lan sbyin ni kyi ho: las ldan bu mtshog khyed cag ni gsang sngags 'phrad pa skal ba bzang 'on kyang dam tshig rim pa rnams: bsrung na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob nyams par gyur na phyi mar mnar: de phyir dam tshig ldan la sbyin mi nus pa rnams phyir dengs shig: de nasagasalabagadab pa ni zu rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dngos:kun la brtse ba chen po'i dgongs: sa ma ya las mi 'da' 'o: de phyir dbang mchog gnang bar zhu: de na slob ma'i tshogasabasagasal skyab 'gro semasabaskyed yan lag sdoms dang po skyabasasu 'gro ba ni na moḥ ye sangs rgyasapa chos kyi ska bde chen lngan grab longs smod rdzogs: mtha' grol jo 'das spral pa'i sma: skabs kyis mchog cu 'dzin par bya: ༅gsum rjes

su yosabaskyed ni nyo rang byung ye shes spros mtha' bral: lhan skyes jo 'das byang chub sems: ma bcos ye bab so ma'i ngang: 'khor ba gzhir sgrol sems bskyed do: lan gsum rje su yan lag ni na mo rig pa sku gsum ye shes la: lta ba dad pa'i phyag 'tshal lo: mngon gsum snang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: 'khrul snang 'dzin pa dbu mar bshags: gong 'phel don la rjes yi rang: tshad pheb don gyis chos 'khor bskul: 'pho chen klong las mi 'da' bzhugs: dge tshogs mar gyur 'gro la bablo phyam gcig gzhi thog grol bar shog: la gsum rjesasu sdomathayo ni rdo rje slob dpon dgongasasu gsol:rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig nyu byang chub semasani mi spang ngo: phyag rgya rdo rje dril bu brten: rin chen rigs mtshog dam tshog zhu sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu brtson padma'i ja med dam tshig la: theg gsum dam pa'i chos kun bshad: las rab mchog gi dam tshig ni: sdom pa thams cad ldan par bgyi dkon mtshog gsum ni spangasami bya sor byang jags kyi dam sdoms 'dzin: nam yang mi 'da' sa ma yā: lan gsum rjesasu

sa dam sbyin ni hūṃ 'dinidus gsum sangs rgyas kyis: phrin las rmad byung bdud rtsi 'khyil: gnyis med ye shes dam chu 'di: slob ma khyod kyis lce la bzhag: 'od zhu tsitta'i sbubs su gnas dam sdom bsrung na bar chad sel: legs pa'i yon tan gong 'phel rgyas nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar lhung: tshe 'dir nad dang gnid pa'i mnar: de phyir dam la gnas par mdzod: badzra sam ya na ra gaṇa de nasametog sbyin byalote a kho 41ra purdze ji de na mig dar bkab byasal yin tsakyu bhanta wa ra ma ṇa ye hūṃ: de nasasgob ma lar bskyed ni oṃ ma hā shu hye ta dzñā na badzra swā bha wa arma ko3 nya: gzu 'dzeen gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: de'i ngang las stong nyid snying rjes ye shes chen po'i rtsal snang 'od zer 'bar ba'i slob ma'i phung khams thams cad dbyings su bsregs te ye shes kyi lha ru ldang ba ni: lha bskyed spyan 'dren 'do sa bar 'ardug ye shesaze ba pa de sko ni khye badzra gyisabartan pa ra bya'o de nasametag dor ba ni mislob ma'irig pa'i me tog 'di: jon nas 'brel ba gang yod pa'i: rigs kyi lha la dbab pa rtsa mchog

gsum bden pa'i byin gyis rlobs: badzra pukhye pra ti tsa ho: cesadoragang bab ngosabangasal dbusasu bab na dpa' bo thogs med rtsal: shar du bab na rdo rje grub pa rtsal: lho ru bab na rin chen legs grub bshad: nub tu bab na padma bde byed 'bar: byang du bab na las rab drag po rtsal zhesagadag go lhag pa'i lha de go me tog dang mnyamasadu byon na slob ma'i spya bo nasazhugasasnyang gar thim par mosal sgo〉 bde chen ye shesalhag pa'i lha mchog nyid: chos nyid dbyings nas slob ma'i snying gar byon kun bzang 'od kyi phung po'i klong du bzhugs: lhan skyes gnyug ma'i rang zhal dngos grub sprol: pukhye pra ti e me sarba sirnyi badzra: de nasamig dar dbye ba ni ho chosanyid sang lasarnam 'phrul ba'i: shes rab gser gyi thur ma 'dis: slob ma'i ma rig mun pa bsal rang byung lha zhal mablal bar shog: ma dzñā na tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nasamathong ba bam pa ni hūṃ nyi lasaldan jon nasa'abrel ba yi:skal bzang stes bu khyed cag rnams: ltos shig mdun gyis dal la ltos: mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor 'di: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang ste: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs

sa rje'i bdag ye shesachen po gsang ba'i lha rdo rje phag mor lhun gyis grub: 'di ma rtog pa'i yi dam lha log na med do shes par mdzod: cha āḥ/ swā snya de na bum pa zog byasal hūṃ nyi skye med dbyingasakyi bum pa phu bde chen ye shes dwangs bcud 'khrul skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: lusadang rtsa yi sgrib pa dag: sku yi dbang dang dngos grub thob: bskyed rim bsgom pa'i snod rung gyur rnam smin rig 'dzin dbang rgyas theb: snang stong ye shes zhal mjal nas sprul pa sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngagasamathar kā ya a snyi ༷༷ sa: de nasabhasto gto na su hūṃ trī: lhun grub rang byung kwa pa lar gsang ba bde chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag gsung gis dbang dang dngos grub thob: rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i snod rung gyur tshe dbang rig 'dzin sa la theb bde stong ye shes zhal masngal nas:longs song zosasasa'i ngabang zob sos: rtsasngagasamathar wab a bri 'i a de nas shes rab ḍakri g.yo rte ci: badzeechen sror ba'i mdza' ra mo: sachong tshal lang tsho'i ngapal mis

phongasaspyod rdzogs sku'i dbang thob shog: rtsasngagasamathar wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de na shesorab ḍakki gto hūṃ hrī bde chen sbyor ba'i mdza' na mo: gzhen tshul lang tsho'i dpal gyijamabyud: bcu drug mthar phyin wa ra hi skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: rdo rje padmo bsre ba las: a ha 'bar dang zhu ba yi yid dang thig le'i sgrib pa dag: thugasakyija) bang dang dngos grub thob: khams gsum rol pa'i snod rung gyur: dga' ba bcu drug ye shesa'abar stong nyid bcu drug 'od gsal mjal: thig le bcu drug dbyings nda) ga 'dzin 'dren dgram bsdus lusal sbyor: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin sa bon theb dga' stong ye shesazhal mjal nas chos kyi sku yi dbang thob shog rtsasngagasamathar rapa ya ho sa ma ya sto: a ni ra go nyi a nu ra ga ya mye: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho sto dhi tsitta spa ra ṇa phaṭa: waṃha ra na ྅: mu tra dzñā na satta a bhi ṣiñtsa nyu: de na༅ngasasalashelardogam hūṃ trīsngong nyid spos dang bral ba'i ga sa: lhan grab gsal ba'i 'ja' shel 'di: skol lngan bu la gtad pa yis: las nyon smib gnyis bag chags dag: ka dag tshig dbang

sa dngos grub thob: khreg chod bsgom pa'i snod rung gyur snang sems rang sar klod pa las: kun gsal rig pa'i ye shes rgyas: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma thad gar chod: shes rab pha rol phyin la mjal: lhun grub rig 'dzin dbang rgyas theb rig stong ye shes rjen par mthong ngo bo nyid sku'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nasagri gug sto sgron gto hūṃ hrī: ka dag zang thal chos kyi dbyings lhun grub ye shes chen po'i gdengs: thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis dkyil 'khor rdzogs: gzung 'dzin sgrol pa'i gri gug 'di skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: snang gsum shes sgrib bag chags bcoms: rig pa rtsal dbang dngos grub thob thod rgal bsgom pa'i snod du rung: a āḥ gzung 'dzin gyis snang ba gdod nas ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid dbyings 'ong phaṭa: gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i khyab bdal chen po'i ngang du kod: kun shes kun gsal gyi ye shes smra brjod las 'das pa 'di kho na'o: tshos kyi sma yi ngang nas rgyang zhags zlam su drangs rte dbyings zig gi

ra ba la gtad med du klod dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rgyas pa 'di sku gsum gyi rgyal ba yin pa'i 'di kho na'o: gtad pa med do: 'dzin mkhan mi gnas so: ye nas stong pa nyid do: rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o: rnam par dag pa'o: gdod nas grol ba'o: a a a phaṭa: skye 'chi'i 'dzin pa kun bcoms nas: mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor srog la dbang: rlung sems dbu mar dzad pa las: bsam mi khyab pa'i 'od gsal dang: dga' bral ye shes mngon gyur nas: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sa thob shog:tshojags mthar bidu dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nasaga' ma gto byasal trī nyi bde chen yangasapa'i gzheng pa sa lhun grub rdzogs pa'i gtor ma la: lha dang dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: nyams snang na bun 'thor ba dang: ye shes yon tan ngang rgyas nas: gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sa zin: sprul ba'i g.yin don byed pa dang: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i srog thob 31ga: rtsa sngags mthar marbal bu mingata a bhi shing oṃ yi hūṃ: mtha' rten khas jangs maṇḍal phul bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam gdab tshogs da dga' ston

'a chad 'ongs de phyir shin tu gsang rgya sdoms sam yu om rgyal ba'idabang po pa dma ngas ma 'ongasalas ldan don ched du smin byed dbang gi ldan gcig da 'phrad pa ra shog ma mo rnams gsum bya ra mdzod sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi cesakya chos kyisabadag po pa dma chos 'phel 6)gas 'phe05

rdza snyan brgyud reg po che'imadzod las bka'ayojab bcud gnyer skyong btsan rgod chen po'i gsol sgrub dgra bgegs tshar gcod bzhugs so:na modzñā je rtekki ni ya:4744mimi lar gsa' rṣa 'dzan brtan po yas dga' ston spal la 'ad skad do kya rang mdun brag dmar rngams brjid 'bar mkha' 'od khu sbrang sprina'abyugs klong:snyan brgyud bstan pa'i 'gal zla rnams:pho mo kha sbubs gan skyal steng:tsaḥlas zangs ri btsan mched ni:dmar nag me yi phung po can spyan mig skarachen ltar du 'byugs:khro 'dzum sgegs pa'i rnam gyur can:zangs rmog dar 'phru rgod ldems mjes bse khrab lcags kyi 'khor gsum bkra:dbang gi ber klubs btsamerta bcibs:phyag g.yas mdung ring gnam la gzengs nyams pa'i don snyi tshal bar byed:g.yon pa bcan zhags lcags 'khril bsdam:dgra snying shan 'byed mtshon gyimachog sa bong phed 'grung sabs kyis rol:me rwang thog ser ba mag ladzabs:mi dmar ston 'gos khrigs khrig bsgar:bya dmar gad wing ya la la:khyi dmar rjerba

'brang kengs se keng skad cig yud la srid gsum bskor: zab don bdud gcod bstan la gdung: bya btang sgrub por 'bral med 'grogs: 'tsho ba sbyor zhing mthun rkyen spel: 'gal zla tshar gcod phrin las gter btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas: tha tshig bsgrags so da tshur byon sam ya dza: dza: rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mo skye med dgongs pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i ma cig lab sgron bka' dam bzhin: zangs ri btsan mchod da tshur byon: dam tshig rnam dag mas ngor bzhugs: phren las kun sgrub khyod phyag 'tshal: thugs mthun ja chang skyems bzang po sha khrag gtor ma go khrab mtshon: ga ṇa tsakra dar zab gos: bya gcan ri dwags chu gnas tshogs: 'bru sman dkor nor mtha' yas pa thugs mthun mchod sprin rab 'byams kun zab don bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor dabhe bcas: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskangs: dgyes pa'i zhal mdang 'dzum nyams ston: legs nyes 'byung 'gyur smra bar mdzod lta log sgo btags rtog ge yis: grub pa'i mtha' kun zil

badzra gnon mdzod: mtha' grol lta ba'i rang zhal ston: bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma thad gar chod: 'od gsal sgom pa'i nu zho stsol: nyams rtogs phyogs mtha' yasapar bskyed: gol rtogs shan 'byed spyod pa skyongs: blos byas zag pa kun zad mdzod: rig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje yis: bshul lam 'od skur skyel ma mdzod: bya btangadaben khrod 'grims pa la: 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag mdzod: 'og min mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gral: lus sems phyes tshe sun ma mdzod: de bar rnam bzhi'i phrin lasakun: gang bcol byed pa'i grogs mdzod cig tsamasarba sa ma ya pañtsa rakta bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: kyi slog dmar 'byur 'dre'i gzi mdangs ngoms: rdzu 'phrul thogalas dbal ngar tsha: skye med sgom pa'i grogs gcig pu: zangs ri btsan rgod mched la bstod: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang gang bcol las mdzod sa ma yā cesabastod cing phrin lasalol bar bya'o gsol bsdusani kyi zangasaribatsan rgod mched gnyis po rgol yum ma cig bka' dam bzhin: dad lngan mosangor thogasamed byon ja chang

gtor skyems 'bul gyis bzhes:skye med sgom pa'i grogs byed par:brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin mdzod: grang bsogasasnying nye phrin la myur sgrub 'bras ga med mngon mtho ra sam yu rme ma snyan brgyud mkha' 'gram gsang mdzod 'di tshogasasmon lasakyisa'aphro 'dzom la gceganor bsgo skal tshul du stsal sgrub rgyud bstan pa' gsogasu shar sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya ba thim snyi zhesanga'adi'ang chos bdag bsod namasabazang pos bskul ro ra/kho bos ldan rdo nga rdul gnas rin po che' byang phrin las ldongs kyi mdun ngos gsang sngags bshad sgrub gling nas spel ba dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo lam/

(2 snyan brgyud las: btsan rgod chen po'i 'khrugs bskang 'khu ldog tshar gcod bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍākki ni ya 3 (byed/ ci 'byor mar rdzas yo byad bsags sngags da phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis rnga rol sgra bcas 'di skad do dza bhyo skye med dbyings su dgongs pa mnyam brdal zhing rkyen snang zil gnon bdud bzhi lam slong ba'i rnal 'byor grogs mchog zangs btsan 'bar ba rtsal: snying nas 'bod do ma g.yel da tshur byon: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol dbu 'phang bstod: sku gsung thugs 'gal nongs pa bzod par gsol: 'khu ldog khro tshul rkyen snang mi ston par: ma bu lta bus brtse gdung byed pa dang: rnam mang phrin las rab 'byams thogs med sgrubs bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma yu de ltar grang sa ldan phul ba yas 'khru ldog zhi zha byams rtse'i skyongs sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya zhes snya nor༄khyebha dra' bskul ba don da ldan phyi ra nus ldan pas smrasarte yi ge'i ras byed me tra' bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam/

'o/ snyan brgyud las btsan rgod chen po la brten pas za ngu bstan dgra'i dpung 'joms bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍākki ni ya:—11sgo spo sha khrag dmar gtor bshams pa la dgra bo 'gugs bstem nan du bya sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor dmags lhar gsal ti 'dzan brtan po yis 18 dzaḥ zangs ri btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal: gnad nas bskul lo mngon spyod las la bzhengs: dgra sha khrag skyems dgyes ston 'di bzhes la: do bsdo phod btsug byed pa'i dgra bo yis: mi byugs dkor dang bcas la za ngu mdzod: mtha' rtsa skye rgyud ming gi lag mar bsgyur: nye bar 'tshe ba'i bgegs tshogs drung nas phyung: rgol ngan rtsad nas gcod pa'i za ngu mdzod: srung mdud gos dum dgra lag la song yang: tshe sgog gcod byed ha la nag por bsgyur yid brnag dgra sde me stag chu 'phrad bzhin: thal ba rdul du brlag pa'i phrin 05sa macasad: de ltar grangs ldan gtong gyur na dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jigs sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya ces pa 'di'ang snyi nor pusabha tra'i bskul ngor nus ldan pas smras te yi ge' ris byed me tras bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/

sarba ma lam/ rgya rgya rgya me ma mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i snyan rgyud 'di skal ba can gyi dpal du shog gu bye brda thim snyi zhesachosabadag bsod nams bzang po bskul ro ra/ kho bo nu ldan pa rdul gnasarin po che'i byang phranalas rdzong mdun nas/ snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dag par phab pa dge sarba masgo lam/

—13 sman gzha mapo lnga'i gsol bsdusan mja rdzas rnams wā gsum kyis spel te kye: rang mdun gangs ri'i skyed tshal dbus: rin chen sna lnga'i gzhal med khang 'dod dgu'i sprin char 'khrigs klong nas: sman btsun mched lnga dgyes brtse'i dgongs: rin chen brdar bas ja chang skyems: dkar bshos gang ltar brjid chags pa: dam bskang tshogs kyi dga' ston 'bul: bzhes la rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: lta sgom spyod pa'i rang ngo sprod: gol sa mtha' dag bsal ba dang: 'ja' lus 'od skur skyel ma mdzod:gnyer bcol ma g.yel sa ma ya: grangs bsogs snying nye phran las myur the tshom med do sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya lung zin dam pa me tre da 5〉ba tra dgyes slad gu kho bo nusaldan 'dus la pas snyan brgyud brda lasabakrol ba'o sarba masgo lam/

(1 sngagasamaja phul rje bstod pa ni dmi:༄7 ༄da debyangs sum shes lnga 'og min gnas su mkha' 'gro lnga:sprul sku'i zhing 'dir sman btsun lnga 'byung khams mnyam / nyid la bstod:dug lnga phung lnga 'byung ba lnga phyi nang zag pa kun zad te nang dbyings gting gsal bum sku'i sbub gdod ma'i yum chen mngon gyur shog:zhesalungazen dam snying nor mi)'a bskulo ngarakho bo nus ldano ral bi rjes smras pa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma lam/

52tsho zab lam rdo rje phag mo'i chos skor las:sgrun byed dbang gi lhan 'thabs blo gsal 'jug ngog zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na 51 gu ra we don dam lhan skyesaye shes nyid bde chen rdo rje pha ga mor shar lam snang za byed gtum mor rdzogs 'bar ba'i gshis la phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ong la ldan gdul bya rnams:bskyed rdzogasalam du 'jug pa la thogamar dbang gis smin pa gal de yi wan thabs zab mo bkod de ya rdo rje slob dpo na gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa 'i cho ga rnams yongasasu rdzogasapa grub nasaslar slob ma gral 'khod khrus rim ni ༷ ma chags grimed yeshes bde ba che:zag med bdud rtsi gtsang ma'i rang bzhin 'dis:skal ldan slob ma'i sgo gsum nyes sgrib rnams bkru zhing byab po bag chags dag gyur cig:ya ga brgya ba'asbyang bkru bya de nasabagegasabaskrad rim pa ni snotshos nyid smra bsam brjod bral rol pa las:lhun grub rang byung bgegs 'dul khro bo'i sprin:chos dbyings mkha' khyab phyag rgya'irol par sad:'byang po bdad tshogs gzhom pa'i sma ru gsal na ma dzeebatsun rtsa ba dang brgyad par bcas pa'i dpal mgon rig 'dzin ba ma tshoms kyis bka' bden

pa dang ston pa bla na med pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang: skyob pa 'dran zla dang bral ba dam pa'i chos rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang 'dren pa mtshung zla ma mchis pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang: snang cha ma 'gags kun rdzob rten 'brel zab mo'i bka' bden pa dang: stong nyid phyogs med don dam chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug ma gnas gsum gyis dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro bka' bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang: bden pa chen po de dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang mchog bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i sngon byung las dang 'phral snang rkyen gyi brkul ba'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma len pa'i slad du 'dir mchis par gyur cig: sarba bisnan a sharsha ya dza dza: dzaX hūṃ baṃ ho: a smra terabasang su bha wasasbyangs stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las tre las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ uhā

52tsho 'od du zhu ba las glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par gyur: namaX sarba ta thā ga ta a wa sogs༅ga4 akabaspelal btso bsgo bya ba'i po pa ni sno tshos nyid ma 'gags bde ba chen po las: lhun grub rig stong mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i gar zhe sdang rdo rje bgegasa'adul khro bo'i rgyal: 'byung po dam sri ma lusardul du rlog gsang sngags 'di la ma 'tshe phyir dengs shig bka' 'das dam nyams khyod rnams tshal bar gtub: de bas da lta nyid nas byer cig phaṭa bden stobasagong bgo brjodapa'i mthar rkyenagyi bskul ba'i 'byung po gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig: gal lte mi 'gro zhing gnod cing 'tshe bar gyur na bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje bgegs 'dul khro bo'i tshogs rab tu spros te bgegs khyed rnams kyis mgo po ardza ga'i tog pa bzhin du 'gas par 'gyur ta re hūṃ btso drag sngagasastobasakya bskrad dmigasamed lta ba' rgyasagadab po de nasabasrung lor rim pa ni tshi 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bar du gcod byed nga bdag ka nas

dag: rang byung lhun grub bsrung ba'i gur chen po 'gyur med rdo rje yangasapa'i rgyasagadab po badzrarakta tt+waṃ: de na mig dar bkab la'adi skad brjod: sngon chad zab lam rdo rje phag mo yis: smin byed dbang gi da lar ma zhugs gam: mthong yang slad nas 'jug pa'i rten 'brel du: dbang lnga'i dar gyi gdong g.yog mos pa mdzod o tsakyu bhanta wa ra ma ṇa ye swā snya de nasamersā sbyin pa ni e nyi rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes las: zung 'jug phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba la: ma gusastong lag bsdam pa'i mi rung ba'i u dum wa ra'i chun 'phyang sbyin par mos a khaṃ ni ra /: de na bden pa'i lorgyasagad pa ni 'o na: khyab brdal nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i skye 'gro semasacan thamasacad zung 'jug chos sku'i gzhi la 'god par bya de'i ched du bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam nyams su len par bya ba la thog mar dbang gis da la mthong ba gal che ste dbang med pa la dngos grub dbul: chu dkrub las ni mar mi 'byung zhes pa ltar zab lam rdorjephag mo'i dbang bskur zhu ba la thog mar gnas lugs shes pa gal che ste des

༄1 tsho na gzhi chos sku gdod nas rnam par dag cing ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yog mtha' dag dang bral te rang sangs rgyas pa khyad chos drug ldan chos sku kun tu bzang mo nyid do: re zhig gi tshe smon log dam nyams bdag tu lta ba'i ru tra zhes bya ba shin tu ma rung ba zhig tu mchis pa de'i srid gsum dbang du bsdus la sdig bcol 'ba' zhig la spyod skabs dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'og min gyis gnas su bka' yis bsgro gleng mdzad cing ye shes spyan gyi kun tu gzigs la gnyen po bka' bab kyis lha:chos dbyings kun tu bzang mor bab nas phrin las mdzad phyir ri ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas gzugs sku rdo rje phag mor bzhengs nas phag rkad ngur ba'i sa gsum shig shig tu g.yos te rnam pa mang pos thabs mkhas kyis brtul zhugs la brten nas bdag tu lta ba'i ru tra bsgral nas 'dzin med 'od gsal gyi dbyings la spar:mi 'grur rang byung rdo rje'i dam rtags bcings: lcan grub byang chub sems kyis mgon po ru shar: lha gnas sogs phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs rnams la rang dbang bsgyur te

smin cing grol bar byas la ded dpon khro bo bcu ru sprul te ma 'ong pa'i dus su sangs rgyas par lung bstan gnang bar byas so kun btags sna tshogs g.yos pa'i 'khor dbang phyug sogs kyang lce la dam tshig gis bdud rtsi bzhag de kho na nyid la dbang 'byer ba'i smin grol du gzhugs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran skyong bas lhag sdud dang gtor len du bka' bsgos zag pa klu yul du lhung ba las bdud rtsi a mṛ ta zhes gsang sngags sgrub pa'i dam rdzas khyad par can zhig byung ste phyi nang gsang ba'i zab gter rgya mtsho ru spel ba'i rgyu byas man ngag sna tshogs 'byung ba'i bka' med du byung ba ru sbas par mdzad do: de nas lhan skyes rdo rje phag mo'i zhal nas: e ma sngon bsags las kyisa'abras bu chud mi za: sna tshogs gsang sngags spyod pa rmad du byung gzung 'dzin bsgral ba'i khrag chen zas su spyod: he ru ka dpal ye shes mkha' 'gro ma las ldan gdul bya skyong bar dam bca' 'o: zhes gsungs so: 'dus pa'i 'khor gyi zhus pa: e ma rang byung ye shesardo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang sngags zab mo 'di nyid

pa tsho gang gis spyod bstan pa nam dar 'gro don gang du 'byung: lhan skyes rdo rje phag mo'i gsungs du gsol: slar gsungs pa: e ma las ldan khyed cag nyen la mos pas zung: 'di nas drug tu gsum chad na: mdangs ldan dha na ko dzi'i mtshor: lhun grub snang ba mtha' yas kyis thugs ga'i nyilas 'od zer 'phros: rgyu rkyen las 'das rang byung sku: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku 'byung: dur khrod brgyad du brtul zhugs mdzad gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad du bsgrangs:bsam yas 'gro la phan thog mdzad: bdag gis gsang sngags 'di yang bsgrags gzhan yang sku rje bod kyi yul 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i rgyal po yis padma 'byung gnas gdan drangs nas: gsang sngagasaphyinang gsang ba'i chos: lag len kha bskang dang bcas spel de dus nga nyid gzugs kyi sku: dbyangs can ma 'am mtsho rgyal zhes:las lngan rigs kyi mi mor snang zab gter rgya mtsho'i smong rgya bsngams rje 'bangs lo paṇa smin grol byed zhes gsungs nas 'khor 'dus pa mang po yi ring ngo: dus

rtags mngon gyur gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang rje 'bangs lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho tshom bu gcig tu 'dzom nas dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsugs lag khang bzhengs: mdo dang sngags kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin dar rgyas su mdzad do rje 'bangs grogs gsum la chos kyis de kho na nyid bstan: lo paṇa nyer gcig sogs kyi zla ngos re la bsam yas bar khang g.yu zhal 'bar ba ru gter gyis sgrub pa dang lta gon 'phrul yig rdo rje'i bka' rtags bcas mdzad skabs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyer lnga la: lung par dri bzang 'thib: 'od zer sna tshogs kyi drwa ba sbrel: tshogs 'khor gyi dga' ston 'gyed skabs: bar snang 'od thig gi klong las rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa byung te 'di skad gsungs ngo: e ma: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las pho nya mchog: ston 'khor dbyer med 'gro don ngo mtshar che: gsang sngags bstan pa gang du dar ba der: skad cig 'bral med bdag gis byin gyis brlabs: zab gter 'gro bar chos bka' sprum pa la: me tog bab ltar

pa'i tsho smon lam gtad rgya mdzod: zhes gsungs pa ltar byas nas khye'u chung 'a tsā dang ye shes mtsho rgyal rgyal ba mchog dbyangs gsum gyis me tog dor ba ye shesamakha' 'gro'i thugs gar phog nas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab po:e ma ye sangasargyasapa'i chos dbyings rnal 'byor ma bdag cag las dang skal ba re mchis nas/dbang gi cod paṇa rigs kyi mkha' la bab: thugs rje chen po'i rjes su bzung du gsol: zhes zhus tshe:kyi ho:sngon sreX las dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gsum: lnga brgya'i 'groba'i dpal du smon lam thob bdag ni 'du 'bral skad cig med pa phukhye'u chung lo tsāmi lta ba'i klong dang 'dres ge shes mamo rgyal bsgom pa'i gshis dang mnyams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs ye shes me dang sdeb: gdams pa sgrub skor zab gter bcu gsum chos: khyed cag gsum la gtad rgya'i dpal sbyin no: zhes gsungs nas 'od du gyuranas bka' bab gsum la thim mo: de nasagu ru rin po che'i rdo rje phag mo'i phyi yi sgrab stor rnams bse sgom du 'phrul yig byas la gtad rgya mdzad nas rgyal ba mcho dbyangs
