la gtad de lho rgyud gar sna zhes pa'i gnas su gter srung tsa ri dmar mo la bcol: dus rtags mngon gyur gyis zhal byang bcas mjad do: nang gi sgrub skor rnams rin po che g.yu sgrom du gzhugs nas ye shes mtsho rgyal la gtad de byang rong gnam rdzong zhes par bkram nas bsrungs ma sha za kha mo cher gnyer gtad nas snying byang yid bzhin nor bu bcas dar rgyas su mdzad do: khyad par gsang ba'i sgrub skor rnams rin po che shel gyis sgom bur bcug la ye shes kyi 'phrul yig rnam pa lnga ru bsdus nas byin rlabs bka' rtags gi rgya dang bcas nas khye'u chung lo tsā la gtad de: gnas mchog rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong la bsdam nas bsrung ma sngags bdag mched gsum la bcol nas man ngag mdo rtsa bcas mdzad pa legs so: khyad par skabs kyis gdams pa zab mo byung tshul yang: o rgyan chen po'i zhal nas: e maḥ lasaldan khye'u chung lo tsa khyod: ma 'ong dus kyi tha ma la: dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjer bzhengs: gser gyis bum pa lag tu lon: g.yu yis je tso grogs su bkol: tshogs drug yul la ltad mo byed: 'dzin pa lus

48 kyi gdul bya la a ti gsang ba'i thabs mchog 'doms: 'bum phrag tsidhi'i yul du 'dren ston pa nga dang gnyis su med: dam chos thugs gter bco brgyada'abyed las can 'khor gyi tshom bu bkra: gnas gang bde ldan gser gyi lung dus ni ka dag zang thal rtogs: bshad sgrub bstan pa'i ba dan 'dzug: 'gab 'dre dmasri'i snying la 'dzer: de dus rgyal mo tsha rong nas: gdams pa pha phog zab mo 'di: rnyed nas chos kyi bdag por spel: zhes pa ltar dus rtags mngon gyur gyisaspyon rgyan chen po'i smon lam gyi mthus lnga brgya snyigs ma'i 'gro ba skyob pa'i ded dpon mdo khams lcags mo'i rus rigs 'chang ba'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal zhes dpa' bo rtogs pa klong rdol gyi rnal 'byor ba de nyid kyi sngon dbang las kyis bsdus pa'i dpon slob zhal 'phrod rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs bskal pa chu pho sprel lo'i zla tshes kyi thun gseng zhig tu mkha' 'gro jon mo rus pa'i brgyan drag mas pa zhig byang nas 'di skad gsungs so: yi ma: sngagasaskyes rnal 'phyor dbang po tshur gson

dang: sbas pa'i gnas ni rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong: sgrub pa'i grogs mo padma'i tha tshig skyongs: gsang ba'i mtshan ni nyi 'od 'bar ma zer: gter kha chen po bcu yis gnyera'adzin yin: khyod la mos pa'i brda shog sprad par yong: byin rlabs tshan kha 'di ni gzhan las 'phags: nyams su longs dang rtags mtshan nges par gsal: ces pa'ibarda tshig gis bskul ba dang: bsrung ma rnams gsum gyi rin po che'i brda shog gtad tshe nyamasa'od gsal dang 'dres lta bachosasku dang mnyams bsgom palengesasku dang sdebs spyod pa rgyal bami myu gu dang 'grogs: gang snang dag pa rab 'byams su shar: 'gro don la skyo ngal med: lung par dri bzang 'thib: chos bdag la las 'phro sad/'ja' tshon 'od kyis 'khor los bskor: bdud rtsi sman gyi dngos grub 'byung ba sogs yon to bcu phrag sogs 'byung ngo 'dir brgyud pa ni chosasku kun bzang yabayum: longs sku snang ba mtha' yas: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas: sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal: ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs: rig 'dzin khye'u

༄1 chung lo tsa: gsang bdag bdud 'dul rdo rje: gar dbang bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal gter chen rdo rje khro lod: dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis bar du grub thob rig 'dzin gyi brgyud pa ma chad: dbang gi chu bo ma nub gdams ngag gi sarga ma log byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od ma yal dngos grub kyi rno myur ma rdul: dam sel gyi lhung ba ma byung ba'i zab lam gtum mo'i dbang bskur ba la bdag nyid slob dpon gyes bya ba dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bdag mdun bum bzlas tshogs mchod rig me dor ba sogs yongs su grub nas da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i maṇḍal phul bar zhu: slar yang snyim pa me tog dang thal mor bcas te gsol ba gdab pa 'dis rjes bzlos mdzod: de nas skyab su 'gro ba la dmigs pa 'ad bawo du mdzod mdun gyis nam mkhar dbyings phyug bde chen rdo rje phag mo dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i sgran jar bdag dang mtha' mnyam gyis sems can thams cad 'dun pa gcig dril du sgrabs su 'gro zhing sdom pa 'dzin par

pos la rjes zlos mdzod lan gsum de nas semasabasgod pa 'damigs pa 'di bzin du mdzod 'di ltar nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la'ang mtha' yod pa ma yin pa 'i gnas dman log lam du mgo rmongs su gyur pa'i byis pa rnam sa zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i lam la 'god phyir rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byerama'i spyan jar smon pa dang mdug pa'i sems ren po che bskyed pa'i dam sdom 'dzen pa'i mos pa dang bcas nas 'dis rjes zlos mdzod: de na lo bsags sapa yas: yan lagabadun yod bzhi brjod: rgyal yum dbyings phyugabade chen dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor tshogs kyis zhing mtha' yas pa la yan lag kun 'dus mchod pa rab bdun gyi sgo nas bskal tshogs skad cig la 'dum tha 'i dmigs bsam mos pa dang bcas te 'dis rjes zlos mdzod: de nas na gi sdom pa ni dmigs bsam da ldan 'di batsho brjod lha mi phongasakyi'adren ston sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams mtha' yas pa'i spyan sngar so byang sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig gi rim pa rnams mi nyams par rgyud la sngang nas sgog gi

52 7 slad du dam sdom 'dzin pa'i mos pa dang bcas nas 'dis rjes zlos mdzod: de nasamana' chu sbyin pa la dung zhal lagatu thogasanasasu to gsang jags ja na med pa'i dam tshig sgog gi mna' chu rgyal ba yongs kyi byin rlabs bcud 'dus kyi ngo bo: rdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin gyi rang mdangs ye shes bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di slob ma'i lce thog tu reg pa tsam gyis dbumabyang chub sems kyi dbyings su drangs te sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa la tshul bzhin tu gnas pa rnams la kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od lnga'i thig le'i rnam par shar ba'i klong du don dam mi shig pa'i ngo bo gser gyi rdo rje 'bar ba'i rang bzhin tu gyur nas nyams rtogs yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas la phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad yongs su zhi bar nges pa'o: dam sdom la mi gnas pa'i rigs rnams la bdud rtsi de nyid lcags kyi sdig pa ༄ 6)ra nas snying khrag drung nas 'byin cing tshe 'dir nad dang gnod pa'i g.yul gyis mnar de phyi ma rngo rje dmyal ba'i me yis tshig la sngag bsngal brnag par dka' ba myong dgos pa yin no: de nasaslob ma lhar bskyed da

spyon 'dren ye shesarab tu dbab lhag lha de nyid brtan par gzhugs de nas mee tog dor ban dkyil 'khor snang bam tshom bu la me tog dor ba'i rjesabazlosamadzod kyiho: rgyal ba phongabasa'adusadakyil 'khegar pachog bde chen rdo rje phag mo'i drung: bdag gi rig pa'i me tog 'di: dbab par mdzod la byin gyis rlobs: ༅ gsumorjesasu metag dor rig de ngo 4nga mingagadagasag de nasathog dar dbye ba la khyed rang rnams rkyes mig dar dang bcas te dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi phyogs su blta' bar mdzod cig: 'od dkar du mthong na rdo rje'i rigs dang zhi ba'i pas 'grub 'od ser du mthong na rin chen rigs dang rgyas pa'i las 'grub: 'od dmar du mthong na padma'i rigs dang dbang gi las 'grub 'od ljang du mthong na las kyi jegs dang drag po'i las 'grub pa yin pa'i don yid la zung zhig: bdag nyid rdo rjesgob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gser thur ser po'i rnam par byung nas khyod rang rnams kyis ma rig long tog gi dri ma bsal bar mos la jar gyi rigs de nyid ji lta ba bzhin du ye shes kyi rang zhal mthong bar dmigs la: mag dar bsal gsung ba'i rjes de nas

48smrathong ba bstan pa dang la ngo sprod pa' rim pa ni kye ho: skal ldan rigs kyi bu dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams nyon cig dkyil 'khor gyingo bo stong pa ni chos sku spros pa ba'o: rang bzhin 'od gsal ba ni longs sku phyogs mtha' yas pa'o: thugs rje rtsol med du snang ba ni sprul sku dmigs gtad bral ba'o: 'od lnga'i brgyan pa ni ye she rdzogs pa'i don no: lhun grub dpal gyi gtor ma ni sgrub dang dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i rang gzugs so: skye med chos dbyingasabum pa nisku rnam pa mtha' yas pa'i do bde stong lhun grub kwa pa la ni gsung 'gags med na dwa'i rang sgra'i gshis so: shes rab ye shesamadza' na mo ni yon tan lhan skyes bcu drug rtogs pa'i thabs so: bdag dbyings 'ja' shel nirig pa ka dag sgrib g.yog dang bral ba'i don mtshon pa'i brda'o: phrin las bcud 'dus kyisrig 'a/nigasang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye rtogs pa'i brda'o: rang byung grogug ni gzung 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa'i brda'o: snang ba'i rdzas rtags rgyal srid ni: rig pas rgyan du shar ba'i brda ru rgyal srid sna rnga

no: tshogs brgyad ka nas dag pa'i brda ru bkra shis rtags brgyad do: yul brgyad rang sar grol ba'i brda' ru rdzas mchog brgyad do rig stong rjen pa'i gshis su grolaba'i brda ru 'dod yon lnga'i bkod pa'o: rkyen snang lam du slong ba'i brda ༄ khyag rgya gar bsgyur bkram pa'o: mtshan ma rdzasakyis dkyil 'khor brda tsam du shes nas mtshanamed dbyings bde ba chen po sems nyid rig pa'i gshis lugs 'di las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas med pa'i don zab mo rtogs par mdzod cig: a a ā de nasobum pa thogasal 'o rigs kyi bu rnams: bum pa 'di nyid spyi bor bzhag byung ba'i dus su phyi rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal med khang la nang zag med bde stong bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'khyil ba gsang ba rgyal kun yongs 'dus kyi rang bzhin du rdzogs pa mngon gsum yin par shes pa'i mos gus mdzod cig: bum dbang bskur rjesango sprod ni de ltar sku bum pa'i dbangathob: lus kyis skyib pa dag rtsa yi bag chags sbrangs: bskyed rim gyi snod du rung: lus rdo rje'i sku ru 'phos: sprul sku'i sa bon theb snang stong gnyis su med

52 pa'i ye shesamajal: dga' ba dang stong pa'i 'od gsal mthong: rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa la sbyor ba yin no: de nasag4 dbang bskur ba na snga ma rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde stong byang chub sems kyi rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa slob ma'i lce thogs du bzhag la: gsang dbang rjesasu ngo sprod ni de ltar bhanta bdud rtsi lce thog la bzhag gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob: ngag gi sgrib pa dag: rlung khams kyi bag chags sbyangs: rdzogs rim gyi snod du gyur ngag rdo rje'i gsung du 'phos:longs sku'i sa bon thebs gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mjal: mchog dga' dang stong pa chen po'i 'od gsal mthong tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa la sbyor ba yin rgo: de na sher dbang bskur ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha las rdo rje'i rig ma lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa 'dzum pa'i bzhin rgyas shing: lang tsho'i dpal gyis 'byud pa: bcu drug dga' ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa gsang ba'i pho nya mo byung ste: de la 'du shes gsum ldan gyis sbor bar mos la: sher dbang rjes su ngo sprod ni de ltar rdo rje'i rig ma dang mnyam

par sbyor ba'i stobs kyis thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: yid kyi sgrib pa dag: thig le'i bag chags sbyangs: myang ba tsasgoli'i snod du gyur: yid rdo rje'i thugs su 'phos: chos sku'i sa bon thebs bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shesamasngal: khyad par dga' ba dang stong pa'i 'od gsal mthong: bcu drug rtsis las 'das pa'i don mthar phyan: phyag rgya chen po'i sa la sbyor ba yin no: de nasatshag dbang bskur ba ni snga ma rdo rje phag mo'i thugs ka nas dri ma med pa'i rdzas gsang ba'i shel dkar byung ste thabs de la brten nas lan skyes ye shes masngal bar bsam la kadag tshigagi dbang mdza bskur rje su ngo sprod rim pa ni de ltar dri ma med pa shel dkar gyi brda la brten nas: ka dag tshig gi dbang thob: cha mnyam gyi sgrib pa dag: der brten gyi bag chags rag pa sbyangs: ka dag khreg chod bsgom pa la dbang: sems rdo rje'i yon tan su 'phos: ngo bo nyid skya'i sa bon thebs: rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes masngal: lhan skyes kyi dga' ba dang shin tu stong pa'i 'od gsal mthong: lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa la sbrar ba yin

52 tsho no: de nas rtsal dab bskur ba ni snga ma rdo rje phag mo'i thugs ka nas gsang ba snga na med pa'i dkyil 'khor thig le dang gri gug gi rnam par byung bar mos la: rag pa 'a rtsaladabang bskur ba'i rjes ngo sprod bya ba'i ram pa ni de ltar dri ma bral ba'i thig le'i brda la brten nas: rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob: snang gsum gyi bag chags dag: shes sgrib phra ba'i phra ba yul med du sangs lhun grub thod rgal bsgom pa la dbang kun gzhi'i rnam shes rdo rje'i phrin las su 'phos mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku yi sa bon zebs dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mjal: dga' bral dri ma med pa dang bsam mi khyab pa'i stong nyid phyogs mtha' yas pa mthong: mchog gi rig 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la sbyor ba yin no: de nathamatha' brten ga' ma'i dbang kyi ho: rigs kyi bu dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams nyon cig: gtor ma ni sgrub dang dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i rang bzhin:phyi ltar na khrang 'thung khro bo brten pa'i rdzas: nang ltar du dbang dang dngos grub sgrab pa'i rten gsang ba ltar na bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ye shes nyams rtogs gong 'phel du

rgyas pa'i mdzod du shes pa'i ngang nas khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag pa'i bdud rtsi 'od zer dang bcas pa lan gsum bab: dang po'i sgrib tshogs dag: gnyis pa'i nyams rtogs 'phel: gsum pa'i smra bsam brjod bral gyi ye shes mthong bar bsam la mos gus drag po bskyed cig ga' ma'i dbang bskur bya ba'o rje sor smon lamagadab pa na ༷ chosasku kun tu bzang mo: longs sku rdo rje phag mo: sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal: lha lcam manta ra ba: mkha' 'gro su kha sirnyi: shel dkar rdo rje mtsho ma yum sbasapa'i dbang mo rdo rje zhi 'od 'bar ma: rin chen gser gyi 'od 'phro: padma me tog 'jum ma: las rab bde chen rgyal mo 'bum phrag gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro gnas yul ḍakki bsam yas bka' bab khye'u chung lo tsā: rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal rig 'dzin bdud 'jomasardo rje drin chen rtsa ba'i ja ma la sogs pa'i skrub pa'i lha brgyud pa'i ja ma dam pa rnams kyis deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol: rgyud bstan du gsol: byin gyis brlabs du gsol:

5) 9 rtogs pa spar du gsol: brtul zhugs bskyed du gsol: nyams rtogs rtsal du gsol bya bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin nasa'aja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas par gyur cig kā ya wākka trītta sarba garma a bhi ṣiñtsa / de nasamatha' brten gto pa ni 'o: dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i bkra shis rdzas brgyad phun tshogs lang tsho sgegs pa'i rtags mchog rnam brgyad: 'phags pa'i nor rnams 'dzoms pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun gtad pa'i bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan cing rang don chos sku'i dpal la 'byor cing: gzhan don gzugs sku'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig: aṣṭa maṅga lama.a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba sirnyi hūṃ āḥ gsang sngagasakyisdom pa dang dam tshig rnamasatshul bgo tu bsrung snyamasapa'i rjesazlos 'di ltar mdzod bla ma'idziltar brtsal ba bzhin: bdag gi de dag tshul bzhin bsrang lan gsum mkha phul la lusadabul ni bdag gilus longasasbod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa rdo rjer snga mar 'bul ba ni dbang gi tha tshag yin pa'i 'di rjes

zlos mdzod: deng nasabadag gi sgo gsum 'di snga mar 'bul lo slob mar zungs: ༅ gsum bskyal la bden brjod ni mdun gyi nam mkhar lha lam yangasapa ru dusagasumargyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: thibs kyi byung nas bden tshig tir tir sgrogs thugs rje'i brtse dgongs me tog char phab gyur:ye dharma ma rje 'di ltar bskyal ngo bo ye dag nam mkha' lta bu la: 'dzin med 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' brgyad bral: phyogs lhung yangs pa mi 'gyur bde ba che: chos dbyingasakun tu bzang mo'i bkra shisashog rang bzhin ma 'gags rta bdun rgyas pa'i zhal: 'khrul bral rang gsal ye shes rnam lnga'i bdag dmigs su med pa klong yangs mnyam nyid gshis longasasku rdo rjephag mo'i bkra shis shog: thugs rje ye shes lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas: sna tshogs rang rig yangs pa'i gdul bya smin 'od gsal jo bral gnyug ma de bzhin nyid: sprulasku bde chen rgyal mo'i bkra shis shog: gang snang dag pa rab 'byams lha yi sgra grags stong 'gags med na da'i rang sgrar dag: 'gyu 'phro ye shes chos sku chen por rdzogs:

52 tsho ro mnyams gsang sngags bla med bkra shis shog:rtsa khams rang grol bya chub sems kyi lam rlung gdang rnam dag ma 'gags bde ba che:thig le ye rdzogasarang rig ga ga ma'i gshis:dag pa dbyings gsum 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog:gdodanas stong chen yangs pa lta ba'i gshis:ma 'gags zang thal rang rig bsgom pa'ibab:thugs rje rtsol bral ye dag spyod pa'i gdangs:mnyam brdal rdzogs pa chen po'i bkra shis shog:de ltar ra lan grub pa 'i rjes bajo ba smon lam rgya yisagadab dga' ston masakyi'akhor lo bskor gnad de bkrashis phun sum tshogs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya skem rgyal ba'idab po padma ngas snying thig gdam pa zab pa 'i skor byin rlabasakhyad par 'phags pa 'i chos lkog yig dmar byang da bcas nas chubo bzhi ldan snying po' bcud las lan bskal bzang skyes bu'i ched rin chen sgrom bur bcug nas sbas bsrung ma rnam gsum bya ra bcol khye'u chu lo tsa'i dpa la du bzhag cha ba'i ro la a tham rgya:snying nor bu yi grogs su shog sa ma yu rba gtad rba smas rba zab rba gsang rba kong na ga rgya snya zhesapa 'di ya ske 'phrang btsu gsum da 'brel ba' chos kyi bdag po padma 'byur tshad rba mtsho'i rngo rje'i gsung dang dbang mdog lnga regs

gtsang ma bkra shis dngul dkar gya me long la chags bral padma 'dabs brgyad bkra ba'i dkyil du 'gyur med g.yu yi phra mdzes pa'i skyes bcas yang yang su bskul bskul nan du bshad bshad grangs med bsgrangs bsgrangs ba'i bzhed skong dusngags kyi rnal 'byor pa klong yang nus ldan rdo rje'i dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/ shu bhe/
skus zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las ḍākkoligasang bsgrub byin rlabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

sa namodzñān ḍakki ni ye: thang thab sko phyi rabathalasacan skal bzang skyes bu'i phyir snying la phang ba'i gdamasapa zab pa'i 'am padma nga yi thugasakya thig le mchog snying gi bu la gto kyisagazhan la rgya rang nyams gsang rgya byas te snying la 'chong dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub shugasalas 'byung tshe dang bsod namasonyamasartogasagong 'phel rgyas khamasagasum dbang gyur 'khor slob gdul bya 'dus gnyis snanga'abyung po gdug pa can rnam sgol lta ba'i co rgyasasgom pa zang ma thal spyod pa gang shar ye shesagand la 'byor the tshom med do gu ru padma' bka' bden rdzun nyamagasu long dang nges shesagasal sam mā e ma brtul zhugasaldan pa'i rnal 'byor skal ba bzang las smon tshogasabasags 'dzom pa'i skyes bu yis mi med dben par gsang rgyasaphyin nasasu sde brgyad tshogasal sa bslang mchod gtor bsngo 'byung po'i tshogasabarngan bar chad dbyings su bsgrad bsrung ba'i gur khang rim brgyad bkod par bya de na byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bya bde ba'i stan la gnasabacas rlung sems klod phyi nang gzung 'dzan 'khrul rtog phaṭaḥkyis bshag ma 'gags bde chen rolaba'i rtsal snang ni ā chos kun mi dmigs gzhi rtsa kun dang bral:rang mdangs ma 'gags byang chub sems kyi klong thabs shes zung 'jug beḥyig shar ba las:'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs bstim 'gro kun sdug bsngal sdig sgrib bag chags dag:yongs gyur ma chags padma 'dab rgyas khar:snang stong nyi zla rtog med bam ro'i steng:bdag

sa snang mi shig rdo dzeephag mo'i sku dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzi 'od 'khyug: spyan gsum mkhar gzigs smar smin me ltar 'bar dmar ser dbusgra gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan: nyi zla'i snyan cha dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur: rna ltag g.yas nas phag skad ngur sgra sgrogs: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche bgatsigs: phyag g.yas bhanta dmar ltem zhal la bstab g.yon pas gri gug yu ba dku la brten nu 'bur bde stong gsang ba'i padmo rgyas: stag gi sham thabs rus pa'irgyan drug mdzes: zhabs gnyis gyad stabs g.yon 'gyeng sgeg pa'i sku: thod pa'i phreng ba ratna'i do shal 'phyang: gnas lngar rtsa 'khor thig le phra mo'i klong: 'bum phragayangs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdzogs: he ru ka pa sbas pa'i tshul du 'chang: spyipor rigs bdag kun tu bzang mo mdzes: ba spu'i dbyings su rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rdzogs: spi mgrin snying gar yig 'ja gsum gsal las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pa yis: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: kha ba bu yug

'tshubs pa ji bzhin du phyag rgya yig 'byu phyag mtshan rnam par bsdus: bdag snang mi shig rdo rje'i dbyings dang bstim lha sngags de kho na nyid ngang du bzhugs: dran rig gsal sangs rjen pas gus phyag 'tshal: snang srid kun bzang dag mnyam mchod pa 'bul: mi 'gyur spros bral bde ba chen por bstod: rang nyid lha yi thugs gar pad zla'i steng: 'od lnga'i dga' 'byel sbubs su baṃḥyig dmar: de mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yon du 'khor bzlas pas lus ngag yid kyi sdig sgrib dag: tshe dang bsod nams yar ngos zla ltar 'phel: khams gsum srid pa'i zas nor dpal la dbang: gnyis snang gzung 'dzin rū tra kun bsgral nas: gang shar rang grol dag mnyam chos sku'i ngang: mi g.yo sprosabral rig stong rjen pa'i gshis so ma ngang bzhag rgya yan lhug pa che: rmo dhu ma gha ye na ma boḥsarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ga47dag stong pa gsum gyigand ldan zhi sgogasum rdo rje gsum du lam khyer bya thabs shes phyag rgya chen po' ngang la bzla ye shes 'od zer 'bar ba'i spros bsdus byed slar yang sgrub pa'ishamani'adi ltar bya 67 dma ma gru ye na ma ku ya wākka tsitta sa ma ti sirnyi

sa bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru tt+waṃ:dmigasadang 'phro 'du gsal ba'i 'od zer kyang yengs med dzi 'dzin dag pa'i spro bsdu bya shkas dang rtogs pa 'a yon to yar zla bzhi gong na gong 'phel mchog thunadangosogrub 'bebs skab sulasalasar ba'i bzla dmigasani oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma ratna bā su kha dhe aḥrtsi nyi.a ra ya bsdus bsdus sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ āḥdamigasapa'isno dngagasal ba'i 'odazerasgo 'phro 'du'i pho nya 'gyur med ting 'dzan gzhi bzlas pa'i lcags kyu dad pa'i bskul ma yis za nor longs spyod ma lus ra bzhin 'byung the tshom med do rdo rje padma'i bka' skab sushesarab 'bar ba'i bzla pa ni snyen dhu ma gha ye na ma pra dzñā dzñā na sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ yisayeng med brtson 'gru drag po'i lcag ga brab 'gyur med mosagusa'odazer spro bsdu byed she rab thogasamed ye sheganyi ma 'bar las rtsod rtsom pa'i dge marga nyiltar gsal bslu ba bral lo pha gcig padma' bka' skab subyin rlab bsdu bar 'dod pa na glus dhu ma gha ye na ma ma hā gu ru kā ya wākka tsitta sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā ci 'grub mosagusadagapa bzla pa na dbang dang byin rlabs dngosagrub 'bad med 'byung sngar med nyams rtogasahur bo gsal du nga bden rdzun lag tu long dang nge shes gsal yad gnyisami dgo rdo rje rgyalapo'i gtam sam yu donasamatshad cing bstod par

bya ba la dbyang gsalarten snying yig brgyasalhag ra skong thod rnga'i sgra yisathugasadam bskul ba ni hū trī: ka dag skye med chos dbyingasapho brang nas: lhun grub 'gags pa med pa'i ye shesasku sgrub mchog rnal 'byor skyong ba'i yum chen mo: rig stong rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor bcas thugs dam gsang ba chen pos rgyud bskul na: rmad byung ye shes gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol thod rnga snyan pa'i sgra la dgyes par dgongs: dam ldan rnal 'byor bu la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'byung po thul nyams rtogs yon ma yar ngos zla ltar bskyed mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob o dzñā na ḍāsko ni sam ya dza dza tiṣṭha lhan dpung gis byon nas sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim par bsam gtor ma 'byu gsum dag gi byin gyisarlabs ha ho snoyisanam mkha'i mdzod du spel mkha' 'gro'i lngagasagri gug gi rnam par gyur ba gtor ma'i bcud drangasategasolabs ga med bde ba chen posadagyesapa bskang bar bsam la oṃ dma ma snga ye na ma sarba sapa ri wā ra e dam bā lijo kha kha khā nyi khā ༷ lan bdun gyisaphulabar bya'o den phrin la bcolabar bya

sa ba ni hūṃ hrī: gzung 'dzin bdag lta'i rū tra bsgral ba las: bdag med don dam phag mo'i sku ru bzhedas nyi shu rtsa bzhi yul ni sum cu gnyis: dur khrod he ru'i gnas skyong ma mo dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho rnams: bka' yis dbang bsdus bran du khas blangs bcug: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba dang:dkon mchog dbu bstod dge 'dun sde skyong zhing: sgrub pa'i drod nyul gtor ma blang bar bsgos: tha tshig ma g.yel 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro rnams deng sang snyigs ma'i rtsub 'gyur ru gzengs skabs bdag cag dad pas chos la mos na yang: rgyal bsen dam sri'i g.yo ba sna tshogs ngom lta sgom rig pa gzhur la drangs mod kyang: kla klo gdug pas bying rmugs 'thibs rkyen 'byung: g.yel med rtag tu bsnyen sgrub brtson 'dod yang: le lo rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i bdud kyis 'tshe: tshe gcig srid pa'i pha mthar brgal 'ardod kung: snye 'brel babud kyi pho nyas 'khor bar 'ching dam chos sgab la bar chad mang mchis pas: ma dang mkha' 'gro ma g.yel bu la dpod sa: bye nang gsang ba'i

bar chad dbyings su sol gol shor nor gsum gegs dang 'phrang bsgral nas: tshe gcig mi med lung stong zin pa dang bya btang brtul zhugs ri khrod thub pa'i stobs 'jig rten chos brgyad 'du 'dzi dben pa dang: nyon mongs bar chad bdud kyi 'phrang las sgrol: gtad med har sangs yan pa'i dbyings dang bsres: 'dzin bral gang shar ye shes ha rer sprod: shugs 'byung rang shar rtsol med spyod pa'i gnad 'od gsal brdal khyab nyi zla gsal ba'i stobs: mi 'jigs gdengs chen dpa' ba'i shugs phyung la: rig stong chosasku yangs pa'i rgyal sar skyol gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sar phyin par shog: skabasa'adar phyinangags ba'i pu tsa khrul de nagasad pa byab 'ad ltar ro hūṃ trī: sor rtog ye shes padma rā ga'i mdangs: ma rung gzung 'dzin rū tra bsgral ba'i gshed: dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong ba'i dam tshig can rdo rje phag mo'i sku gsung thugs la bstod:ste ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad kun: skad cig 'bral ba med par byin rlabs nas: zhal masngal lung ston dbang basmar sngo sna bsgrar: gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sa

ra ཿ zin par regag de lta ra byas la smon lam gzhan yang gdab bsdu sdang la sogasagazhan dang mthun pa ra bya gnad des bsod namasaye shesatshogasachen rdzogs the tshom med do rgyal ba chen po'i bka' sam mā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha sa snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag par thug brtse bas rgya bal bod yul thams cad gter gyisabakang nga sprul bslu ba med pa'i gter chen rer gter phran nyi shu rtsa lngasabaskor nasasu lasaldan gdul bya skyob pa'i dpa la du bzhag ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo rtsub 'gyur dus kla klo gdug pa'i mgo 'phang drag pa'i dus khyi'uchungalo tsā rdo rje khro lod kyi gzugasaskur bzhedas na bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel de yi gdung rgyud yi shesanyi ma zhes snga ma gnyis kyi gter mjug skyong ba'i rigs rnal 'byor rdo rje'i rigs can blon sbyang can dpa'abo nusaldan 'dusapa spral du grags chosakyi bdag po dam pa dharma'imatshan la kyi 'brel ba'i skye bu rnam pa bdun tshig gis bskul ba'i skal bzang bu lngadang sgra tsam thos pa 'i gang zag rnam pa gsum rjes nas las ldan skyes bu bcugasum sogs 'byung la bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i lang tsho spel rdzogs ldan gsal ba'i 'bras bu yar zla bzhin gong nas go 'phel chud mi za bar 'gyur bka' 'a da drag po srog bdag sdebazha dang dragamomached gsum dag gis thub par srungs skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya lasocan snyang gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma shā

rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi cas pa 'di'ang smon lam las kyis 'brel ba'i chos kya bdag po padma chos 'thel rgya mtshos bzhed ngor rten 'brel dge ba' sna 'ga' re 'byu ba' mod la jags kya rnal 'byor nu ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro'i gsang brda lasazhal bdusate dag par phab pa dge'o/dge'o/dge'o/legaloso/sarba mang ga lam//phaṭa gzung 'dzin gnyisakyis bsdus pa yi:'khor ba'i rū tra ma tram̐ ga:bdag med shesarab ral gris bsgral:chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i lha la 'bul:rmimahā sarba pañtsa tstsha khā twe:

sasnyerdzu zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: mkha' 'a14)bstod bskul zab mo dad pa'i gdungs dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so:sa ju na mo dzñā na ḍakki ni ye: mtshag tu yi'agyur bde za ye shes gshis lam snang za byed gas mor snang ba yis gzung 'a༄ na rtsad gcod mkha' 'gro yongasal spa lhan skyesardo rje phag mo ra phyag 'a pa lo byang chub sgrub cing gzhan phan don gnyer blo'i mag pa'i la mchog dzñā na wa ra nyirnam par bstod ci 'gro ba'i don du bskul cesapa'i don la zhugasapa man ngag go sam yu rnga brdung thod pa'i cing te'u 'brol ba dang bzhugs glu daragadug 'phan phyar sposaza bltams snang gsal sbar la snyan pa'i dbyangs za po'i hūṃ hrī: dbus mtha' med pa'i chos dbyings dkyil 'khor nas: ye sangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang mo'i sku:lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan: ka dag spros mtha' bral la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdechen 'bar ba dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: ma chags sor rtog padma rā ga'i mdangs: dri bral 'khor 'das spyi dpal bla na med: 'gags med snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstod: mdangs ldan lho nub mtsho gling pad sdong rtser: rdzu 'phrul

rmad byung gu ru thod phreng rtsal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i spro bsdu bsam mtha' yas: padma 'byung gnas mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod gsang chen o rgyan rang byung dur khrod nas: bde chen 'gyur med ye shes wa ra hi rtog pa'i ru tra bsgral ba'i brtul zhugs can mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal bstod: zla gam dbang chen gdengs pa e yis klong: thabs mchog dpa' bo chen po gar gyi dbang: rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags rta skad spud: 'gyur med dbang chen gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: mkha' spyod u tsa la yi dur khrod nas: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs khro gtum bshad pa'i sku: sgrub mchog kun gyis grogs mo dngos grub bdag: ma cig khros ma nag mor phyag 'tshal bstod:dkar gsal 'od thig zlum la 'khyil ba'i klong zhi ba'i las mdzad bde chen ye shes sku me long lta bu'i klong las dngos grub 'bebs: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod ser gsal 'od garting 'khyil la brjid pa'i krong: rgyas pa'i las mdzad mchog gi phrin las bdag: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes smrar snang ba: rin chen mkha'

sku 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmar gsal 'od 'byel brjid la brten pa'i klong: dbang gi las mdzad bde chen mdza' na mo: so sor rtog pa'i ye shesaskur snang ba: padma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:ljang gsal 'khyel la g.yo ba'i gur khang klong: drag po'i las mdzad gzung 'dzin gshed po che bya ba grub pa'iye shes skur snang ba: karma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dga' chen yishasda gsang ba don gyi klong: stong nyid mi gnas shes rab 'gyur med gshis: mi shigabarjod bral don dam mchog gi sku: las bzhi lhun grub mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las sna chogs 'gag med bde rtsol 1nga: bde stong 'gyur med ye shesamachog gi lam: dbang dang dngos grub 'bad med shugs la stsol: gdong can mched bzhi gtso 'khor bcas la bstod:sgrub pa'idrod nyul rlung sems ye shes bskyed: thunamong mchog gi dngos grab char bzhin 'bebs: las can bu la 'bral med rjes 'dzin pa'i: bka' sdod sgog bdag sde lngar phyag 'tshal bstod:mkha' la pogs mad nam

mkha'i glog ma sprin:bar snang rlung ltar bskyod pa'i thog mda' 'phen:sa gzhir nad rims 'bebs pa'i phung byed nag:sngags bdag mched gsum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:ces nyid mkha' la thugs rje rtsol med 'gro:byang chub sems kyi spro bsdu yongs la brdal:mi shig 'gags pa bral ba'i ye shesacan:'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod:zhi ba'i lasamadzad bde chen mtsho rgyal dang:rgyas byed ser mo manta ra ba'i sku:dbang mdzad ku ru kulle pad rag mdangs:khro gtum drag mo shel dkar rdo rje mtsho:mchog gi pho nya bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod:gsang sngagasabastan dang der 'dzin rnal 'byor ba:'od gsal snying po gang du rgyas pa der:skad cig 'bral ba med par byin rlabs pa'i:sngon gyi dam tshig can la phyag 'tshal bstod dam ldan sgrub pa'i skyes bu ma lus la:dbang dang dngos grub mchog gi gru char 'bebs:bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams len nar bsring ba'i:ma gcig rnal 'byor dbang mor phyag 'tshal bstod:bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas:dam bca' las

sa smon 'dzomasapa'i rten 'brel sgo: phun sum tshogasapa'i bkra shisadon mthar phyin: lha gcig ye shesamakha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod: samayā rgya༅ gu misnyi donas mkha' 'gro bskul ba' rim pa la tshil chen spos bsreg rol mo sna tshogs sbir snyan pa 'a dbyangs kyi mkha' 'gror gsol gdab pa 'gro phan snyi rje' 'bras bu phyug pa yis hūṃ bhyo: dza sa dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba na rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma rnams: thugs dam ma g.yel bu la dgongs phrin las stsol ba'i dus la bab: bde chen yeshes pho brang nas: rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha: ma g.yel thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: rnga yab srin po'i grong khyer nas dpa' bo rakka thod phreng rtsal: thugs dam dgongs pa'i shugs phyung la: gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod dus la bab: dag pa dbyings kyi pho brang nas: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha: ma g.yel ma 'khyang thugs dam basmal: bde sngong bsked pa'i dus la bab stsa tshogs las kyi pho brang nas king dad ling ga 'bar ma tshoms: ma g.yel thugs dam gnad nas bskal: phrin las yongs

'grub dus la bab hūṃ bhyo: mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa nas: dur khrod rngams brjid pho brang klong 'jigs rung he ru ka yi gnas: khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing: rdo rjecan yang nga ba: ri bo thams cad rus pa'i sa rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung: chu 'bebs thams cad khrag dang rnag: thod mkhar me rlung 'khrigs pa nas: rgyal bathams cad bskyed pa' yum: bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa mo: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho spro bsdus brgyan skal ldan skyong ba'i dam tshig can: rdo rje phag mo'i thugasadam bskul khros ma nag mos thugs dam bskul: rdo rje mkha' 'gros thugs dam bskul: rin chen mkha' 'gros thugs dam bskul: padma mkha' 'gros thugs dam bskul lasakyimakha' 'gros thugs dam bskul rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros thugs dam bskul: dkar mo rnam rgyal thugs dam bskul: ser mo tshe 'phel thugasadam bskul: dmar mo dbang sdad thugs dam basmral: ljang mo dbugs len thugs dam bskal shar gyi ma bdun thugs dam basmral: lho yi srang bdun thugs dam basmral nub kyi

sa mdza' bdun thugs dam bskul: byang gi bran bdun thugs dam bskul klu rgyal chen po'i thugs dam bskul: ya ma ra tsa'i thugs dam bskul shan pa kusa'adebs dam bskul: srid pa'i dbang mo'i thugs dam bskul: drag mo gsum gyis thugs dam bskul sprul 'khor bsam yas thugs dam bskul: bzhedas/go mkha' spyod dbyings nas bzhengs bskul lo 'gro ba'i phyir du bskul: mdzod cig gdug pa 'dul bar mdzod: kla 1 gdug pa'i cho 'phrul bsgyur: du ru ka yis gzing ba gzhesas: log 'brul 'khor ba'i mtsho mo skoms ra dza dam sri rtsad nas chod: byang chub sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe bzlog: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen sol: sgrub pa po la bu bzhin skyongs: dam rdzas skyems gtor mchod pa bzhes: 'gal 'khrul dam tshig nyams chags bshags: mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad zhi ba dang: dngos grub ma lus char bzhin phob: 'jigs brgyad zhi zhing tshe bsod rgyas: khams gsum dbang sdad mos bzhi 'gags: dgra bgegs log 'dren rdzul du rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par

mdzod: dus la bab po sa ma yā: cesabarjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs ma dang mkha' 'gro gnad na bskul phrin lasarab 'byamasathog med 'grub phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel the tshom med do sa ma yu srog bdag sde lnga'i thub par srungs lasacan bu dang 'phrad par shog sam yu rgyargya rgya gu rgya dha thim snyi cesapa 'di yang skye ba bcu gsum du 'brel ba' chosakya bdag po padma chosa'aphelargya mtsho zhesabya ba dad pa'i nor dang bsgrubapa'i brtson 'grus kyi phyugs pa de yis bzhed ngor bdag 'dra sngags 'chang nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda' ris lasazhal bzhugs te dag par phab pa dge zhang bkra shis par gyur cig sarba maṅga lam/
